items.quote: Our new Rs 130 crore investment in Dahej is also progressing well, and our teams have done a great job of keeping it on track in spite of the challenges and disruptions we have been witnessing on account of the war in the last few months.

items.statement: TDQ plant trial production underway with customer samples initiated; commercial supplies expected from Q4 FY27
items.quote: Trial production at our new TDQ plant in Dahej is coming along well with initiation of samples to customers. As approvals progress and commercial supplies ramp up over time, we believe this investment will further reinforce our competitive position in the market.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 11.2%, up 210 bps YoY and 480 bps QoQ
items.quote: EBITDA margins for Q1 FY27 stood at 11.2%, expanding by 210 basis points YoY compared to Q1 FY26, and by 480 basis points QoQ compared to Q4 FY26.

items.statement: Anti-dumping duty approved on Sulphonamides (CBS & NS) on 20 June 2026; Pilflex 13 DGTR positive recommendation in June 2026, awaiting government approval
items.quote: The Central Government has approved the imposition of anti-dumping duty on Sulphonamides, covering both CBS and NS on 20th June 2026. On the other product front, the Pilflex 13 the Director General of Trade Remedies, DGTR, issued a positive final recommendation in June 2026.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 export-domestic volume mix 33:67; export share expected to rise directionally to 40-45% over time
items.quote: In the 1st Quarter, we see exports about roughly 33% and domestic 67%.

items.statement: Specialty segment currently ~15% of revenue; expected to add 5-10% more over next 1-2 years
items.quote: Yes, so that should add to that. So, I would expect at least another 5% to 10%, we should see an additional.

items.statement: Deferred volumes from Q1 supply constraints expected to recover in coming quarters
items.quote: We continue to work closely with our suppliers and logistics partners to normalize supplies and execute the pending orders, and we remain confident of recovering the deferred volumes in the coming quarters.

items.statement: Anti-dumping duties on CBS/NS and Pilflex 13 cover ~25-30% of topline (ex-TDQ)
items.quote: So, this would be totally about 25% to 30%.

items.statement: Maintains 2x market growth target with broad-based volume growth across consumer, industrial, and institutional segments
items.quote: We maintain the range of 2x the market growth. We are in that range.

items.statement: Implemented two price increases in low double digits during Jan-Jun 2026 to offset commodity inflation
items.quote: In the quarter, which is the April to June quarter, we have taken pricing action, which are in low double digit. And with that, there are 2 price increases that we have implemented this year, January to June

items.statement: Targets EBITDA margin range of 21-24% and uses pricing actions to maintain it amid cost volatility
items.quote: We are guided by our pricing actions by 2 things. One is our outlook on raw material prices / cost, and the second is our direction on maintaining our EBITDA margin at 21% to 24%.

items.statement: Q2 FY26 EBITDA margin at ~26%, H1 FY26 at ~24%; expects commodity cost impact to become more visible in Q3
items.quote: We, therefore, expect the impact of commodity and feedstock inflation to become more visible in the third quarter.

items.statement: Annual capex ~INR100 crores split between manufacturing (capacity, safety) and market visibility investments
items.quote: We spend about INR100 crores, almost about half amidst both of them.

items.statement: Launched fully synthetic variants under Activ (10W-30, 5W-30), upgraded GTX 5W-30 to fully synthetic, introduced GTX 0W-20; industrial coolant Alusol SL 61 XBB
items.quote: We expanded our fully synthetic range. We introduced premium variants in Castrol Activ. It's called Castrol Activ Synthetic 10W-30 and 5W-30 visco metrics. We upgraded GTX 5W-30 to a fully synthetic product positioning, and introduced a full synthetic under GTX 0W-20.

items.statement: Cautious outlook due to higher inflationary pressures, uneven monsoon, commodity volatility; Silvassa plant briefly halted in July for safety but fully restored
items.quote: Looking ahead, we remain cautious given higher inflationary pressures, uneven monsoon conditions, and continued volatility in key commodities.

items.statement: Interim dividend of INR6.25/share declared, payable by 2 Sep 2026; dividend yield historically ~5% combined interim and final
items.quote: The Board this quarter has declared an interim dividend of INR6.25 per share, which will be payable on or before 2nd September 2026.

items.statement: Targets INR 1,000 crore revenue by FY29-30 through organic growth from existing product basket and new verticals
items.quote: The company looks at growing to INR 1,000 crores by 2029-'30. And that growth is going to be very organic coming from its existing product basket.

items.statement: Targets sustainable double-digit EBITDA margins of 10-13% over time
items.quote: Target margins are to stabilize and take the EBITDA margins to a sustainable double digit, grow it from a 10% to 11% and going up to 13% and keep it sustainably consistent at those levels.

items.statement: Expects to reach 10% EBITDA margin in FY27 through economies of scale and cost reduction
items.quote: So hopefully, yes, we can go up to -- we are trying to get into 10% this year.

items.statement: Plans INR 30-40 crore capex over 3-4 years for new verticals and Thane plant shift; INR 5-10 crore in FY27
items.quote: This year, I think we're looking at around INR 5 crores to INR 7 crores, because as I mentioned -- or going up to INR 10 crores, because as I mentioned, we've already set up two product vertical lines, and we're also looking at expanding the MIG wire product line.

items.statement: Total incremental capex of INR 30-40 crore over next 3-4 years for SAW wire, SAW flux, flux cored wire and Thane facility shift
items.quote: We are looking at around another INR 30 crores to INR 40 crores capex and going up to INR 1,000 crores over the next three to four years.

items.statement: Niche products contribute 27-30% of revenue; expected to increase with NPCIL approval and infrastructure growth
items.quote: So currently around 27% to 30% would come from the niche product category. And of course, the larger chunk coming from the commodity products.

items.statement: Expects nuclear power to contribute 10% and shipbuilding 3-5% of revenue at INR 1,000 crore scale
items.quote: At least I would say, we should be doing at least 10% of our business from nuclear. This is what we envisage. And from shipbuilding now, shipbuilding business will also be going to start take up for which the major consumption will come from flux cored wires. So once that should also will take care of around 3% to 5% o

items.statement: Received orders from 3-4 major players including L&T, ISGEC, BHEL, NPCIL, MEIL for nuclear-qualified products
items.quote: We have already received orders also from 3-4 major players.

items.statement: Promoter share pledge of INR 40 crore for personal loan settlement; to be freed over 3-4 years
items.quote: So, the pledge has been done for personal, regarding the settlement of personal loan that the promoters had to take. And the timeline for the same or another three to four years, we'll be slowly reaping and freeing the share pledge.

items.statement: Monetizing Thane land via joint development for ~INR 400 crore over 5 years to fund inorganic growth from INR 1,000 to 2,000 crore
items.quote: The cash flow is coming from it approximately INR 400 crores over the next five years is where the company looks at going ahead and doing some inorganic growth and taking the company's growth journey forward from 1,000 to another 2,000.

items.statement: Industry growing at 6-7% CAGR; GEE targets 20% CAGR by capturing unorganized-to-organized shift and new technology adoption
items.quote: So, when I say that growing at a 20% CAGR vis-a-vis a 6% to 7% CAGR which the industry is witnessing today.

items.statement: Thane plant shifting to be completed by end of September 2026
items.quote: I think by end of September, it will be completed.

items.statement: Flux cored wire commercial production starting by September/October 2026; SAW wire and flux already in commercial production
items.quote: The first line is already in process. I think by within by September end or early October, it should start the production.

items.statement: FY27 industry volume may be 5-10% lower than last year, best case matching last year.
items.quote: Today, the revised forecast that we are having for rest of the year suggests it could be 5%-10%, within that range.

items.statement: FY27 industry volume could be north of 450,000 units, best case same as last year.
items.quote: If you do the math, we should be north of 450,000. Best case, same as last year.

items.statement: PAT margin target range 7.5%-8.5% for the year.
items.quote: somewhere between 7.5%-8.5% is the margin range that we can at least as an overall band that you can take.

items.statement: Phase-1 and Phase-1(a) capex nearly 40% done, some production started.
items.quote: we are implementing a Phase-1 and Phase-1(a) of CAPEX and nearly 40% of those investment are already done, and we have already started some level of production in that.

items.statement: Capex to improve capacity by 25%-30%.
items.quote: Roughly, I would say that we are looking at anywhere between 25%-30% capacity improvement.

items.statement: Q4 expected to be another peak quarter, barring geopolitical and monsoon headwinds.
items.quote: Q4, as expected, is going to be another peak quarter for us, barring the headwinds that we see, the geopolitical tension and the monsoon effect.

items.statement: Qualitative year: reasonable Q2, increasing demand Q3, Q4 peak.
items.quote: Reasonable Q2, increasing demand in Q3, barring the monsoon question that I had, and then Q4 ending at a peak.

items.statement: Commodity price increases are fully passed through to customers.
items.quote: It’s a complete passthrough of all the commodities, be it steel, casting, forging, any commodity increase will be passed through.

items.statement: Some price increases absorbed this quarter; working with customers to offset future impacts.
items.quote: Yes, there were some price increases that are there, which we have absorbed this quarter but in parallel, we are working with our customers, to offset the impacts in the future.

items.statement: New 160 tandem axle in pilot batch, entering production with a large customer.
items.quote: We are launching a new tandem axles, which is already in pilot batch, and it’s getting into production mode as we speak. This is a 160 tandem, so we are launching this with one of the large customers.

items.statement: Bus axle launch delayed for design iteration to meet pass-by noise regulations.
items.quote: we are again going back to the drawing board and ensuring the product spec what we have is also going to cover those noise levels that the industry will meet.

items.statement: Monsoon and geopolitical tensions are key headwinds being monitored.
items.quote: The headwind is monsoon. We do not know how it is going to play out.

items.statement: Exports were 13% of revenue in Q1, expected to remain 8%-12% for the year.
items.quote: This time we were slightly better off in terms of exports. So, we were at about 13% for the quarter, on the overall pie.

items.statement: Defense contributes 5%-10% of revenue depending on tender awards.
items.quote: currently, our presence out of the revenue that we are generating, maybe defense goes 5%-10% depending on how the tenders are awarded.

items.statement: Bharuch SRB line utilization at 40-45% in Q1, targeting 70% by Aug-Sep; CRB line to ramp by Q2/Q3 end
items.quote: That utilization level in the last quarter would have been anywhere close to 40%-45%, and we expect that to ramp it up to 70%, which Chairman told in the last meeting, in August, September timeframe. The CRB line is slightly lower in terms of its utilization, and we expect to ramp it up towards the Q2 end and Q3.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 revenue mix: Rail 22% (INR200 cr), Mobile 20% (INR184 cr), Distribution 17% (INR154 cr), Process 20% (INR186 cr), Exports 21% (INR200 cr)
items.quote: For this quarter, FY27 first quarter, rail stood at INR200 crore, that is 22% of the total INR929. Mobile others was at INR184 crore. Distribution was at INR153.9, which is INR154 almost. Process was INR186. Exports was at almost INR200 crore, slight export incentive of 1% of the total.

items.statement: Manufactured vs traded mix steady at ~75/25 in Q1 FY27
items.quote: It is almost in the similar range, I would say. Though we do not disclose, but I think whatever numbers we gave in the earlier quarters, it's almost in the similar range of 75/25.

items.statement: US automotive business expected to grow 60-70% over the next 3 years, primarily from wallet share gains with existing OEMs like Ford and Chrysler.
items.quote: Sir we have already told that our US business will increase and next in next three years the business will almost be if not double at least 60%, 70% our US business will increase, right? In terms of US automotive. So our share of business in Ford was very less. So we have got good orders from Ford and the business will

items.statement: Potential additional capex of INR 250 crores over next 2 years if final decision is made on a new greenfield facility (likely outside India).
items.quote: 2027, 2028 can't tell you exact figure, depends -- if we have taken a final call on putting up a new facility somewhere. So, if that happens, then in the next 2 years, you will have a capex of 250 crores. Yes, it will be additional. But we can tell you after taking the final call.

items.statement: Received good OEM supply orders from USA, already contributing to export revenue; export OEM revenue grew ~40% YoY to INR 73.56 crores in Q1 FY27.
items.quote: And in this context, we have received some good OEM supply orders from U.S.A., which have already started making good contribution to our export sales revenue and overall business profitability. And this sales growth and increased momentum is expected to continue in the next 2, 3 years.

items.statement: No price hike pushed in US export OEM market yet despite RM cost inflation and 4x freight cost increase; 10% natural hedge from USD appreciation partially offset costs.
items.quote: So obviously, we have not taken a price increase in the export market but you also have to look at one more thing in this 10% more or less natural hedge has happened. Right? If today I was selling material for US$8 and I was having realization of 85 to 86, so at 94 I was getting a 10% natural hedge. That's okay, my raw

items.statement: Export volume grew 9% YoY, domestic volume grew 1% YoY in Q1 FY27; overall volume growth ~3%. Footwear segment saw degrowth due to raw material price spikes.
items.quote: Volume growth for domestic and export is in total. Export is 9% plus is the growth rate and 1% is domestic growth rate. Overall, 2.77%, around 3%, you can take it.

items.statement: Geopolitical volatility (Trump tariffs, West Asia war, shipping disruptions) delaying final decision on overseas plant location (Mexico, US, or other NAFTA regions).
items.quote: So it could be in Mexico, it could be in U.S., it could be in some other NAFTA areas. We are still considering various options, but there's so much of volatility in the market. So it's not easy to decide where exactly we should put the plant right now.

items.statement: India-UK/EU FTA seen as positive for export sentiment and customer de-risking toward India, but no quantified business impact provided.
items.quote: I think so it's a very positive move for India. Definitely, we will be more effective in terms of cost. The sentiments of the customers to procure from India will definitely increase. So and definitely both especially in the Europe market, I mean very good sentiments are coming. Maybe customers might think of, you know

items.statement: Private Markets credit book guided to grow 15-20% Y-o-Y; half achieved in Q1
items.quote: what we had guided at the end of quarter 4 was this book should see at least a 15% to 20% growth Y-o-Y. So I think we've almost done half of that growth in the first quarter.

items.statement: Wealth Management net inflows target INR6,000 crores minimum for FY27; Q1 saw INR2,000 crores
items.quote: we are targeting about INR6,000-odd crores at the minimum.

items.statement: Corporate Advisory pipeline of DRHP-filed IPOs at INR220,000 crores (incl. NSE & Jio); ex-large deals INR150,000 crores
items.quote: pipeline of transactions is extremely strong with almost INR220,000 crores of pipeline of DRHP filed IPO transactions.

items.statement: ARC distressed credit targeting 16-18% average IRR on new book; wholesale 18-22%, retail 15-18%
items.quote: on the new book, which is roughly almost half of the book, INR1,600 crores, we should be expecting close to 16% to 18% average sort of IRR.

items.statement: July Corporate Advisory revenues already exceed June, signaling recovery in primary markets
items.quote: The month of July, our revenues on the transaction side in Corporate Advisory and Capital Markets for the month of July already exceed what we have done in June

items.statement: Wealth recurring AUM grew to INR33,400 crores, now 30% of total AUM; loan book up 43% Y-o-Y to INR2,417 crores
items.quote: recurring AUM of our wealth business grew to approximately INR33,400 crores. The proportion of recurring to total AUM has now increased to 30%.

items.statement: Mutual fund non-liquid AUM up 16% Q-o-Q to INR10,900 crores; SIP book decline being arrested with distributor engagement
items.quote: closing AUM from non-liquid funds showed signs of recovery and stood at approximately INR10,900 crores, up 16% on a quarter-on-quarter basis.

items.statement: Wealth Management employee costs peaked; hiring now selective; productivity focus to drive margin expansion
items.quote: They would have peaked now. And we will not stop hiring, but we will hire judiciously and selectively where there are gaps

items.statement: Management aspires to grow at about 20% in FY27 and FY28, but cautions against specific quarterly guidance due to inherent business lumpiness.
items.quote: I think we've always aspired to grow at about 20%, and we expect that FY 27& FY28 also we expect to grow that way.

items.statement: Approved capital investments of ~INR 203 crores in Q1 FY27, primarily for capacity expansion at Unit 1; total approved capex over last 13 quarters is INR 1,460 crores with INR 870 crores spent to date.
items.quote: During the quarter, we also approved capital investments of approximately INR203 crores, of which INR196 crores is earmarked for strategic growth initiatives, largely related to capacity expansion at our Unit 1.

items.statement: Future capex will be quantitatively higher and qualitatively different, targeting newer complex modalities and potential geographic diversification via M&A or overseas investments.
items.quote: So you will see quantitatively more investments, and you will also see a qualitative move towards newer modalities because that's where we believe we have been successful, and that's where we would like to play.

items.statement: EBITDA margin was 35.5% in Q1 FY27; management maintains long-term guidance of 25%+ EBITDA margin, viewing higher levels as a bonus subject to mix and forex.
items.quote: I think in terms of our plans, in terms of our long term, 25% plus is what we would be coming for. And anything that's above that is kind of a bonus.

items.statement: Order book from pipeline molecules is encouraging and will pan out over next few quarters; customer engagement deepening toward broader capability-led, long-term strategic partnerships.
items.quote: The order book from pipeline molecules is quite encouraging, and we will see that panning out over the course of the next few quarters.

items.statement: Peptide manufacturing plant to be commissioned next month with manufacturing qualification; multiple projects lined up for Module 1 utilization; facility located within FDA-approved site.
items.quote: The plant itself is going to be commissioned next month, and then it will be ready for manufacturing qualification will be done by then. We have multiple projects lined up at various stages.

items.statement: Strategic collaboration with Gland Pharma for sterile API manufacturing (niche generics), leveraging complementary strengths in complex API development and sterile fill-finish; asset-light, long-term partnership.
items.quote: We believe this partnership creates differentiated platform in sterile APIs by combining complementary strengths of both organizations.

items.statement: FY27 revenue guidance of Rs 240-250 crore confirmed based on Q1 run rate of Rs 61 crore
items.quote: Yes, Rs. 250 crores is possible. 240-250 is possible because we have done around Rs. 61 crores now. And I think this trend in the Q2 also gives me confidence. Similar level of achievement is possible going forward.

items.statement: FY28 revenue target of Rs 300-350 crore including potential acquisition
items.quote: Probably at least a Rs. 300-350 crore should be our target for the FY '28 along with an acquisition.

items.statement: PAT margin target of 15-16% for FY27, could improve if Beryl contributes
items.quote: I will be glad to maintain this at 15%, but it can move up once Beryl starts contributing a little bit. So, for the time being, we can keep 15%-16% PAT margin as a target.

items.statement: Civil work on hand at $4.5 million vs $3.7 million last year; MES work on hand flat at $1.15 million
items.quote: MES work on hand is just like last year, it is about 1.15 million. Whereas the civil work on hand is 4.4 million as against 2.7 million last year. So, civil continues to have strong traction on demand.

items.statement: Power distribution for data centers driving demand; $5-10 million annual opportunity identified, currently at $2 million
items.quote: I wouldn't call this line a $100 million opportunity. It will still be $5 million to $10 million per annum opportunity but with a good profit margin.

items.statement: New MSA with top US power distribution company: $1 million annual revenue starting August, team growing from 10 to 20 people by Oct-Nov
items.quote: At this stage, for the next 12 months, that is starting let's say from August, it can be a million dollar per annum activity with very good margins.

items.statement: Automation and incentive system driving productivity gains; employee cost reduction from MES downsizing (125 to 50 people) and software cost cuts
items.quote: But more than that, the real contributor is high automation what we brought in our operations and an incentive system which is driving the people towards higher productivity is visible in the last at least 3 to 5 months.

items.statement: Beryl expanding to Georgia; Master Purchase Order of $1 million from Hillsborough County received last month
items.quote: One good thing in the case of Beryl that happened recently is that they received a $1 million work Master Purchase order from the county which is going to help them to have a steady flow of work from the county.

items.statement: FX gain of Rs 1-1.2 crore in Q1 due to rupee strengthening
items.quote: It is about a crore. Rs. 1-1.2 crores

items.statement: Management expects revenue to reach INR 1,800-2,000 crore in FY27, exceeding prior INR 1,800 crore target.
items.quote: See, absolutely. And it will be achieved. Not even INR 1,800 crores. We can go up to INR 2,000 crores also. It's a matter of some time now.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin was 12.59%; management expects similar margins to sustain for the full year due to low-cost inventory.
items.quote: The EBITDA basically oscillates between 8% to 12%. Sometimes 14% also. So, this quarter we have done 12.59%.

items.statement: Management expects current gross margin levels to sustain in future quarters supported by low-cost procurement.
items.quote: You can expect same levels of margins in the future.

items.statement: Company quotes FOB prices and passes actual ocean freight costs to buyers at shipment date to make CIF pricing.
items.quote: We are quoting only FOB these days and telling the buyers we will ship CIF, of course, because we have to secure our cargo also with the insurance. And the ocean freight will, the actual ocean freight as on that date will be added to the price to make it CIF.

items.statement: Demand for Basmati rice remains strong globally as an essential product, though logistics and war situation create uncertainty for Q2 volumes.
items.quote: It's an essential product. Demand is too much. And other question, we built up huge stock of low prices and starting from the commencement of season until mid-January, we bought a lot of rice.

items.statement: Export selling price reached INR 98/kg in Q1 FY27 (highest since Q1 FY23), domestic price at INR 64/kg; export mix at 91% of revenue.
items.quote: Yes, that's right. So, in Q1 of FY27, our domestic selling price is INR 64. But our export selling price is INR 98.

items.statement: New strategic customer Al-Muhaidib (Saudi Arabia) buying 2.5 lakh tons annually; first 500-ton shipment dispatched, more volumes expected if margins sustained.
items.quote: And because they have been buying from multiple people, but they got hits here and there. So, they have selected our company for, of course, part of their purchases. And they are a very big buyer. They are buying around two and a half lakh tons.

items.statement: Current packing capacity 500 tons/day, scalable to 800 tons/day; no major capex needed for revenue growth to INR 2,000 crore.
items.quote: Average we do about 500 tons of packing. We can go up to 800 tons per day of packing. So, in terms of infrastructure there is no problem.

items.statement: Red Sea/Hormuz disruptions have not impacted revenue or receivables; company diversified across US, Canada, Europe, Russia, Africa to mitigate geographic concentration risk.
items.quote: So, we are not dependent on the areas where Strait of Hormuz is affected, first of all. That is why you can see the revenue has not dropped. Neither the profitability has come down.

items.statement: Inventory includes 45-30% paddy, rest processed rice; procurement is just-in-time with ability to pack within 24 hours.
items.quote: 45% to 30% is paddy, rest is all rice. And if you ask for the capacity, capacity for milling is different and buying rice and packing it is altogether a different capacity.

items.statement: Monsoon conditions currently favorable for Basmati crop; early variety C9 arriving normally, farmer sowing expected to increase due to high prices.
items.quote: Up till now, I don't see any impact. It is more in the news. Early, I mean one of the Basmati varieties C9, which comes early in the month of July, it is coming normal. So, I don't see any effect as of now.

items.statement: Management expects Q2 FY27 to be strong, similar to Q1, though premature to give precise volume guidance due to logistics uncertainty.
items.quote: My closing comments are that despite so many challenges in this quarter I feel the revenue and the profitability remain all well. And you can expect the next quarter also to be the same. It will be strong now.

items.statement: Focus shifting to domestic sales growth (currently ~9% of revenue) to diversify from 91% export dependence; Maharani, Mithas, Begum, Anarkali key domestic brands.
items.quote: Domestic sales is very important now and particularly after this war and the disturbance happens in any part of the world. It was earlier in Ukraine. items.statement: Saudi buyer Al-Muhaidib demands high quality at low margins; management insists on reasonable profitability per container and will walk away if margins insufficient.
items.quote: We have told them if you really want to get good rice, you have to pay for that. We don't say give us very large but reasonable profitability has to be given. We have to meet our expenses.

items.statement: Large capital investment in peptide manufacturing capacity in India; block to complete commissioning by end of FY27
items.quote: On capex side, we are doing large capital investment in peptide manufacturing capacity in India, which will have capability of manufacturing from start to end in solid-phase synthesis and block will complete commissioning by end of FY27.

items.statement: 3 NCE programs in advanced phases will get commercialized in FY28
items.quote: On the CDMO side, we have 3 NCE programs in advanced phases, which will get commercialized in FY28.

items.statement: API business likely to have steady growth in FY27
items.quote: Overall, the API business is likely to have steady growth in FY27.

items.statement: Strong likelihood of robust growth in Formulation division given existing and new pipeline launches
items.quote: Overall, given existing and new pipeline launches, there is a strong likelihood of robust growth possibility in Formulation.

items.statement: Spent INR114 crores in Q1 FY27, primarily funded through internal accruals
items.quote: On the capex front, we have spent about INR114 crores in the first quarter, and the capex is primarily funded through our internal accruals and deployed across our different businesses.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 gross margin 71%, EBITDA margin 30%; expect margins to remain in similar range
items.quote: So there is consistent performance showing that we are in that particular range. At this stage, I wouldn't want to raise expectations too high. We would like to be conservative and overdeliver. So we would expect margins to remain in a similar range.

items.statement: Raw material prices have gone up due to global political situation, impacting gross margins; able to pass on partially to customers
items.quote: And just to give you some idea about the slight dip that we have seen in the gross profit margin, that also has to do with the recent political situation globally -- raw material prices have gone up, which ends up impacting margins, at least for the time being. So that has been one of the reasons for the slight dip you

items.statement: Formulation captive API sourcing more than 50%
items.quote: So in Formulation, the overall captive percentage, if I tell you, is more than 50%.

items.statement: Credit rating upgraded from A+ to AA-; certified as Great Place to Work
items.quote: Besides this, I'm also happy to announce that the company has been certified as a Great Place to Work, a recognition that reflects our culture, trust and commitment towards healthy work environment.

items.statement: Strategic investments portfolio revenue expected to reach INR750-800 crores by end of FY27
items.quote: For the whole year, for all the start-ups, like for this quarter, we did INR160 crores. By the end of the year, I think we will be ending up anywhere between INR750 crores to INR800 crores.

items.statement: International business expected to show significant growth in Q3 and Q4 FY27 after supply chain realignment
items.quote: Most likely, you will see a significant growth coming in from the third and the fourth quarter because we have got -- we have realigned our -- a lot of international business strategies have been realigned in the last 1, 2 quarters.

items.statement: Kesh King portfolio expected to deliver double-digit growth for full year FY27
items.quote: We are expecting a double-digit growth at the end of the year for Kesh King portfolio.

items.statement: Zandu OTC business expected to continue double-digit growth for remainder of FY27
items.quote: We are fairly hopeful that at the rest of the year also, we'll be able to continue double-digit growth for the OTC business.

items.statement: Input costs increased 360 bps in Q1 FY27 (200 bps from West Asia conflict, 160 bps from mix change); confident of offsetting via price hikes
items.quote: Our input cost, if you would see, has gone up by 360 basis points, okay? And out of which almost 200 basis points is due to the conflict, West Asia conflict and the balance 160 is because of the mix.

items.statement: Management committed to maintaining overall operating margins despite lower-margin start-ups growing faster
items.quote: Despite of all this, we are committed that our margins don't come down. That's a task that we have, and I'm confident that we will be able to maintain our margins.

items.statement: Strategic investments portfolio grew 61% like-to-like, now contributes 18% of domestic business
items.quote: On a like-to-like basis, this portfolio grew by an impressive 61%, which now contributes 18% of our domestic business, highlighting the increasing relevance of our new age growth engine.

items.statement: Measured price increases taken in Q1; further pricing actions being implemented to offset input cost inflation

items.statement: aiRA ARR at ~$2.5M run rate; 26 customers live, <10 paying; targeting 5-10% of revenue from aiRA in FY27; gross margins 80%+
items.quote: We are right now, I would say at like $2 million, $2.5 million in terms of revenue run rates on aiRA. I think my hope is that we'll try and get to probably at least 5% to 10% of our revenue coming from aiRA this year.

items.statement: SessionM acquisition net cost INR17 crores ($20M enterprise value adjusted for net debt); acquired $32M ARR; already profitable generating INR5-6 crores free cash in 2 months
items.value: INR17 crores net cost; $32M ARR acquired

items.statement: Full-year organic growth expected at 17% (incl. 6% currency benefit); Q1 organic growth 11% impacted by one large healthcare customer not growing
items.quote: So, overall through the year, we are looking at a 23% growth including a currency impact of about 6%. So, you will see about a 17%-odd full-year organic growth for the business.

items.statement: ESOP expense guided at INR12-15 crores for FY27 (1-2% of revenue); natural FX hedge with ~50% cash in USD
items.quote: Our ESOP expenses for this year would be about INR12 crores to INR15 crores, and you would see that our ESOP expenses will sort of remain in this range. We would typically like we look to maintain it between 1% to 2% of the top line.

items.statement: CustomerGlu (Experiences+) acquired for <$100K; acqui-hire/IP-led; enables no-code front-end loyalty experiences; rebranded as Experiences+
items.quote: Less than a few 100K, you know, not worth talking about, Chintan.

items.statement: FY27 guidance: 15% organic plus 1.5-2% inorganic revenue growth, about 17% total, and 20% PAT growth.
items.value: 15% organic, 1.5% to 2% inorganic, about 17% revenue growth, 20% PAT growth
items.quote: We continue to target 15% organic revenue growth and about 1.5% to 2% inorganic revenue growth resulted about 17% revenue growth and 20% PAT growth and we remain confident in our ability to achieve these objectives.

items.statement: Medium-term organic revenue growth guidance of 15%, beating IPM by 500 bps.
items.quote: we remain confident on maintaining our 15% organic revenue growth outlook or beating the IPM by 500 basis point.

items.statement: Endeavor to maintain margins in similar range; cautious on extrapolating current margin due to volatile costs.
items.quote: At this stage, it would be premature to comment on the sustainability of current levels, although our endeavor is to maintain margins within a similar range.

items.statement: Chronic and semi-chronic therapies now about 73.4% of total portfolio.
items.quote: We continue to significantly outperform the market in chronic and semi-chronic therapies, which now contributes around 73.4% of our total portfolio.

items.statement: IPM growth expected sustainable around 9-11% going forward.
items.quote: So, I think so now it is sustainable, according to me this industry growth will continue to grow in the tune of around 10%, 9% to 11% in between.

items.statement: In-house manufacturing 60% and outsourced 40%, to remain same in FY27.
items.quote: It is about 60-40, 60% in-house and 40% outsourced, and it will remain more or less 60-40 for FY27.

items.statement: Wokadine targeted to double from INR 20 crores to INR 40 crores over three years at 25% growth.
items.value: INR 20 crores to INR 40 crores, 25% growth
items.quote: We have add a 25% growth for coming three years down the line to make the brand double in coming three years of INR 20 crores to INR 40 crores.

items.statement: Hormonal facility asset turnover to be below 1 in FY27, rising to 2-3 over three years.
items.quote: So as far as, you know, turnover is turnover ratio is concern, it will be little than less one in FY27 and then gradually it will grow to two and two-three in, you know, next three years of time.

items.statement: International business to grow from 3% to higher single digit in three to four years; India to stay above 90%.
items.quote: But one thing is for sure that international business also grows from 3% to a higher single digit in three to four years, but then India business will continue to focus about 90% plus.

items.statement: FY28 revenue growth projected at 35-40% YoY with EBITDA margins 30%+
items.quote: So, historically we are growing in the range of around 35 % to 40%. So, we are projecting in around that range, because we have a at present also plant have enough capacity to ramp up and execute this level of the revenues.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth guided at 35-40% YoY despite Q1 61.5% growth
items.quote: See, our overall guidance pattern is on a year year -on-year. So, last year's our Chhap ara plant was step-by-step ramping up. items.quote: So, if you will see the overall capex, it's coming to around INR250 crores of capex. Out of INR250 crores of capex, around INR100 crores is for the building and INR150 crores is of the plant and machinery.

items.statement: Capacity to expand from 3.2M to 4.2-4.3M machine hours after new facilities operationalize
items.quote: And if we go for the overall capacity at the end of the executions of these two plants, then that will be around 42 lakhs to 43 lakhs of machine hour capacities which we are estimating.

items.statement: Order book ~INR3,000 crore as of July 31, 2026 including Weatherford order >USD100M
items.quote: Our strong order book as on July 31st was about INR3,000 crores. It includes, and you must be well aware of, the multi-year order received from Weatherford with a total order value exceeding USD100 million.

items.statement: Order book executable over 3-5 years (INR2,000 cr long-cycle) and 6-18 months (INR1,000 cr short-cycle)
items.quote: So, it's around this is a some two orders out of INR3,000 crores, there is a INR2,000 crores of two orders. So, that is having a timeline of around 4 to 5 years. So, in the range of 3 to 5 years based on some product category. But apart from that, then one there is a INR1,000 crores, which are having mix of the short c
