We observe similar trends in other major Western markets as well like European Union and UK. If I talk of now, the retailers and the brands in US are feeling better, because they are getting back

items.statement: Logistics disruptions persist: container shortages, shipping capacity constraints, Bab-el-Mandeb and Strait of Hormuz chokepoints pressuring freight costs and timelines
items.quote: even before the peak shipping season, we are seeing a shortage of containers and the shipping lines capacity shortages resulting in delays and high spot prices of freight. On other hand, the Bab-el-Mandeb is back in news as it affects one of the choke points of critical shipping lanes. This will also continue to put an

items.statement: India labor challenges in Q1: harvest season, school holidays, West Bengal elections caused absenteeism; Haryana and Noida minimum wage hikes of 38% and 21% impacting cost structure
items.quote: we did face the challenge of worker availability during the Q1, majorly because of being a harvest season, school holidays, and this time also we had the West Bengal elections, we saw a lot of labors going missing or absent. Haryana and Noida both raised the minimum wage significantly, 38% and 21% respectively, which c

items.statement: Bangladesh expansion adding 6-7 million pieces capacity with sustainable laundry operational by September; group installed capacity to reach ~108 million pieces
items.quote: Our ongoing capacity expansion projects in Bangladesh along with the sustainable laundry operations that we are starting in September and we should be becoming operational and execute orders in the second half of this year. These projects expected to give us almost about 6 to 7 million pieces of additional capacity in

items.statement: Management targets 10x revenue growth over the next decade, implying ~20% CAGR.
items.quote: We are seeing 10x growth in 10 years, which turns out to be about 20% a year is what we are looking at.

items.statement: Booked orders worth Rs. 120+ crore in Q1 FY27 including new wins and multiyear renewals.
items.quote: During the quarter, ADSL has booked orders for Rs. 120-plus crore towards new wins as well as renewals for multiyear contracts.

items.statement: Entered Enterprise Application Services in US with ServiceNow/Jitterbit/Boomi engagement; expanding AI-enabled offerings across portfolio.
items.quote: Won an Enterprise Application Services engagement with a leading NYSE-listed electronics design and testing solutions company to provide application maintenance and support to core enterprise platforms, including ServiceNow, Jitterbit and Boomi.

items.statement: Investing in leadership hiring, mid-level talent, and AI technology to make service portfolio AI-ready.
items.quote: We have done a lot of investments with respect to hiring new people, getting the leadership in place, getting the mid-level leadership in place. So, one side, we are investing. We are investing on people. We are investing on technology where we are doing a lot of investments on AI to make sure that our service portfoli

items.statement: Trailing 12-month revenue crossed Rs. 1,000 crore milestone (Rs. 1,009 crore); audit report now unmodified with no qualifications.
items.quote: Our trailing 12 months revenue have now crossed the Rs. 1,000 crore mark, reaching to Rs. 1,009 crore.

items.statement: Targets INR1,000 crores D2C revenue by FY29 with at least 15% operating margin from that segment
items.quote: We remain committed to achieving INR1,000 crores of direct-to-consumer revenue by FY29 with an operating margin of at least 15% from this segment.

items.statement: Expects bottom line growth greater than 30% for FY27 despite muted revenue growth due to exiting unprofitable lines
items.quote: Our expectation is to -- that bottom line should grow more than 30% for the year. Revenue growth may be muted because as stated earlier, we are exiting certain unprofitable lines of businesses.

items.statement: Plans to add 4 Jean Dousset retail stores in FY27, reaching 7 total stores by year-end
items.quote: During FY27, we intend to add 4 more locations. We believe this measured retail expansion will deepen Jean Dousset's presence across important luxury markets in the U.S.

items.statement: Jean Dousset store payback period less than 1 year, profitable from month 2-3
items.quote: Currently, based on the unit economics, we see a payback of less than 1 year for the JD stores. So very optimistic. And obviously, we're watching the numbers very carefully as we ramp up the store rollout of Jean Dousset meaningfully. But currently, as we see it, based on limited data set, usually the store is profitab

items.statement: Working capital days reduced to 220 from 253 in Q1 FY26, a 33-day improvement
items.quote: Our working capital efficiency improved meaningfully during the quarter with working capital days reducing to 220 days from 253 days in Q1 FY26, representing an improvement of 33 days year-on-year.

items.statement: Targets working capital improvement of INR250 crores and operating cash flow over INR300 crores in FY27
items.quote: The initiatives currently underway are expected to deliver working capital improvements of approximately INR250 crores in the current financial year and generate cash flow from operations of more than INR300 crores during the year.

items.statement: Rationalized licensed portfolio to focus primarily on Disney; exited NFL, Netflix, Harry Potter licenses
items.quote: We are no longer sort of pursuing NFL and Netflix and Harry Potter, and all those licenses. It's going to be primarily focused around the House of Disney and their brands.

items.statement: Owned brand focus narrowed to 3 power brands: Jean Dousset, WithClarity, and Disney (licensed); Jewelili and Everyday Elegance are smaller
items.quote: The 3 brands that will be most meaningful will be Jean Dousset, WithClarity and in the licensing segment, Disney. And these and the renewed strategic focus on these brands will allow us to expand profitability and grow profitability going forward.

items.statement: Tariff refund applications in process; expects to share refunds with customers; no numbers available yet
items.quote: We are in the process of applying for tariff refunds and we do expect to get some refunds for tariffs. I think we will have to obviously share some of those refunds with our customers as well. So we will -- I think we should know more in the coming quarter.

items.statement: Aspires to be a $2 billion revenue enterprise by FY30, close to INR16,600 crores.
items.quote: So you recall that we announced our aspiration to be a $2 billion revenue enterprise by FY30. But we are not going a year-wise breakup. So by FY30, we should be close to INR16,600 crores company.

items.statement: Aims for higher double-digit EBITDA margin and continued improvement from here.
items.quote: And on the margin front, definitely, we would like to earn a higher double-digit EBITDA margin.

items.statement: Data center genset supply revenue to be recognized this financial year; O&M contract for 5-6 years.
items.quote: So I think for genset supply, the revenue recognition will happen in this financial year. And for the O&M contract, this will continue for at least 5 to 6 years.

items.statement: NPCIL order revenue to start flowing this financial year, remaining in coming quarters/years.
items.quote: And some of the revenue will start flowing in this financial year and the remaining will come in coming quarters or coming years basically.

items.statement: Expects export logistics and inflation normalization in 3 to 6 months.
items.quote: But I would say 3 to 6 months is a fairly reasonable assumption.

items.statement: International business affected by Middle East conflict and delayed customer investments.
items.quote: The Middle East region is an important export market for us, and it continued to operate below normal levels, impacting both business mix and operating leverage during the quarter.

items.statement: Domestic demand strong across power gen, industrial, distribution and aftermarket.
items.quote: Our standalone revenue grew 16% year-on-year to INR1,461 crores, led by robust domestic demand across power generation, industrial and distribution and aftermarket businesses.

items.statement: Employee cost increase of INR31 crores (40% YoY) due to increments, ESOPs, capability additions.
items.quote: So our Q1 bridge indicates an increase of approximately INR31 crores, and you rightly mentioned that is a 40% increase.

items.statement: Company targets 8-10 new restaurants plus 10-15 Walters QSR stores in FY27, not 32 stores as speculated
items.quote: We continue to maintain 8 to 10 restaurants in a particular financial year, added with few Walters, which are a smaller format in QSR category.

items.statement: July was extremely good vs prior year; first 7-10 days of August also showing good trend for both dine-in and delivery
items.quote: July has been extremely good month compared to earlier July for us. And the trend for the first 7 days, 10 days into August has been good. So, we are seeing the tailwind which is available for both dine-in and delivery.

items.statement: Gross margin improved 1.2% to 71.1% in Q1 FY27 via portion control, vendor negotiations, and induction cooking adoption despite inflation
items.quote: Third, there have been improvement in gross margins by 1.2% to 71.1% from 69.9% previous year, primarily because of managing the portions, inefficiencies and continued negotiations with our vendors because of volumes.

items.statement: Price increases taken from June 7 to offset service charge withdrawal; tactical hikes used to neutralize raw material inflation
items.quote: We had taken some amount of price increase to neutralize that impact.

items.statement: Liquor sales 8-9% of revenue at food-led stores, 40% at Episode One; Gong at 38%, Siciliana at 25%; bars being added to all renovated Mainland China and Asia Kitchen stores
items.quote: We have 8% to 9% of our revenues on from our existing stores which are food-driven. And episode one is our wetland restaurant, where we have 40%.

items.statement: Joint development of Speciality Hotels India (Odisha land) to complete by FY27 end; company will hold 34% post-completion
items.quote: Joint development is progressing, and we would be able to complete the development by this financial year end itself.

items.statement: Brand portfolio restructuring to three verticals: Oriental (Gong, Mainland China, Asia Kitchen, Haka), Italian (Siciliana), QSR (Sweet Bengal, Walters Burger); older brands to be phased out
items.quote: Going forward, specialty restaurants to power the kind of numbers that we foresee is only going to be working on these three categories to power any form of growth.

items.statement: Same-store sales growth of 11.35% in Q1 FY27; Oriental segment (sub-50% of revenue) remains biggest growth contributor
items.quote: Second, the same-store sales growth has been at 11.35% precise during quarter one FY27 as compared to quarter one of FY26, with like-and-like stores operating during both the quarters.

items.statement: Sweet Bengal achieved 30-day shelf life via new technology and packaging, enabling national expansion; Kheer Kadam, Mishti Doi, Sandesh are hero products
items.quote: We have been able to crack a 30-day shelf life with our Sweets and the new modern technology and packaging that we've put in. And we will be in many new markets, hence visibility of our product and the revenue of our product will be grown from these new markets in the times to come.

items.statement: Walters Burger grew ~300% YoY in prior quarter with one new store; 5 new physical stores opening by end of FY27; currently 3 principal stores + 2 cloud kitchens (1.3% of quarterly revenue)
items.quote: From the previous quarter we have grown almost 300% -odd with the addition of one new store only. And also overall looking at the model the central kitchen facility, and also bringing our margins high and cost down.

name: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd

items.statement: Expect annual cash funding requirement of INR500-550 crores for next 2 years; business to be FCF positive by FY29-30
items.quote: We are confident that this cash is enough for us to fund the businesses for next 2 years, with annual cash funding requirement of INR500 crores to INR550 crores. And by FY 2029 and '30, we expect the business to be FCF positive.

items.statement: Expect losses to reduce annually; FY27 lower losses, FY28 even lower, portfolio fully profitable by FY29
items.quote: On an annual basis we will have lower losses this year, and '28 will probably be even lower losses. We had indicated that '29 is the year when portfolio will become fully profitable, and that's really the trajectory that we are on.

items.statement: EBITDA margin 8.2% in Q1 FY27; decline due to lower treasury income and investment in newer businesses; ex-treasury EBITDA increased Y-o-Y
items.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR167 crores with a margin of 8.2%. The Y-o-Y decline largely reflects lower treasury income, along with continued investment in scaling our newer businesses.

items.statement: TCNS LTL only 2% in Q1 due to inventory liquidation base effects; expect turnaround from festive season onward; scaling only profitable quality growth
items.quote: We are past that. We are behind that phase, and we expect that from this season onwards, which is festive period this year onward, we'll start to turn the business around.

items.statement: Standalone cash ~INR1,000 crores at Q1 end; expect ~INR500 crores by FY27 end; TMRW separately raised INR500 crores
items.quote: I said that when I started the year with roughly INR1,150 crores, INR1,200 crores cash, now I have INR1,000 crores approximately. By year-end, I will have around INR500 crores.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 started very well after supply disruptions settled by end of Q1; management optimistic about current trajectory
items.quote: Moving ahead, as I said earlier, Q2 has started very well, and we are continuing to witness, now that many of the volatility conditions have settled down, if not subsided.

items.statement: Solar rooftop order book remains at Rs 500 crore, with Rs 450 crore expected to execute over 6-8 months; B2C orders also starting
items.quote: Frankly, as you are aware, out of that Rs. 500 crores, Rs. 450 crores is an order book that we expect to execute over the 6 to 8 months. So, I'd say that this has been a year in which we really ramped up our execution capability.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin expanded 20 bps YoY to 10% in Q1 FY27; ECD EBIT margin up 20 bps to 13.5%; Lighting EBIT margin at 12%; Butterfly EBIT margin at 4.2%
items.quote: Despite adverse and volatile market conditions, at a consolidated level, revenue grew 11.8% YoY to Rs. 2,235 crores, EBITDA was Rs. 224 crores, it grew 14.2% YoY with margins expanding by 20 bps, reaching 10%.

items.statement: Pricing interventions of high-single to low-double digits covered ~80% of inflationary pressures; no significant further hikes seen necessary currently
items.quote: Across segments, as I've already said, we have taken pricing interventions. These range from high-single digits to low-double digits. These have covered approximately 80% of the inflationary pressures that we faced.

items.statement: BLDC fan portfolio grew ~45% YoY with 5 new launches; water heaters now volume leader in General Trade; Butterfly core categories (mixer grinders, pressure cookers, glass tops) gained market share
items.quote: Our BLDC portfolio grew ~45% this quarter, resulting from the focused portfolio interventions that we have made in the last four quarters. During this quarter, we launched five new BLDC fans, further strengthening our portfolio.

items.statement: Supply disruptions caused ~Rs 200 crore primary sales loss in Q1, largely in fans/ECD and lighting; issues resolved by June-end; channel inventory not a concern
items.quote: I would say that, because of supply disruptions, we did lose some sales, order of magnitude ~ Rs. 200 crores, maybe a little bit more.

items.statement: Brand transformation progressing; first visible outcomes by end of August; brand launch event on Aug 18 and investor event on Aug 20
items.quote: I'm happy to share that by the end of this month, you will see the first visible outcomes of this work stream. We believe these efforts will set the tone for Crompton's next phase of brand journey.

items.statement: Doubling cheese production capacity from 60 to 120 metric tons per day over next 1.5 years, by March 2028.
items.quote: So we are increasing our cheese capacity to double it from 60 metric tons per day to 120 metric tons per day.

items.statement: New age business (Pride of Cows, Avvatar) grew 59% YoY, now 13% of revenue vs 9% last year.
items.quote: The new age business, that is Pride of Cows and Avvatar, grew by 59% year-on-year in this quarter and now contributes to around 13% of our overall revenue versus 9% in the Q1 last year.

items.statement: New age business margins are almost double the company's average, per management guidance.
items.quote: The margins are almost as high as double the company's average.

items.statement: Calibrated price increases taken in ghee and new age business to offset milk cost inflation.
items.quote: So even in quarter 1, we have, towards the fag end of the quarter 1, we have taken up prices again further in ghee. And we have revisited prices recently for even new age business as well.

items.statement: Milk prices stable at INR42/litre; slight increase possible due to monsoon and festive demand.
items.quote: I would say that milk prices are almost on the stable platform. Maybe there will be very slight increase in coming months because of the onset of monsoon, because of seasonality milk production goes down a little bit because of the humidity and some other factors, environmental factors.

items.statement: Monsoon expected to bring milk flush; festive season to support value-added category demand.
items.quote: Milk availability should benefit from the progress of monsoon, and the festive period should provide a supportive demand environment for the value-added categories.

items.statement: B2C flagship categories grew high single digit to near double digit; aspiration is double-digit growth.
items.value: high single digit to double digit
items.quote: But on the guidance, I can definitely share that the B2C category in core categories has grown towards high single digit or close to double digit.

items.statement: B2B volumes ceded due to pricing pressure; management prioritizes profitability over volume.
items.quote: Though B2B, we have to maintain our profitability and all these things. So sometimes we forego some volumes from the few customers, which are negotiating very hard and we don't go to that kind of pricing to maintain our profitability.

items.statement: Whey protein demand-supply gap seen as structural, not temporary, globally.
items.quote: So I would say it's not a temporary, it will be a, kind of, a futuristic, kind of, demand-supply gap in our protein segment.

items.statement: Avvatar distribution: 75% from quick-commerce, e-commerce and own website; 25% traditional retail.
items.quote: Our revenues from quick-com, e-com and our website is 75% and 25% is coming from the traditional retail or specialized protein outlets.

items.statement: Distribution expansion target: 1.5 million outlets in next 3 years.
items.quote: And we've given a guideline saying that in the next 3 years, we want to be available in more than 1.5 million outlets, and we are reaching towards that and we are working towards that road map.

items.statement: Maharashtra FDA ban on analogue paneer seen as positive for company's 100% milk-fat paneer.
items.quote: So in that case, it's good for us to at least provide the good quality paneer to the consumer because then the bad quality is banned. So basically, this is good for us.

items.statement: Other income fluctuates due to annual biological asset fair valuation and one-off asset sales.
items.quote: One is the fair valuation on the biological assets, which is an exercise which we do on an annual basis and based on the change in number of cows.

items.statement: Targeting EBITDA margin improvement over next 2-3 quarters from current ~8% level
items.quote: With Q1 FY'27 at around 8%, we are further targeting to improve EBITDA over the next two to three quarters.

items.statement: Expect debt reduction of Rs 25-30 crores by end of FY27
items.quote: I think by the end of this financial year, our debt should reduce by almost Rs. 25 crores to Rs. 30 crores.

items.statement: MP plant construction to start post-monsoon, targeting commercial production in FY28
items.quote: And we begin to, we target to start commercial production at that plant in FY'28.

items.statement: AAC wall panels expected to achieve 30-35% EBITDA margin as utilization improves
items.quote: So, AAC panels will have almost 30%, 35% EBITDA margin possibility as the utilization levels keep on improving.

items.statement: Already implemented price hikes in some markets, planning further increases across other markets
items.quote: Over the last one or two quarters, we have already done some price hikes and passed on to the customers. And across other markets, we will be now looking at continuously increasing the prices.

items.statement: Q1 typically slowest quarter; Q3 and Q4 strongest due to seasonality
items.quote: Generally, if you would have seen our results, every year Q1 is generally the slowest quarter and Q3 and Q4 being the strongest quarters.

items.statement: AAC panels contributed ~5% of revenue in Q1 FY27; targeting higher contribution from panels and construction chemicals
items.quote: So, AAC panel had a sales contribution of approximately 5% in the total revenues of the company for Q1 FY'27.

items.statement: Coal costs increased 50-60% but hedged for monsoon period; expect normalization post-monsoon
items.quote: The cost for coal has grown up drastically by almost 50% to 60%. But since we had booked the coal in advance for the monsoon period for a period of almost three, three and a half months, we are quite, I mean, settled over there.

items.statement: Targeting 75%+ capacity utilization to unlock operating leverage and margin expansion
items.quote: As utilization improves to 75% and beyond, we expect operating leverage to strengthen further, resulting in better absorption of fixed costs and a meaningful improvement in our profitability.

items.statement: No plans to convert existing block-only plants to fungible capacity due to 2-5 month shutdown requirement
items.quote: Currently we do not have the option to modify our existing facilities to make them fungible for AAC panels because it would involve a shutdown period of almost two to three months, maybe up to four, five months to make it operational for AAC blocks as well as panels.

items.statement: Labor shortage issue resolved post-harvest/marriage season; automation reducing plant-level labor dependency
items.quote: Yes, sir. That is totally behind us. Generally, in every year post Holi, from mid-March up to mid-June or first, second week of July, there are labor shortages because of, you know, the harvesting season as well as the marriage season, in the small towns, rural villages, etc. But yes, today we are totally sorted with l

items.statement: Fly ash prices up 5-10% over 6-12 months, driven mainly by diesel cost increase of 8-10%
items.quote: Over the past six to 12 months, I think there has been a normal increase, maybe between 5% to 10% in the fly-ash prices. But apart from that is majorly because of transportation cost and not because of the material cost. Since we have seen a hike in diesel prices to the tune of almost 8% to 10% over the last one quarte

items.statement: Solar meets ~52% of power needs; expanding rooftop solar to 3.3 MW and introducing electric forklifts for cost savings
items.quote: During the quarter, approximately 52% of our power requirement was met through solar energy.

items.statement: Executing 2 bullet train stations for Mumbai-Ahmedabad route; in talks for more stations and data center projects
items.quote: We are also executing the upcoming bullet train stations on the Mumbai-Ahmedabad route. And are in the process of executing work orders for two bullet train stations and are in talks for a few more with the AAC wall panels.

items.statement: FY27 operating revenue growth target of 10%-15%
items.quote: Firstly, we are looking to grow Operating revenues by 10%-15% for the year.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin guidance band of 17%-19%
items.quote: Secondly, we are giving an EBITDA margin band guidance of 17%-19%.

items.statement: Content licensing revenue target exceeding Rs400m and client growth from 5 to 10
items.quote: Fifth, We are looking to target revenues in excess of Rs400m in the Content Licensing opportunities of our text, images, audio, videos and non-academic datasets and growing the number of clients from 5 to 10 this year.

items.statement: New printing and binding facility partially operational by Sep-Oct FY27, full completion next year
items.quote: Half of it will get done this year. The complete process will complete next year. So partially the binding and some printing will start moving from next week onwards. We'll start operation there probably in September and October, and the rest of it will go next year.

items.statement: Paper prices increased due to dollar at Rs95 vs Rs85 last year; pre-emptive purchase of 20-25% annual requirement
items.quote: the paper, the dollar prices, as you understand, has gone up around Rs95, and earlier it was around last year at the same time it was Rs85.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance factors in 10%-12% paper price increase; only 20-25% of annual paper purchased so far
items.quote: We factored in about 10% -12% price increase.

items.statement: Full adoption of new NCERT syllabus books expected in FY27
items.quote: We look forward to NCERT releasing the remaining books on the new syllabus over the course of the year. We expect the full adoption of the new syllabus books in FY27.

items.statement: Content licensing revenue Rs91m in Q1 FY27; FY26 full year Rs550-600m for Mylestone and Zen curricula
items.quote: We generated Rs91 million revenues from content licensing during the quarter.

items.statement: Geopolitical instability in Middle East hampering collections; expect normalization
items.quote: Geo-political instability in the Middle East continues to hamper our collections from the region. We expect this to normalize going ahead.

items.statement: Actively considering market buyback; decision expected by October after acquisition clarity
items.quote: we are considering a market buyback. I think we should be able to once these acquisition opportunities, really, fructify over the next 2 months. I think by October we should be in a space to decide on where we are on this.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 consolidated revenue Rs1,145m (up 12% YoY), improved gross margin, EBITDA loss Rs97m, PAT loss Rs187m
items.quote: we reported consolidated revenues of Rs1,145 million (up 12% YOY), Improved Gross Margin, EBITDA Loss of Rs97 million and a PAT Loss of Rs187 million.

items.statement: FY27 cement volume growth revised down to 8-9% from earlier 11-12%; clinker sales expected to stagnate or degrow 5-10%
items.quote: And on the overall year, I think we expect to probably revise the numbers. A bit from 11% to 12% to about 8% to 9%.

items.statement: FY27 capex planned at INR500 crore; FY28 similar at INR1,500 crore; total North expansion capex INR2,600-2,700 crore (INR2,900 crore with GST)
items.quote: This quarter, we have spent around INR93-odd crores. And our planning what we have given INR500 crores for this quarter this year, that will continue. That will still holding on the same.

items.statement: Fuel cost per ton rose to INR1.55 in Q1 from INR1.33 in Q4 FY26; expected to fall to INR1.45 in Q2 and further in H2
items.quote: We expect in Q2 onwards, the cost should come down to about INR1.45 -- and hopefully, in Q3 and Q4, we can hopefully reduce the cost further on fuel.

items.statement: Cement prices broadly stable in Northeast and outside markets (Bihar, West Bengal) in Q2; slight increase of INR2-3 in Northeast, INR10 in Bihar
items.quote: I think the prices are broadly stable in Northeast as well as in outside Northeast markets of Bihar and West Bengal, even in the quarter 2.

items.statement: Northeast demand muted in Q1-Q2 due to elections and floods; pent-up demand expected to drive higher growth in Q3-Q4
items.quote: I think that when the floods subside, which is basically quarter 3 and 4, I think there should be some pent-up demand which gets released in those 2 quarters in the second half of the year.

items.statement: Northeast industry growth estimated at 7% for FY27; Star Cement targeting 8-9% growth in Northeast for full year
items.quote: For the industry, I would say that the growth rate should be about 7%. For us, I hope that we can do about 8% to 9% in Northeast.

items.statement: Assam subsidy payout restructured over 12 years; FY27 subsidy estimate reduced from INR145 crore to INR115 crore; INR130 crore outstanding receivable
items.quote: So what I expect for this year is not about INR145 crores, but about INR115 crores.

items.statement: PP bag costs elevated due to international turmoil/war; difficult to predict trajectory
items.quote: The PP bag prices are completely related to the international turmoil and war situation, which is going on and thereafter prices are up. So that, I think, really is hard to predict of how will it play out.

items.statement: Building Solutions (AAC/RMC) revenue target of INR150 crore on ARR basis by Q4 FY27; currently below run-rate but expanding RMC plants
items.quote: At least on an ARR basis, we should be able to reach that 150 number by the quarter 4.

items.statement: Cost savings initiatives: Silchar railway siding by Oct-Nov, EVs on select routes in 5-6 months, Siliguri wagon tippler (INR150/ton savings), one-off donation/incentive savings of INR60-70 crore next quarter
items.quote: We expect about INR150 savings from the sales that we make from Siliguri after we do introduce wagon tippler there.

items.statement: FY27 revenue target of INR 8,100 crores; FY30 aspiration of INR 18,000-19,000 crores
items.quote: Our current FY27 revenue target of INR8,100 crores is meaningfully higher than the outlook we had communicated 9 months ago.

items.statement: Guidance revision planned post-Diwali after analyzing one more quarter
items.quote: We will revise our target after Diwali. We'll analyze one more quarter, and we will give our new guidance post Diwali.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 gross margin 9.3% (+27 bps QoQ); EBITDA margin 7.8%; PAT margin guidance 5.25% long-term
items.quote: Our consolidated gross margin increased to 9.3% in Q1 FY27 versus 9.1% in Q4 FY26, an improvement of 27 basis points.

items.statement: Advance Gold sales 17% (ahead of 15% FY27 target); non-22KT share 14% (from 10.5%); studded jewelry 2.1% (from 1.65%)
items.quote: We have achieved 17% sales on the Advance Gold model, significantly ahead of our expectation of 15% of the Advance Gold model for FY27.

items.statement: Capacity utilization ~60%; no major capex until post-2028; then INR 80-100 crores on leased model (12-15% of FY28 PAT)
items.quote: Currently, the capacity utilization is close to 55%- 57%. And looking at the current projection numbers, we are good till 2028. And post that, we may look at a new facility, but that we will continue on the leased model, and capex will not be very big. It will be close to INR80 crores to INR100 crores.

items.statement: Volume growth 7-9% in Q1; structural shift to lower karatage (18/14/9KT) and studded jewelry; unorganized-to-organized shift provides 4-5 year runway
items.quote: Overall, I can say that we have grown by 7% to 9% in the volumes in this quarter.

items.statement: International pipeline INR 30-45 crores from UK/Europe expo; targeting 3-4% sales from Europe; export mix rising (18% of revenue)
items.quote: The response was highly encouraging, resulting in strong initial interest and helping us to build a prospective order pipeline of approximately INR30 crores to INR45 crores across the U.K. and European markets.

items.statement: Operating cash flow turned positive ~INR 30 crores in Q1; net debt INR 540 crores; target net debt-free by 2030; promoter zero-salary model linked to dividends from operating cash flow
items.quote: During quarter, the company has generated approximately INR30 crores of operating cash flow, marking an important milestone in our journey towards building a stronger and more self-sufficient business model.

items.statement: CEO Akash Talesara appointed with targets: Advance Gold 15% (FY27), 20% (FY28), 25% (FY29), 30% (FY30); Europe expansion 3-5% from UK; new auditor MSKA & Associates (BDO India)
items.quote: We have given him the target for this year to be average of 15%, next year 20%, and the third year of 25%. In 2030, we will achieve 30% of the Advance Gold business.

items.statement: Target mid-teens revenue growth (17-19%) for FY27
items.quote: our full year projection continues that we are targeting to hit around mid-teens kind of growth

items.statement: Target 14% EBITDA margin by Q4 FY27
items.quote: our target still remains that by quarter 4 of this financial year, we get to our 14% EBITDA target

items.statement: Target 15-16% EBITDA margin by FY30
items.quote: by 2030 financial year, we want to hit EBITDA closer to 16%

items.statement: Target INR4,000 crores revenue by FY30
items.quote: we want to hit the next milestone of INR4,000 crores

items.statement: Current capacity supports INR3,400-3,500 crores revenue; FY27 capex ~INR200 crores plus spillover
items.quote: this year, our approximate investment should be -- other than the spillover of last year, this should be close to INR200 crores

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 13.1%, up 80bps YoY; gross margin 47.2% vs 45.6%
items.quote: EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 13.1%, an expansion of 80 basis points in Q1 FY26

items.statement: Price increases of 2-2.5% in consumer business; input inflation impact ~1.5% in Q1, higher in Q2
items.quote: Total price increase taken so is around 2%, 2.5% in the consumer business

items.statement: Domestic biscuit growth high-single digit; bakery growth 17.5% YoY; exports high-double digit
items.quote: Our Biscuit business reported a revenue of INR325 crores, registering a growth of 15.7% year-on-year

items.statement: Bakery mix improving; premium biscuits and Naturbaked (INR1 crore/month run-rate) driving premiumization
items.quote: Naturbaked has crossed a monthly revenue rate of INR1 crore

items.statement: West Asia conflict, commodity inflation, freight costs, minimum wage hike; Q2 inflation impact sharper
items.quote: the West Asia conflict has been an important contributor, though not the only one and the pressure reached us on 3 fronts

items.statement: Export orders month-to-month, no long order book; U.S. contribution doubled to 23-25%
items.quote: we are today touching close to 23%, 25% in U.S.

items.statement: Quick commerce grew 58% YoY; Kolkata bakery commissioned, Khopoli stabilizing, Bangalore site finalized
items.quote: Quick commerce continues to be of strategic significance for us and grew 58% year-on-year

items.statement: Full-year services revenue guidance trimmed to INR2,650-2,750 cr from INR2,700-2,800 cr due to cash supply squeeze; total revenue guided at INR2,750-2,850 cr
items.quote: We are setting our full year services revenue goal at INR2,650 crores to INR2,750 crores against the INR2,700 crores to INR2,800 crores earlier. The total revenue, including product revenue, is estimated accordingly at INR2,750 crores to INR2,850 crores.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance raised to ~27% from 25-26% guided in May, reflecting pricing discipline and tech-driven productivity
items.quote: Against this, we are raising our EBITDA margin guidance to about 27% from the 25% to 26% we had guided in May.

items.statement: Q1 EBITDA margin expanded 170 bps QoQ to 27.2%, driven by automation, pricing focus, and higher-margin Tech & Payments mix; management aims to maintain ~27% for FY27
items.quote: EBITDA came in at INR173 crores, up 8.9% on a year-on-year basis and 6.8% sequentially, with margin expanding 170 basis points quarter-on-quarter to 27.2%.

items.statement: Steep state minimum wage hikes (6-60%) and 8% fuel cost increase necessitate larger price increases; private bank discussions progressing, PSB repricing via IBA committee expected by end-Q2
items.quote: On the cost side, this year has seen very steep increases in state-level minimum wages, ranging from 6% to as much as 60% in certain key large states. Fuel costs are up 8% this year. Now this will all necessitate a larger price increase than average.

items.statement: Currency supply at ~70% of indents in Q1, recovered to ~80-85% currently; expected to normalize by end-Q2. Currency in circulation up 12% YoY, same-store retail volumes flat
items.quote: As of today, the currency fulfillment has recovered partially through Q2 to about 80% of indented volume. And in our plan, we now assume that this should improve gradually by the end of the quarter.

items.statement: Won INR500 cr orders in Q1, led by HDFC Bank mandate (6,000 ATMs, 5 years, INR400 cr TCV); now have long-term contracts with all 3 largest banks
items.quote: On the contract wins, we won INR500 crores of orders in Q1. The largest of these is the HDFC Bank mandate, which we announced in May, 6,000 ATMs over 5 years at a TCV of INR400 crores.

items.statement: Tech & Payments segment at 18% of services revenue in Q1, expected to cross 20% by Q4 FY27; growing 35-40% vs 11-14% for ATM/Retail platforms
items.quote: Technology and Payments segment, which was 7% of our services revenue in FY22, has grown to 16% in FY26, is 18% in this quarter, and we expect this to cross 20% contribution by the end of Q4.

items.statement: Persistent currency supply shortfall may lead to pruning of underperforming ATMs from BLA estate; EBIT impacted by INR18 cr revenue drop in BLA business
items.quote: If the currency supply and the transaction levels do not improve, we will prune the persistently underperforming ATMs out of our BLA estate.

items.statement: Completed share buyback of 49.39 lakh shares at INR340/share (INR168 cr) on June 19, 2026; ~INR400 cr cash on books; surplus capital to be returned via dividend/buyback after inorganic needs
items.quote: As you are aware, we completed a share buyback on June 19, 2026, for 49.39 lakh shares at INR340 per share, totaling to INR168 crores.

items.statement: Services revenue growth guided at 15-19% for FY27; ATM/Retail platforms 11-14%, Tech & Payments 35-40%; double-digit revenue and profit growth expected
items.quote: Combined, the services revenue growth should be in the 15% to 19% range.

items.statement: HAWKAI Enterprise proven at national scale in large PSU bank; bidding into strong pipeline for next 18-24 months; ALGO MVS deployed at SBI, going live at ICICI in Q3
items.quote: The demanding AI use cases developed there were tested and deployed over a national network, and this will be key for us in competing for a large pipeline of similar bids across banks in the next 2 years.

items.statement: FSS acquisition integration on track; synergy benefits expected from H2 FY27; INR20 cr revenue accrual in Q1 from FSS contracts being novated
items.quote: In Q1, I think it will be roughly close to a INR20 crores accrual from FSS.

items.statement: No plans to enter merchant acquiring/payment aggregator space; view it as highly competitive with established leadership and difficult to make money
items.quote: As of now, we don't have any plans to be in the merchant acquiring space. We find that space to be very competitive and very difficult to make any money.

items.statement: Express volume growth tracking toward mid-to-upper end of 20-30% range for the year.
items.quote: Broadly looking at where we are at the start of Q1 and the early part of Q2, we're towards the mid or upper side of the range that I spoke about, which is a 20-30% range.

items.statement: No major changes to FY27 or medium/long-term growth and profitability targets.
items.quote: We anticipate the overall environment to be more benign going forward and see no major changes to either our FY27 or medium or long-term growth and profitability targets.

items.statement: Delhivery Direct GMV to close FY27 higher than originally planned Rs.250 Cr.
items.quote: Our original plan was to reach a GMV of close to Rs. 250 Cr in FY27. As things stand, we are currently at a GMV ahead of plan at close to about Rs.150 Cr GMV and expect that we will close the year higher than originally planned.

items.statement: No significant difference anticipated to FY27 margins despite weak Q1.
items.quote: I don't think we will see a very significant difference to our margins. We don't anticipate a very significant difference to our margins, despite where Q1 has turned out to be.

items.statement: No structural change to margin trajectory for the year or beyond.
items.quote: So no, I don't anticipate any structural change to our margin trajectory for the year or beyond either.

items.statement: Full fuel inflation and pass-through impact to be evident in Q2 numbers.
items.quote: So, in any case, what will happen is the entire impact of fuel inflation and the passthroughs will be evident in the Q2 numbers.

items.statement: Minimum wage increases will be passed on to customers via price increases.
items.quote: We will pass that on in the form of price increases to customers down the line.

items.statement: Fuel contracts revised; coverage now upward of 97-98%.
items.quote: We are covered upward of 97, 98% at this point in time.

items.statement: Minimum wages have bigger margin impact as no contractual pass-through clause exists.
items.quote: Minimum wages, you would expect them to have a bigger impact also because there is no contractual pass-through clause for minimum wages.

items.statement: D2C volumes sustaining 40-45% year-on-year growth.
items.quote: The sustained growth in D2C volumes continues to be in that 40 to 45% range year-on-year.

items.statement: Demand strong in Q2; August volumes robust so far.
items.quote: Demand has continued to remain strong even in Q2.

items.statement: PTL yield improvement of 37 paisa, only 6 paisa from fuel inflation.
items.quote: But I think,, we have something like a 37 paisa improvement in yield, of which really only about 6 paisa is coming from the fuel inflation.

items.statement: Automation investments key to sustaining market share growth over next couple of years.
items.quote: As the external environment continues to remain challenging, especially from a labor availability standpoint, these automation investments we expect will be key to sustaining market share growth over the next couple of years.

items.statement: Labor shortages, elections, weather, geopolitical inflation and labour codes posed Q1 challenges.
items.quote: There have been chronic labor shortages across the industry throughout the period of April, May and June. We also had significant disruptions due to both elections as well as weather in this quarter, some of which - especially weather-related challenges - have continued a little bit into Q2.

items.statement: Express service EBITDA target 16-18%, confident of reaching higher end in H2 FY27.
items.quote: In Express, our target has been in that 16-18% service EBITDA range. We continue to maintain that and we remain confident that in the second half of this financial year, we will be in that range, in fact, closer to the higher end of that range.

items.statement: PTL internal objective to exit FY27 at 15-15.5% service EBITDA margin, up from 13.4% last year.
items.quote: We exited last financial year at 13.4%. This financial year, our internal objective will be to exit closer to 15-15.5% service EBITDA margins.

items.statement: Normalized margins would have been 30-35 Cr higher; fuel pass-through delayed to Q2.
items.quote: So normalised, it would have been at least probably about 30-35 Cr higher compared to where we ended up.

items.statement: No significant pricing pressure; yields expected to hold, with cost inflation passed through to customers.
items.quote: We will, at the bare minimum, it's safe to assume that yields will hold.

items.statement: If statutory wages rise, pricing must increase; negotiations ongoing with most customers.
items.quote: But yes, if statutory wages go up, and this is a discussion that we're having with customers, pricing has to go up in response to that.

items.statement: Volumes encouraging, possibly gaining share from in-house logistics; hopes for structural shift to outsourcing.
items.quote: At least so far, the volumes have been pretty encouraging. But let's see. I hope so. Let me put it that way.

items.statement: Yield decline from Q1FY26 to Q1FY27 due to lower heavy mix after Ecom Express acquisition; volumes up 55%.
items.quote: It is just fundamentally a proportion of the total volume, but we are also carrying 55% higher volumes in Q1FY27 as compared to Q1FY26.

items.statement: Delhivery Local ARR already 150 Cr in July, revising FY27 exit target upward from 250 Cr.
items.quote: We were expecting to exit the financial year at a 250 Cr ARR. But, here we are, we're sitting in August and we're already hitting, sorry, in July, and we're hitting a 150 Cr ARR.

items.statement: New initiatives investment earmarked up to 160-175 Cr for FY27, mostly Delhivery Local; on track.
items.quote: So in that sense, the amount that we had earmarked, up to about 160-175 Cr for the financial year, at least looking at current trajectory, we should be well within that.

items.statement: Wage inflation, labour codes, and climate challenges require mitigation; focus on network, technology, engineering.
items.quote: And either way, wage inflation is a reality.

items.statement: Quick commerce dark stores and last-mile delivery avoided; no network benefits, undifferentiated, margin pressure expected.
items.quote: So, we don't see any value in being in that part of the supply chain, it is an undifferentiated service, the ability to rent a two and a half thousand square foot shop, rack it up and stock, FMCG and count it while using somebody else's systems is essentially contract logistics by a different name.

items.statement: Supply chain services margin decline due to new contract ramp-up; no structural change, margins to scale in 45-60 days.
items.quote: And what typically tends to happen is about 45 to 60 days after the inventory starts rolling in is when you start moving to high potential, the full potential outbound volumes.

items.statement: E-commerce integration cost on statutory P&L closer to 30 Cr, including depreciation and rent, vs 17 Cr cash cost.
items.quote: So, on the stat P&L, this number is closer to 30 Cr.

items.statement: Ahmedabad city for Delhivery Local expected to break even in Q3 FY27; overall new services revenue run-rate tracking ahead of FY27 target of Rs 250 Cr
items.quote: the first city that we launched in Delhivery Local, for example, which was Ahmedabad, in fact, looks set to break even most likely at some point within quarter three

items.statement: New services contribution margin significantly ahead of plan in Q1 FY27; further improvement expected in Q2 and Q3 FY27
items.quote: contribution margin also actually significantly ahead of where we anticipated we would be in Q1 itself. And we continue to see some improvement in Q2 and anticipate that that will improve further in Q3

items.statement: Contractual manpower expense at Rs 371 Cr in Q1 FY27 (12.8% of revenue vs 12.2% YoY); wage hikes and increments impacting margins
items.quote: That number would be 371 Cr for this quarter, this first quarter of FY27

items.statement: Linehaul costs higher than 30% of revenue due to fuel, consumables, air movement and last-mile partner cost increases linked to oil prices and minimum wages
items.quote: the linehaul impact would be larger than 30%. Now, that's all just fuel, but linked to oil price, you also have the cost of consumables going up

items.statement: Freight architecture shifting: loads over 200 kg withdrawn into gateways from forward service stations; reduces average service center size and rental/supervisory/storage costs
items.quote: loads that weigh over 200 kgs have now been withdrawn wherever possible into gateways as opposed to being delivered from forward service stations

items.statement: Cross-sell business development team now fully active across 100 cities; generating volumes for express, PTL and cross-border businesses
items.quote: the cross-sales team is fully active now. And we're already seeing strong traction on cross-sales in terms of generating volumes for the express business, generating volumes for the PTL business

items.statement: Delhivery prioritizes full-time rider model with career progression (6-8% field staff become supervisors in 1-2 years) over gig multiplexing for better retention and service quality
items.quote: if you join us as a field executive, 6-8% of those people are going to make it to a supervisory level within, call it a year or a year and a half or two

items.statement: Management is skeptical demand will go higher rather than lower; sees no demand issues for next few years in Mumbai redevelopment
items.quote: The demand has never gone down in Bombay. So, demand in terms of demand, I'm very skeptical that it is going to go on a higher side rather than on a lower side.

items.statement: Sold 44,000 sq ft in Q1 FY27; inventory sell-through: Rashmi Square ~80%, Rashmi Signature ~65%, Rashmi Delight ~40%, Rashmi Manorath ~20-25%, Rashmi Icon and Avenue just started
items.quote: One number I want to specifically mention is the area sold, which in Q1 FY27, we have sold around 44,000 square feet.

items.statement: War-related material/labor cost spikes in April-May 2026 have subsided; Govind Dalvi project on hold due to government stay on 500m section; no other operational challenges
items.quote: The war thing which has now subsided, initially during the first quarter in April-May, there were few challenges, but now everything has subsided.

items.statement: Revenue recognition follows Ind AS percentage completion method; 6 ongoing, 5 upcoming, 14 completed projects
items.quote: Accounting standard we follow the Ind AS, wherein we follow the percentage project percentage completion method. And currently, we have six projects ongoing, furthermore five are in pipeline, and 14 we have completed.

items.statement: Brand building through timely delivery, word-of-mouth, digital presence, channel partner meets, sales lounges; management focuses on project completion over marketing
items.quote: Our major for customer confidence has been delivery of timely. That has been our core. So, we focus more on completing completion of the projects rather than making just the brand visibility.

items.statement: EBITDA margin target of 10-12% (INR16-17/kg) for FY27; Q1 achieved INR19.6/kg but may not be sustainable each quarter
items.quote: Our targets of INR16 to INR17, or in percentage you can say 10% to 12% of EBITDA margin, is something which we always aim

items.statement: FY27 committed capex of INR150-175 crores for HFFR capacity expansion to 20,000 tons, medium voltage cable capacity in East, Vapi consolidation, and BESS
items.quote: Overall, we expect the year's committed investment will be in the range of INR150 crores to INR175-odd crores

items.statement: Export order book is spot-based (10-20 days visibility); July good, August okay but uncertain due to geopolitical situation
items.quote: Today, if you see, our order books are generally spot, and it is not beyond 10 to 15 days or probably 20 days. So we can comment probably up to August only

items.statement: Cable industry growing 12-13% YoY; Ddev targets 15% volume growth via market share gains in medium/high voltage XLPE and exports
items.quote: In the category -- product category in which we are servicing to all the cable customers, they are growing at a rate of average 12% to 13% only

items.statement: XLPE drives growth (72% mix); Bhiwadi adds 48,000 tons XLPE; HFFR target 20,000 tons; engineering plastics niche (10-15% margin) but low volume
items.quote: You can understand that we have added the capacities for XLPE of 48,000 tons and almost 25,000 tons for PVC. So proportionately if you check, the XLPE will always drive the growth

items.statement: BESS Phase 1 capex INR150-200 crores + working capital INR100-150 crores funded from internal accruals; no substantial debt increase expected
items.quote: The amount of investment will be comparatively limited and will be within the range of INR150 crores to INR200 crores, both considering capex and working capital margin

items.statement: Topline ambition INR5,000 crores by FY30; India power capacity to double to 900 GW by FY32 with INR9 trillion transmission investment
items.quote: We remain firmly on track to achieve our top line ambition of INR5,000 crores by FY '30

items.statement: Zero rejections maintained; 50% Sioplas market share; ~33% XLPE market share; exports 16% CAGR FY22-26; cash conversion cycle normalizing to 55-60 days
items.quote: Importantly, this growth has been achieved while maintaining zero rejections, a robust balance sheet and a consistent record of sustainable value creation

items.statement: Expect EBITDA margins to recover to FY26 levels and surpass them before end of FY27
items.quote: We expect to recover to last year's EBITDA margin levels shortly and then hopefully surpass them. We remain confident of achieving this before the end of FY27.

items.statement: Higher blended grape cost impact to subside in Q4 FY27 and fully normalize from Q1 FY28
items.quote: As we have guided previously, the higher blended grape cost is expected to subside in Q4 FY27 and fully normalize from Q1 FY28 onwards, so the full impact will be felt in FY28 as the grape mix rebalances following harvest '27.

items.statement: Expect table grape prices to moderate to less than INR 20/kg in harvest 2027 vs INR 35/kg in harvest 2026
items.quote: We do expect that those grape prices would moderate to less than INR 20 a kilo this time. That's what we really have in our sights, which will definitely lead to a much better margin in terms of our Popular & Economy wines.

items.statement: Completed acquisition of former Chandon estate (Domain RASA) for INR 20 crores; winery ops to start Q4 FY27 harvest 2027
items.quote: A key highlight for the quarter was the completion of the acquisition of the former Chandon estate at an attractive price, as mentioned earlier, of INR 20 crores.

items.statement: Amphitheater expansion at Nashik completed July 2026; new bottle shop at Domaine Dindori opening next week; 5,000 sq ft events pavilion at Nashik on track for Q3 FY27 completion
items.quote: The amphitheater expansion at our flagship Nashik campus was completed in July. And we have our new bottle shop at Domaine Dindori, set to open next week, which is in line with our guidance. Additionally, the construction of our new 5,000 square foot events pavilion at our Nashik campus is on track for completion in Q3

items.statement: Received preliminary approval for 5 additional brand listings in CSD, taking total to 14 from current 9; expect listing process completion by Q3 FY27
items.quote: We have received preliminary approval for five additional brand listings in CSD, taking our total approved wines to 14 from the current 9 when those brands are launched in CSD. This is a very positive development, and we really hope to complete the listing process by Q3 FY27 and introduce the new wines in CSD before th

items.statement: Operating costs reduced 3% YoY in Q1 via organizational optimization and lower ESOP cost, partially offsetting margin pressure
items.quote: Employee benefit expenses reduced by 6% year -on-year, supported by organizational optimization initiatives and a lower ESOP cost. The actions resulted into 3% year -on-year reduction in the operating expenses, helping to partially offset the impact on EBITDA.

items.statement: Elite & Premium portfolio grew 6% in Q1, share expanded 310 bps to all-time high 78% of Own Brands
items.quote: The Elite & Premium portfolio, which is our focus, led the way, growing by 6% in Q1 with its share in Own Brands expanding by 310 basis points to an all-time high of 78%.

items.statement: Economy & Popular segment under pressure from unsustainable competitor discounting; consciously deprioritized to focus on Elite & Premium
items.quote: Coming to our Economy & Popular portfolio. This segment continued to face pressure during this quarter, owing to continued unsustainable discounts by competitors in the market. At the same time, we also consciously prioritized our Elite & Premium portfolio as we have been doing for the past couple of years now.

items.statement: Net debt declined to INR 319 crores (June '26) from INR 345 crores (June '25); expect net debt to continue trending lower by end FY27 vs FY26
items.quote: Our net debt at the end of June '26 stood at INR 319 crores against the INR 345 crores as on June '25. Looking ahead, we expect the net debt levels to continue trending lower by the end of FY27 compared to FY26.

items.statement: Annual new launch guidance of Rs 150 billion for FY27 maintained with launches planned in Q3 and Q4
items.quote: our overall guidance stays firm to come up with new launches worth Rs. 150 billion for this year

items.statement: Pre-sales target of Rs 100 billion for FY27 with Rs 20 billion achieved in Q1
items.quote: we stay confident of achieving about Rs. 100 billion of pre-sales for the current year

items.statement: Q1 average realization exceeded Rs 17,000/sq ft vs Rs 15,000/sq ft in FY26 driven by premium launches
items.quote: we achieved a per square foot realization in excess of Rs. 17,000 a foot. For the whole of last year, this number stood at a little above Rs. 15,000 odd a foot

items.statement: Land acquisition capex estimated at Rs 1,500-1,800 crore for FY27
items.quote: the number could be in the range of around Rs. 1,500-Rs. 1,800 odd crores for the year

items.statement: Cash balance of Rs 25 billion; net debt <Rs 3.9 billion; may increase modestly for business development
items.quote: We are sitting on cash and bank balances of close to Rs. 25 billion, our net debt position is close to less than Rs. 3.9 billion

items.statement: Targeting project completions >Rs 5,000 crore and revenue recognition ~Rs 5,000 crore in FY27; collections to ramp up with milestones
items.quote: We anticipate completing projects in excess of Rs. 5,000 odd crores and recognizing revenue of like Rs. 5,000 odd crores, about 50 odd billion INR

items.statement: Revenue growth guidance for FY27 maintained at 30-40% despite demand headwinds
items.quote: We are definitely waiting to maintain the 40% growth guidance and we are already on the track but unfortunate situation due to this war and everything, the demand was a bit on the downside. But yes, we will be maintaining. There is growth already. So, we will be maintaining 30 to 40% of growth this year.

items.statement: Oleo Chemicals revenue target of INR 65-70 crore for FY27 and INR 150-200 crore over 3 years
items.quote: So, from the first year that is the current financial year '27, we are expecting somewhere around INR65 cr. to INR70 cr. of revenue from OLEO. If we see a 3-year horizon, we are targeting somewhere around INR150 crores to INR200 crores of revenue from Oleo itself.

items.statement: Palghar expansion capex ~INR 71 crore, adds 60,000 TPA capacity, fully commissioned May 2026
items.quote: So, it is very much there in the financial. So, it is around –INR 67 crores in the Egypt and INR 71 crores in Palghar.

items.statement: Egypt facility expected to contribute INR 30-35 crore revenue in FY27 (last quarter)
items.quote: Initially we estimated around INR 50 crores to INR 60 crores from Egypt. Now, we are targeting around INR 30 crores to INR 35 crores.

items.statement: EBITDA margin target 13-15% and PAT margin target 11-12% going forward
items.quote: In our previous call, we have mentioned that we will expect a margin, EBITDA margin around 13% to 15% going forward.

items.statement: CPVC segment margins currently 18%, targeting 20-21% by Q4 FY27 as utilization improves
items.quote: So, right now, we are on 18%, we wish to be on 20%, 21% by the fourth quarter.

items.statement: Pipe demand picked up from August 2026, expecting good demand through December as PVC prices stabilize
items.quote: The demand has just picked up from August, and we see that from August until December, there's going to be a good demand for pipe sector because right now the PVC prices have been stabilized.

items.statement: Shift to higher-value lead-free and CPVC additives; CPVC started at low margins (3-7%) now at 17-18%
items.quote: We started with a very, very lower contribution margin of 3% to 5% to 7% just to start the business. And that is what has the product mix has changed the dynamics of that. But if you remove, say, for example, CPVC, okay, from our current turnover, you will see that the margins and the contribution margins in our calciu

items.statement: Freight cost spikes from shipping disruptions cannot be fully passed to customers, impacting margins temporarily
items.quote: In scenario like where the war scenario, the shipments are not coming on time, in this case, we are unable to pass on, like the sudden freight cost rise, the sudden CFS charges or sudden any transportation costs, we are unable to pass it on to the customer.

items.statement: Stearates capacity (6,000 TPA) at Palghar delayed to September/October 2026 from August
items.quote: This includes stearates capacity of 6,000 tonnes per annum, which is likely to commence commercial production in September/October 2026.

items.statement: 3-year revenue CAGR target ~35% with commensurate profitability from new capacities
items.quote: Over a period of three, we have already given the guidance that CAGR will be around 35% over a period of three years with commensurate profitability.

items.statement: IPO proceeds utilization: INR 15 crore in Q1 FY27, cumulative INR 165.9 crore, balance INR 45.9 crore as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: During Q1, ~ INR 15 crore of IPO proceeds were utilized, taking cumulative utilization to ~ INR 165.9 crore. The balance unutilized IPO proceeds stood at INR 45.9 crore as of 30 June, 2026.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 revenue INR315.7 cr, up 44.8% YoY; EBITDA INR36.3 cr at 11.5% margin; PAT INR26.1 cr at 8.27% margin
items.quote: For Q1 FY27, our consolidated revenue from operations stood at INR315.7 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 44.8% and increasing 10.3% sequentially over Q4 FY26.

items.statement: Expect higher sales in Q2 FY27; volume growth in mid-teens for current quarter
items.quote: We are continuing to witness strong demand in the current quarter as well and expect higher sales in the current quarter.

items.statement: Dahej greenfield project (40,000+ MTA) with INR100 cr investment, Phase 1 (15,000-17,000 MTA) targeting November 2026 commissioning
items.quote: With an investment of about INR100 crores, the estimated revenue potential will be INR900 crores. Phase 1 of the zinc oxide production is targeted for commissioning, as I mentioned, in Q3 FY27.

items.statement: Naidupeta brownfield expansion adding ~5,000 MTA, also targeting Q3 FY27 commissioning
items.quote: The brownfield expansion at our Naidupeta facility is also progressing well in parallel, and we expect to commission that also in the Q3 of the current financial year.

items.statement: Structural EBITDA margin range 10-12%; target 14-15% with higher value-added products and Dahej ramp-up
items.quote: Going forward, our target would be to get to an EBITDA margin level of about 14% to 15% with the higher share of value-added products that we are foraying into now.

items.statement: Dahej Phase 1 EBITDA margins expected at 11-12%; revenue potential INR300-400 cr
items.quote: Phase 1, as I just mentioned in the previous question, would be in the range of 15,000 to 17,000 tons per annum, and the revenue potential would be in the range of INR300 crores to INR400 crores, and the EBITDA margins that we expect to generate from that project would be in the 11% to 12% range.

items.statement: Tire industry demand robust: PV +26.6%, 2W +16.5%, CV +16.48%, 3W +11% YoY in Q1 FY27; ~INR25,000 cr capex announced by tire majors
items.quote: As per ATMA, the Q1 FY27 saw volume growth across major vehicle categories: passenger vehicles growing up to 26.6%, two-wheelers 16.5%, commercial vehicles 16.48%, and three-wheelers more than 11% year-on-year.

items.statement: Realizations at new normal due to higher commodity prices; zinc price neutral to EBITDA; cost optimization initiatives yielding sustainable margin improvement
items.quote: I think the new normal in terms of realizations because the prices of all commodities have increased. Zinc is also gone up in Q1, and I don't see any reason why commodity prices would go down in the near future.

items.statement: Geopolitical supply chain disruptions for zinc dross managed via scale, financial strength, supplier relationships; uninterrupted supply maintained
items.quote: Despite the ongoing global supply chain disruption, which has been quite severe over the last quarter because of the war, etcetera. However, JGC's scale, financial strength, and the long-standing supplier relationships have ensured that your company has had uninterrupted supply of raw material.

items.statement: Dubai subsidiary (BDJ Materials and Metal Trading FZCO) proposed for raw material sourcing and global distribution
items.quote: Recently, the company has also proposed to incorporate BDJ Materials and Metal Trading FZCO in Dubai, UAE, which upon incorporation will become a wholly owned subsidiary of BDJ Oxides Private Limited.

items.statement: Reaffirmed minimum 20% revenue growth for FY27 over FY26, targeting INR 1,800-1,900 crores full-year revenue
items.quote: For the full financial year, in terms of top line increase, we said we would be ending somewhere between INR 1,800 crores to 1,900 crores.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 8-9% for full FY27 with exit run rate close to double-digit
items.quote: As far as EBITDA margin is concerned, it's between full year average between 8% to 9% with an exit run rate close to double-digit.

items.statement: Sustainable EBITDA margin target of 11-11.5% expected by mid FY28-29
items.quote: The sustainable EBITDA margins which we are targeting is somewhere around 11% to 11.5%, that's what is sustainable EBITDA margins we are targeting.

items.statement: Rajkot main facility recommenced operations, production consolidated from Gondal, expected to lower power, fuel, transportation and operating costs
items.quote: The recommencement of the Rajkot main facility also marks the completion of an important phase in our operational recovery. With production now consolidated from Gondal to Rajkot, we expect further improvement in manufacturing efficiency through lower logistics, power, and operating costs.

items.statement: 5% raw material inflation in Q1, passed on 4.2% via price hikes and grammage reduction, 0.8% absorbed; further 0.2-0.3% pass-through planned in Q2
items.quote: Total inflation which hit us in terms of raw material, it was 5%, out of which 4.2% we have passed on to the consumers and 0.8% sit as an hit to our P&L in the current quarter.

items.statement: Insurance claim of INR 30-40 crores expected in Q2 FY27, documents submitted, process ongoing with PSU insurers
items.quote: We are expecting those things to fall in Q2. However, since this is coming from the insurance company, from the PSUs, but we are quite confident enough because whatever necessary documents were required already submitted to the insurance company.

items.statement: Distribution expansion: 1,000+ distributors, 38% outlets on biweekly servicing, targeting 6 lakh retail outlets by end FY27
items.quote: By end of this year, we'll definitely be present at 6 lakh outlets.

items.statement: Trade discounts reduced to 2.5% in Q1 from 3.5% previously; marketing spend at 1% of revenue in Q1, budgeted 2.2% annually
items.quote: Current quarter it is 2.5%.

items.statement: FY28 EBITDA margin target 10-11% with exit near 11%; PAT margin 7-7.5%; revenue CAGR minimum 20% sustained
items.quote: Similarly, next year, which would be next it would be FY27-28, somewhere around 10% to 11% with an exit to near to 11%. And in terms of PAT margin, it would be around 7% to 7.5%.

items.statement: Chana stocked till Q3 end, potato stocked, palm oil and laminate purchased at market prices with no meaningful near-term increase expected
items.quote: Chana we have stored almost till Q3 end, so there also there has been inflation, but that is not hitting our P&L. Potato we have stored it. Palm oil and laminate prices, we are continuously buy from the market, but we don't foresee any meaningful price increase over there in an immediate near future.

items.statement: E-commerce revenue INR 2.79 crores in Q1 FY27 vs INR 2 crores in Q4 FY26; Modern trade flat at INR 1.85 crores
items.quote: E-commerce, we did exactly INR 2 crores number in Q4 and we did INR 2.79 crores in Q1 of FY27. Modern trade is at par, it was INR 1.85 crores in Q4 FY26 and it remained flat.

items.statement: Management does not give quarterly brand marketing spend guidance but targets total customer inducement cost (brand, performance, discounts) around 4% of GTV over time
items.quote: we try to stay in the 4% of the GTV range, right, whenever we can. Now, there could be quarters where we go above this, and there could be quarters where we stick to this range.

items.statement: AI and hotel investments are front-loaded; tech costs as % of revenue expected to become more efficient year-on-year over the long term
items.quote: From a longer-term perspective, our objective remains for technology costs as a percentage of revenue to become more efficient year-on-year, although individual quarters may continue to reflect investments in new capabilities.

items.statement: Hotel business reached 0.5 million heads on beds in Q1 FY27 with 10,000+ direct hotel partnerships across ~700 towns
items.quote: During the 1st Quarter, we put half a million heads on beds across our hotel network. We now have direct partnerships with more than 10,000 hotels across nearly 700 towns

items.statement: Adjusted EBITDA declined 7% YoY to Rs 29.24 cr due to deliberate reinvestment of operating leverage from mature businesses into hotels and AI
items.quote: We are using the operating leverage that our core business is generating to invest in AI and hotels' growth. That's the way to read this quarter.

items.statement: Domestic flight ATV up 22% YoY, international ATV up 38% YoY driven by capacity cuts and oil price impact from Iran conflict
items.quote: Domestic average transaction values or fares on our platform increased 22% year-on-year and 13% sequentially. International average transaction values increased 38% year-on-year and nearly 30% sequentially.

items.statement: Flight passenger growth cautious near-term; Air India cut ~20% capacity, IndiGo ~10% in JAS quarter; meaningful capacity restoration expected only from festive period in Q3
items.quote: Airline commentary also suggests that meaningful capacity restoration may begin only when the festive period starts in the 3rd Quarter. Therefore, we remain cautious about aviation passenger growth in the near term

items.statement: Train OTA growth constrained by policy changes (Tatkal access, waitlist inventory, authentication); no immediate relief assumed but OTP-based auth discussions constructive
items.quote: We are not going to predict the timing of policy or platform changes that are outside our control. We are planning the business without assuming any immediate relief

items.statement: Bus GDP grew 39% YoY, exceeding 60% in 17 states; AbhiBus outpacing market due to deeper supply, local execution, product innovation
items.quote: Our year-on-year GDP growth came in at 39%, much higher than that of the market, and it even exceeded 60% in 17 of the states we operate in

items.statement: Geopolitical risk from Iran conflict affecting oil prices, airfares, and aviation capacity; on-and-off situation with no clear resolution timeline
items.quote: We remain hopeful that the Iran crisis will, at some point, be fully resolved. Of course, as we have seen, it continues to be an on-and-off situation.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin expected at 14-15%, inclining toward upper bracket after strong Q1
items.quote: Margins are expected to remain at similar levels, right? So we have always guided for a 14% to 15% margin. And obviously, quarter -- as we've always discussed, it's difficult to rate the business quarterly. But overall, at an annual level, we expect that the margins should remain in the 14% to 15%. And given Q1 has bee

items.statement: CDMO volume growth expected to remain double-digit for FY27
items.quote: While this could be a period where we have sizable volume growth, but we remain confident that our volume growth will at least be double digits in the coming quarters.

items.statement: API segment targeting monthly EBITDA positive by Feb-Mar 2027, profitable contribution in FY28
items.quote: Absolutely right, Abdul. So the whole target is on a monthly level, at least by the end of February, March, we should be monthly EBITDA positive in this business. And then next year, we should start positively contributing to the profit from this segment.

items.statement: Zambia order of ~$25M (~INR240 cr) expected in H2 FY27, similar in FY28; Europe to kickstart in FY28
items.quote: Zambia is something we expect in the H2 that we deliver for this fiscal, the $25 million, which will roughly translate to almost INR240-odd crores in our revenue. And similar in the next financial year as well. And within the next financial year, we will kickstart our European business as well.

items.statement: New oral manufacturing facility in Baddi to go live by end of FY27; capex amount still under discussion
items.quote: We are in the process of setting up one more facility in Baddi, which will go live in the -- almost at the end of this financial year itself, which will significantly boost our oral manufacturing capabilities, right?

items.statement: Q1 FY27 operating EBITDA margin 15% (+238 bps YoY, +187 bps QoQ); gross margin improvement driven by high-value products, not inventory gains
items.quote: Margins were robust at 15%, improving 238 basis points year-on-year. Quarter 1 FY26, we were at 12.6%, and 187 basis points quarter-on-quarter or Q4 FY26, we were at 13.1%.

items.statement: CDMO operates on cost-plus model; API price increases passed through at every purchase order
items.quote: So the model has always remained a cost plus, right? So it is at every purchase order or whatever is the prevailing price of the input materials that gets passed through.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 CDMO volumes tracking high-teens growth; API prices trending upward
items.quote: So Vivek, look at the volumes for Q2, right? So the volumes also look healthy in high teens, at least for this quarter as well. As the momentum continues, we can update how the rest of the year also goes. But whatever visibility we have today, Q2 also looks extremely encouraging. API prices, they are volatile, right? B

items.statement: API segment improving via shift to non-cepha products (linezolid, montelukast); gross COGS down from 90%+ to ~75%
items.quote: Our cepha business, we have been able to come out of the low-margin products and as well as increase our basket of non-cepha products, including linezolid, montelukast and so on, which are helping us improve our margins, right?

items.statement: Domestic branded (Akumentis) added ~200 field force (+15%) to expand into adjacent HQs; focus on gynae, cardio, paediatrics
items.quote: As mentioned in the initial note, we have added almost 200 people in our field force to tap adjacent headquarters, which are important where we can tap some growth, right? So the focus here remains how do we expand our presence into prescription business?

items.statement: International branded (Unosource) muted in Q1; growth expected from Q2/Q3 via focus markets and niche product filings
items.quote: On Unosource, again, while this quarter was muted, we see good growth orders in our coming quarters, right? So the strategy we are taking is twofold. One is while we say we are present in 60-plus geographies, which are our star focus, whatever you call them, these markets which we have to drill down, right?

items.statement: Acquired Oriflame India manufacturing (Roorkee, Noida) to expand skin care/cosmetics capacity and enter color cosmetics
items.quote: On 23rd of July, we announced the acquisition of Oriflame India's manufacturing business. The transaction covers two manufacturing facilities, one at Roorkee, Uttarakhand and other one at Noida, Uttar Pradesh, along with a leased warehouse situated at Noida, Uttar Pradesh. With the acquisition, we expand our manufactur

items.statement: Net cash INR1,616 cr (98% in FDs with nationalized banks); no debt; net worth >INR3,400 cr; will pursue value-accretive M&A
items.quote: Most of the money, in fact, 98% of the money is parked in fixed deposits with nationalized banks, right? And the money is safely with these banks. There was another question on inorganic. So our net worth sits at more than INR3,400 crores and there is no debt on the company.

items.statement: Domestic branded formulation price increases already taken, to reflect in coming quarters
items.quote: And as far as price growth is concerned, we have already taken price growth, and this will also be reflected as we move on this quarter.

items.statement: Expects gross margins to stay in current range over next quarter or two, improving as commodity prices ease.
items.quote: We expect margins to remain in this range over the next quarter or two and to improve further as commodity prices ease.

items.statement: Gross-margin target is around 30-32%, where management wants it to be.
items.quote: Our gross-margin target is around 30-32%, which is where we want it to be, and opex continues to improve structurally.

items.statement: Expects opex to decline into the ₹300-325 crore range over the next couple of quarters.
items.quote: Over the next couple of quarters, we expect opex to come down into the ₹300-325 crore range, which is where our target is.

items.statement: Intends to keep gross margins steady to slightly growing and volumes steady to slightly growing.
items.quote: While doing this, we intend to keep gross margins steady to slightly growing and volumes also steady to slightly growing.

items.statement: ASP should remain broadly around ₹1.25 lakh, plus or minus 5%.
items.quote: I do not want to give a product-mix forecast, but overall I would say ASP should remain broadly around 1.25L, plus or minus 5%.

items.statement: Capex beyond the Cell project will be around ₹30-50 crore; use ₹50 crore as target.
