items.quote: Pectin segment, commercial production already started as we informed. Audit also going on. And good part s that a few big brands in export big brands, they also shown a lot of interest and we have also sent samples.

items.statement: Kusum spices grew 14.7% YoY; focusing on Horeca and export (Oman); retail expansion slow but progressing; planning condiments/marinades
items.quote: Kusum spices grew by 14.7% year-on-year. What is your strategy to increase market share in the branded spice segment where large retail brands are currently active in acquisitions?

items.statement: CFO Anand Krishnan resigned effective Aug 11; search underway for replacement, announcement expected soon
items.quote: Yes. Last day was day before yesterday, 1 1th. Anand Krishnan has resigned about, I think, 60 days ago, which we already informed, and then he continued till our Board meeting.

items.statement: Promoter holding at 25%; open to increasing stake via open market acquisition or preferential issue if beneficial for company
items.quote: it's high time that some master planning happens and would definitely look at the opportunities to increase the promoters holding.

items.statement: Management expects minimum 35-40% revenue growth in FY27 vs FY26, with Q1 already up ~25% YoY.
items.quote: Minimum, minimum, I observe the rise of 35% to 40% minimum as per the last year, comparating to the last year.

items.statement: Order book of Rs 20 crore as of 31 July 2026, expected to convert into approved sales.
items.quote: We still have a 20 crore order as on 31st July 2026, expected to convert into approved sales.

items.statement: Planning Rs 20-25 crore capex for heavy hydraulic extrusion press and machinery to enable wider product range.
items.quote: CAPEX is the same measure told, 20-25 CR, including machines and, plant and machinery.

items.statement: Targeting capacity of >500 tons/month (6,000 tons/annum) post expansion, more than double current run-rate.
items.quote: We would be easily manufacturing about maybe it would be more than double 500 tons per, per month, so 6,000 tons per annum

items.statement: EBITDA margin sustainable around current 7-8% range (+/- 1-2%), driven by cost control and integrated operations.
items.quote: We are firm that it should vary by 1% or 2% plus minus, but it will continue, because we are in a very smooth working and, business

items.statement: Strong long-term demand outlook from EV, data centers, power infrastructure, defense, and import substitution.
items.quote: The increasing requirement for reliable electrical infrastructure, power equipment, transformers, switch gears, data centers, EV vehicles, and other electrical applications provides a favorable long-term environment for copper demand.

items.statement: No hedging; manages copper price volatility via short production cycle (6-7 tons/day), customer price pass-through, and inventory control.
items.quote: I am not so much into hedging and everything. We, I have a capacity of approx, see, 6 to 7 tons production daily. So, I keep buying. Whatever orders we get, we do the buying.

items.statement: Targeting 3-4x top-line growth and higher bottom-line growth in FY27 vs FY26
items.quote: this year we are targeting to grow at least 3 to 4 times than what we have done in last year in the top line growth as well as even more in the bottom-line growth

items.statement: Core Halol business expected to reach Rs 30+ crore per quarter in FY27
items.quote: I think this year, we will be able to easily cross about Rs. 30 plus crores per quarter

items.statement: Odisha epitaxy revenue targeted at Rs 12-15 crore in H2 FY27
items.quote: We are estimating and targeting revenue out of sale of epi wafers in the range of Rs. 12 crores to Rs. 15 crores for the second half of this year

items.statement: Total Odisha plant capex Rs 618 crore (Phase 1: Rs 225 crore, Phase 2: Rs 395-400 crore)
items.quote: the total expected CAPEX for the Orissa plant is Rs. 618 crores. For the first phase we expect the CAPEX to be around Rs. 225 crores. And for the second phase we expect the CAPEX to be around Rs. 395 crores-Rs. 400 crores

items.statement: FY27 Phase 1 capex budget Rs 100-120 crore; Phase 2 timeline under discussion
items.quote: we expect a CAPEX of around Rs. 100 crores to Rs. 120 odd crores for the phase 1. And for phase 2 we are still under discussion

items.statement: First overseas order received for 120 units of 125mm 5kV SCR thyristors
items.quote: following its first overseas order for 120 numbers of 125 mm 5 kV SCR thyristors

items.statement: Q1 EBITDA margin improvement driven by 80-85% raw material cost pass-through and procurement savings
items.quote: I can say almost about 80 %-85% passed it on to the customers. Maybe some old orders which we have accepted with the schedules which we were not able to. But all the new schedules are with the new prices

items.statement: Long-term sustainable EBITDA margin target 15-17%
items.quote: Our aim is to be always there on those numbers. So, I am sure we should be in a position to achieve those numbers

items.statement: Epi wafer EBITDA margin expected at 20-25%; SiC devices higher than epi
items.quote: we expect an EBITDA somewhere in the range of 20%-25% on sale of epi wafers

items.statement: Growth drivers: High Power Devices (HPD) in India, new products, equipment division; LPD at saturation
items.quote: The growth drivers will be HPD in India going forward and new products and equipment

items.statement: West Asia geopolitical issues making cost pass-through and value-add pricing difficult
items.quote: because of this West Asia disturbances, pushing the cost increase to the market itself is becoming a bit difficult

items.statement: Epi wafer customers include US/Taiwan fabs and Indian government labs; 6/8-inch for export, 4/6-inch domestic
items.quote: we have approached international customers in US as well as Taiwan. And we also have been approached by the Indian customers which are more or less government labs

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 10.5-11% despite Q1 commodity headwinds
items.quote: we are maintaining our full year guidance of 10.5% to 11% EBITDA

items.statement: FY27 capex guidance raised to INR 200-250 crore from INR 100-150 crore due to new order wins
items.quote: For FY 27, our capex guidance updated to INR 200 to 250 crore, mainly due to new order wins

items.statement: Major domestic project tenders (BPCL Andhra, IOCL Paradip Phase 2, ONGC petchem) in feasibility/approval stages; execution tenders expected late FY27 or early FY28.
items.quote: Andhra feasibility was on. They are now maybe anticipating towards the site development activities and all. So probably the execution tender would come towards the end of this financial year.

items.statement: Management reaffirmed strong double-digit revenue growth guidance for FY27, with India business growing mid-teens and outperforming market by 300-500 bps, international markets and US at single-digit growth.
items.quote: we continue to stay with the guidance that we will deliver strong double-digit growth for the year, starting with the first quarter. I think, our India business is poised to deliver significantly good traction, better than market, at least by 300 -500 basis points. So, we see mid -teens growth continuing for that busin

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 24%+ for FY27 despite increased Saro investment in H2 and acquisition-related cost increases.
items.quote: owing to that meaningful increase that we'll see in the second half, we are still guiding towards the 24% kind of margin.

items.statement: Full-year FY27 capex guided at ₹1,500-1,600 crores, driven by capacity expansions (SEZ 3, Moraiya, Goa, Baddi), new R&D center, wellness land acquisition, CAR-T facility, and vaccines DS facility.
items.quote: So, right now, we are guiding for around ₹1,500-₹1,600 crores capex.

items.statement: Branded portfolio share exceeded 55% of total revenue in Q1 FY27; medium-term target is over two-thirds of revenue from branded business.
items.quote: The share of our branded portfolio in the total revenues has steadily increased over the last several quarters. It accounted for over 55% of our total revenue in the first quarter of this year. As our branded business continues to gain scale across markets, we expect their share to exceed two-third of our overall reven

items.statement: India branded formulations grew 20% YoY in Q1 FY27, outperforming market across chronic, super-specialty, and acute segments; chronic portfolio share reached 54.2% (up 360 bps over 4 years).
items.quote: In India, our branded formulations business sustained market outperformance with a strong 20% year -on-year growth during the quarter. This business has, in fact, outperformed the market growth consistently over the last three financial years.

items.statement: Other expenses run rate guided at ₹1,900-2,000 crores per quarter (inclusive of Saro spend and acquisition impacts); 80% of QoQ cost increase driven by Zylidac, Assertio acquisitions and freight.
items.quote: So, our current run rate of about, you know, ₹1,900-₹2,000 crores, I think that kind of a run rate we should assume as a part of other expenses, excluding R&D on quarterly basis.

items.statement: US launches guided at 30-40 for FY27 including specialty launches; Mirabegron settlement amortization to end by Q1 FY28.
items.quote: Between 30 to 40 depending on multiple scenarios, but at least 30+ launches.

items.statement: Consumer Wellness revenue ₹14.3B (+67% YoY) in Q1 FY27; international (incl. Comfort Click) +25% like-to-like, domestic +5% (skin/hair +35%, food/nutrition +16%); seasonal brands degrew due to soft summer.
items.quote: Our Consumer Wellness business recorded revenues of ₹ 14.3 billion, up 67% year-on-year. Within this, the international business, including the Comfort Click portfolio, de livered a like -to-like growth of 25%, while the domestic business grew 5% year-on-year.

items.statement: Medium-term EBITDA margin target 28-30% as branded mix scales to two-thirds of revenue over ~5 years, despite near-term Saro and R&D investments.
items.quote: ideally, we would want to be improving our EBITDA margins to 28-30% range as we move closer to the 5-year period.

items.statement: Entered JV with Sunshine Healthcare to establish pharmaceutical manufacturing facility in Sri Lanka to strengthen local production and reduce import dependence.
items.quote: During the quarter, we entered into a joint venture agreement with Sunshine Healthcare to establish a pharmaceutical manufacturing facility in Sri Lanka to strengthen local production and reduce import dependence for the country.

items.statement: Full-year revenue growth guidance of 15-20% and EBITDA margin guidance of ~14% for FY27
items.quote: We look at overall revenue guidance of around 15% to 20%.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin at 13.5%; full-year margin expected to average ~14% after passing on raw material cost increases with a lag of a couple of quarters
items.quote: The margin guidance for the year is around 14%. You would see that the first quarter has been generally a quarter where there is cost increase around employee cost and so on. But for the full year, we believe that we should be averaging around 14-odd percent.

items.statement: Full-year capex guidance of ~INR100 crores for FY27, largely for Hosur capacity expansion for EV customers like TVS
items.quote: This year, we should target around INR100-odd crores. We did about INR110-odd crores last year. This year, again, it should be INR100 crores.

items.statement: Strong order book and pipeline across 2W and 4W; new supplies commenced for Ather Konarc, River RX02, Royal Enfield Flying Flea, and Hero Vida from Hosur
items.quote: With a strong order book and pipeline, we are well-positioned to deliver the next phase of growth.

items.statement: LED share in auto lighting revenue at 63% (value basis); expected to move towards 70% in next 24-30 months as new models shift to LED and EV penetration rises
items.quote: We think we must -- we should move towards 70% kind of a figure going forward in the next 24 to 30 months towards LED.

items.statement: Indian 2W industry hit record Q1 volume of 7.25M units (+22.8% YoY); EV share rose to >9% from ~6% a year ago; festive season starting strong
items.quote: Industry's volume reached to 7.25 million units, the highest ever for a first quarter. Growth was supported by GST rationalization, India retail financing and strong rural demand, while export and electric vehicles grew even faster.

items.statement: 4-wheeler revenue contribution remains ~2.5% (similar to last year); meaningful scale now expected from FY28 due to longer customer conversion cycles and development timelines
items.quote: We believe that 4-wheeler business will really start being meaningful over the next 2 years. This year as well, we believe that it should be around the similar level. But next year onwards, we should see some significant increase.

items.statement: Raw material cost increased ~80 bps in Q1; expected to be passed on to customers with a lag of a couple of quarters; employee cost up due to minimum wage hikes (35% in Haryana) and will remain at Q1 run-rate for rest of year
items.quote: There is this 80 basis points of raw material cost increase and overall increase, like you mentioned of 120. All of that, we should be able to hopefully pass on and recover over the next few quarters.

items.statement: Sole supplier for Ather's new Konarc model; supplying to River RX02 and Royal Enfield Flying Flea; wallet share with top 4 2W OEMs stable; developing LCM, hands-off detection, ambient lighting, projection lighting
items.quote: The project which is being launched, we will be the sole supplier for that model.

items.statement: Full-year FY27 capex guidance maintained at INR 300 crore including greenfield expansions for Mechatronics and IAC division
items.quote: The guidance for the full year continues to remain around INR 300 crore, which will include the upcoming greenfield expansions of Mechatronics as well as new plants of IAC division.

items.statement: Order book stands at INR 1,600 crore with 24% execution in FY27, 56% in FY28, 20% in FY29; Advanced Plastics largest contributor
items.quote: We are pleased to report a robust order book of INR 1,600 crore, which provides a healthy visibility for the business going forward. Of this order book, approximately 24% is expected to be executed in this FY 27 itself, 56% in FY 28, and the remaining 20% in FY 29.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded 190 bps to 15.1%; Advanced Plastics operates at 16-20% EBITDA margin; Greenfuel normalized margin 19-20%
items.quote: Q1 FY 27 revenue of INR 1,364 crore grew by 33% y-o-y, with EBITDA of INR 205 crore up 51% y-o-y with margins of 15.1%, an expansion of 190 bps.

items.statement: 80-90% of plastic raw material inflation passed through to OEMs within same quarter; electronics cost inflation limited impact due to low Mechatronics revenue share (6-7%)
items.quote: But plastics as a commodity, usually we have a back-to-back arrangement with most of our OEMs, and we do realize that within the same quarter as well. Only for few OEMs, maybe the spillover happens to the next quarter. But I would say to a great extent of 80% to 90%, we get the realization within the same quarter.

items.statement: Mechatronics division targets INR 400 crore revenue in FY27 and INR 1,000 crore by FY31; 5 new intelligent/connected products launching in 18-24 months; BCM already launched
items.quote: If you look at Mechatronics, I think for the full year, we should be clocking anywhere around INR 400 crore of revenue in this fiscal year as a division. I think, to me, by FY 2030-31, we should definitely be looking at close to INR 1,000 crore top line from Mechatronics division.

items.statement: Commodity inflation (plastics up 30-40%, electronics up 30-50%), geopolitical uncertainty, energy price volatility, OEM aggression in aftermarket pressuring margins
items.quote: While we remain watchful of the macroeconomic uncertainties, commodity inflation and the energy price volatility, the overall demand environment and industry outlook continues to be favorable, giving us confidence for the near term.

items.statement: Majority of INR 300 crore FY27 capex funded from internal accruals; 10-12% capex for specific JVs/subsidiaries funded via debt
items.quote: The majority of the capex, INR 300 crore, will continue to fund from the internal accruals. However, around 10-12%-odd, the capex, which is more specific towards any particular JV and or the subsidiary, for that very specific purpose a debt will be taken.

items.statement: Long-term '20.20.20.20 Vision': 20% revenue CAGR (2025-2031), target >INR 10,000 crore revenue by FY31, inching toward 20% EBITDA margin over 5-7 years
items.quote: In the long term, our compass remains our "20.20.20.20 Vision", aiming for a 20% revenue CAGR from 2025 to 2031, inching closer to 20% EBITDA margin over the next 5 to 7 years. And by FY 2031, we aspire to more than double our current revenue base to upwards of INR 10,000 crore.

items.statement: Mechatronics division steady-state EBITDA margin targeted at 14-15% over next 12-24 months as JVs scale up
items.quote: Just to give you a very satisfactory answer, if you just put them under a Mechatronics bucket, the intended path is that over the next 12-24 months, the Mechatronics basket will be operating in anywhere between 14-15% EBITDA.

items.statement: Aftermarket Q1 growth lower at 6% due to pricing pressure in non-lighting categories; expects double-digit growth for rest of FY27 and 15%+ full-year growth with new strategy
items.quote: The Aftermarket segment showed a growth of 6% y-o-y from INR 98 to INR 104 crore, mainly due to dip in non-lighting product category. However, we are confident to bounce back and confident to post double-digit growth for the remaining part of the year in this particular segment.

items.statement: Minority interest expected at 11-13% of PAT going forward; one JV still slightly PBT negative but EBITDA positive, expected to turn PBT positive in 12-24 months
items.quote: Going forward, this minority interest will remain in similar range between 11-13%-odd, considering the existing structure which is at the present moment.

items.statement: Targets sustained net additions, double-digit revenue growth and 3x cash EBITDA by FY29
items.quote: Our 3-year targets are unambiguous sustained net addition, double-digit revenue growth and 3x on the cash EBITDA.

items.statement: Plans Rs 45,000 Cr capex over next 3 years; placed orders worth Rs 9,100 Cr including Q1 spend of Rs 1,930 Cr
items.quote: I also want to update you on our broader financial architecture that supports our capex plan of Rs. 45,000 Crore over the next three years.

items.statement: Intends to deploy ~3,500 4G sites/month; targets 55,000-57,000 4G sites in ~18 months and 86,000-90,000 5G sites over 3 years
items.quote: If you remember in the 3-year guidance, I had said roughly around 55,000-57,000 sites on 4G and 86,000 to 90,000 sites on 5G.

items.statement: EBITDA margin improved 120 bps YoY to 43.1%; Cash EBITDA grew 13.5% YoY to Rs 2,475 Cr despite network expansion
items.quote: The EBITDA margin improved by over 120 basis points from 41.8% to 43.1% during the same period.

items.statement: ARPU grew 10.2% YoY to Rs 195 (highest in industry), 20th consecutive quarter of increase; driven by premiumization (4G/5G mix 67.4%)
items.quote: Our Customer ARPU grew from Rs. 177 in Q1FY26 to Rs. 195 in Q1FY27, a growth of 10.2% YoY; highest in the industry and a sequential improvement of 2.6%.

items.statement: Delivered first quarter of positive net subscriber additions since merger; subscriber base 193.1M; churn down 24 bps YoY
items.quote: We delivered our first quarter of positive net subscriber additions since merger and we will continue this momentum.

items.statement: 4G/5G subscriber mix improved to 67.4% from 64.4% YoY; 130.1M 4G/5G subs; avg data usage per 4G/5G sub up 25.2% YoY to 21.7 GB
items.quote: improving 4G/5G subscriber mix which stood at 67.4% in Q1FY27 up from 64.4% in Q1FY26 as well as higher data usage by per broadband subscriber.

items.statement: Geopolitical supply constraints impaired Q1 capex deployment (Rs 1,930 Cr vs higher plan); expects acceleration in next 2 quarters
items.quote: Despite prevailing geopolitical headwinds impairing the capex deployment in Q1FY27.

items.statement: Bank debt reduced to Rs 211 Cr from Rs 1,926 Cr YoY; total debt Rs 3,489 Cr (incl. Rs 3,300 Cr NCD); free cash Rs 6,558 Cr
items.quote: Our bank debt has reduced to Rs. 211 Crore as of June 30, 2026 from Rs. 1,926 Crore as of June 30, 2025.

items.statement: Credit ratings upgraded: CRISIL A-/Stable (May 2026) and ICRA A-(Stable) (June 2026) for long-term bank facilities
items.quote: I am delighted to share that we were assigned Crisil A-/Stable rating by CRISIL in May 2026 followed by a credit rating upgrade to ICRA A- (Stable) by ICRA in June 2026.

items.statement: Total Phase 1 project capex estimated at INR 12,000 crore plus supporting infrastructure; INR 1,400 crore deployed so far, all equity
items.quote: the total capital requirement as per the current estimate would be around close to INR 12,000 crores on the project itself. And additional requirements would be related to the infrastructure

items.statement: MoUs secured for ~1 million tonnes copper concentrate; target 1.5 million tonnes for full production; visibility expected to improve to 1.2-1.4 million tonnes by Oct 2027
items.quote: as we speak, today, we are having MoUs of 1 million ton of copper concentrate, and if we go for our 100% production, we will be requiring around 1.5 million or 15 lakh

items.statement: Standalone material margin improved to 31.9% in Q1 FY27 vs 23.5% in Q1 FY26 and 20.4% in Q4 FY26; consolidated EBITDA margin 7.84%
items.quote: During the quarter, our standalone material margin improved to 31.9%, compared with 23.5% in Q1 FY26 and 20.4% in Q4 FY26.

items.statement: Average selling prices rising faster than raw material costs; H-Acid prices doubled to INR 800-900/kg; Vinyl Sulphone prices up 70-80%; effective pass-through of higher input costs
items.quote: improved average selling realizations across our product portfolio, together with effective pass-through of higher raw material costs, supported our material margins

items.statement: Operating environment improved with tighter global supply and China environmental compliance; demand trends mixed across categories; medium to long-term outlook positive due to steady textile demand and non-China sourcing
items.quote: The operating environment for the Dyes and Dyes Intermediates industry improved during Q1 FY27. Pricing across Reactive Dyes, Vinyl Sulphone, H-Acid, and certain basic chemicals strengthened

items.statement: Targeting 70-75% average capacity utilization in dyes business this year from current 60%; H-Acid and Vinyl Sulphone key drivers; copper downstream products (tube, rod, foil) to add value-added mix
items.quote: from 60% to 70%-75%, at least we want to achieve during this year as an average capacity utilization

items.statement: Debt financial closure not yet achieved; >50% commitments received, rest in process; equity dilution tested as Plan B but deferred to capture higher shareholder value post-execution
items.quote: A complete financial closure has not been achieved yet. We are there on the debt raising. More than 50% commitments have been received. Rest is in process.

items.statement: First copper revenue expected Q1 FY28 (May-Jun 2027) from tube plant; rod plant Aug-Sep 2027; refinery and scrap furnace by Jan 2028; copper foil trial in 18-20 months; fertilizer/smelter Q1 FY29
items.quote: a 35 KT plant of tube plant will be operational in June 27. And in August-September 27, 2.25 lakh tons of CCR, Continuous Rod Plant of 8 mm will be operational.

items.statement: FY27 standalone revenue growth guided at 10-12%
items.quote: Looking ahead on a standalone basis, we expect FY 2027 revenue to increase by 10% to 12%.

items.statement: Manufacturing EBIT margin guided at 12-13% for FY27
items.quote: Margins on the manufacturing business should continue in the range of 12% to 13% and in the projects business should improve slightly within the 5% to 6% range.

items.statement: Standalone order book at INR 7,727 crores as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: Total order booking for the first quarter is INR 2,323 crores and the total standalone orders in hand as on June 30, 2026, are very good at INR 7,727 crores.

items.statement: Consolidated order book at INR 8,958 crores as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: The consolidated orders in hand as on 30th June 2026 amounts to INR 8,958 crores.

items.statement: Phase 1 of press plant (INR 73 crores) completing early September with INR 225 crores annual revenue potential
items.quote: The INR 73 crores investment is going to get completed in first week of September. That has a potential, on an annual basis, to give additional revenue of INR 225 crores.

items.statement: Full capacity expansions to add INR 1,200 crores annual revenue by FY29
items.quote: All of these together when fully complete, they have the potential to add a total revenue of about INR 1,200 crores per year when fully complete. So it will largely start reflecting from 2028-29.

items.statement: Export inquiries healthy with INR 750+ crores export orders booked in Q1
items.quote: This quarter, for example, we booked more than INR 750 crores of orders from export markets. The current ongoing quarter also, we are expecting to book good orders.

items.statement: INR 1,200 crores orders already booked in July for standalone business
items.quote: During the current quarter, which is the July and until today, we have already booked about INR 1,200 crores orders in Isgec Heavy Engineering on a stand-alone basis.

items.statement: Geopolitical tensions increasing logistics costs and transit times; commodity prices stabilized above pre-war levels
items.quote: Export and import logistics costs have increased, and transit times have also lengthened. The cost of some materials which have risen due to war are having a small adverse effect on profitability. Commodity prices, particularly steel, copper, aluminium and nickel have more or less stabilized, though they remain slightl

items.statement: Net borrowings reduced by INR 140 crores in Q1 to INR 240 crores standalone
items.quote: The company's net fund position has improved by INR 140 crores during the quarter, and net borrowings are substantially down to INR 240 crores compared to INR 381 crores as on 31st March 2026 and INR 408 crores as on 30th June 2025.

items.statement: Order inflow guidance of INR6,000-8,000 crores for FY27 with INR800 crores already won in Q1 and INR1,800 crores as L1
items.quote: Order inflow will be to the tune of INR6,000 to INR 8,000 crores. We have already got INR800 crores in Q1. We are L1 in around INR1,800 crores. That will materialize in Q2.

items.statement: HAM equity investment requirement: INR179 crores in FY27, INR72 crores each in FY28 and FY29; INR638 crores invested till June 2026
items.quote: So for the coming years, for '26-'27, we will have to invest INR 179 Cr on the existing HAM projects including Bowaichandi project. And for '27-'28 and '28-'29 it would be INR 72 crores each.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 revenue growth guided at 10-12% YoY; EBITDA margin guided at 9-10%
items.quote: With healthy volume momentum, expanding channels, disciplined cost management and an improving pricing environment, we remain optimistic about the outlook with revenue expected to grow by 10% to 12% in the coming quarter and EBITDA margin expected to remain in the range of 9% to 10%.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 7.8%, up 120 bps YoY; marketing spend 10.5% of revenue to be rationalized to 6-7%
items.quote: During Quarter 1, the advertisement and marketing spend comes to around 10.5% of the total revenue and going forward, the same would be rationalized to 6% to 7%.

items.statement: Yarn prices rising; 4-5% price hike taken in Q1 but offset by competitive schemes; new rates to be implemented in August; further 4-5% hike planned
items.quote: We took a price hike of 4%to 5% in Quarter 1. But that was gradually again transferred to trade because of intensive competition in terms of extra scheme and all. So, probably in the august the new rate will be implemented. And we look for a further price hike of 4% to 5%.

items.statement: Healthy volume traction drove 10% revenue growth in Q1; value segment key contributor; momentum expected to broaden across segments
items.quote: We started FY27 on a positive note with revenue growing by 10% witnessing steady momentum across the portfolio. Healthy volume traction remained a key driver of growth during the quarter.

items.statement: Thermal segment has sound and healthy order book for FY27; contribution expected better than last year, dependent on winter severity
items.quote: For thermals, we have a sound and healthy order book. And we expect that this year thermal will contribute better compared to last year.

items.statement: Investing in IT, SAP, AI, and DMS rollout for better inventory visibility and working capital management; DMS implementation to start state-wise over 1-2 years
items.quote: We are doing lot of initiatives in IT where we have better control on the inventory and we have a better visibility of stocks where it is stuck. So, yes. Better implementation of SAP and all will help us to, better implementation of AI also we are taking few initiatives and all.

items.statement: Revised FY27 revenue guidance to INR2,600 crores with small chance of exceeding it
items.quote: Guidance, we revised our guidance for FY '27 at INR2,600 crores with a small chance that we may even cross this number.

items.statement: Manufacturing order book at INR22.08 billion with generator & motor at INR19.29 billion, railway INR2.11 billion, spares INR0.22 billion, Turkey INR0.46 billion
items.quote: Order book for the Manufacturing segment is INR22.08 billion, out of which INR19.29 billion is the generator and motor manufacturing business, INR2.11 billion is railway business, spares and aftermarket is INR0.22 billion and INR0.46 billion is the Turkey business.

items.statement: Plans further capacity expansion for FY29-30 targeting INR40 billion+ revenue capacity, details in next earnings call
items.quote: Next, we're looking at what we should be doing for FY '29 and FY '30 to move the capacity to INR40 billion and above.

items.statement: Guides gross contribution margin stable within +/-1% range; EBITDA margin guided at 18-19%
items.quote: we have guided in the last call that we will maintain our approximately plus/minus 1% here and there, we maintain the gross contribution margin for the company.

items.statement: Price variation clauses implemented where contracts allow; margin maintained via pricing, cost reduction, mix, FX
items.quote: We have contracts with our customers where we have price variation clauses and wherever we have price variation clauses, those have been implemented, yes.

items.statement: Very buoyant market across all segments driven by AI data centres, grid stabilization, renewables; strong order inflow expected to continue
items.quote: In general, we see a very buoyant market for TDPS in all segments of business. The basic factors that are driving growth continue to play out, AI data centres, grid stabilization, basic power generation push towards renewables.

items.statement: Large generator segment (>100MW) agreements close to signing; announcement expected in August; revenue impact not in FY27 guidance (18-20 month lead time)
items.quote: Regarding the opportunity in the large generator segment, we are close to signing agreements with the relevant parties and we will inform the market growth probably in the month of August about these unique opportunities.

items.statement: Board meeting scheduled for Friday to discuss fundraise; no details disclosed before board approval
items.quote: We have issued a notification to the exchange that we'll be having a Board meeting on Friday and I cannot discuss anything before the Board meeting takes place on Friday.

items.statement: Demand highly inelastic - power equipment <5% of data centre project cost; customers compelled to buy regardless of commodity price increases
items.quote: The power plant forms a very, very small percentage of the overall project cost. If you look at data centres and things like that, it is less than 5%. So, it's the demand elasticity is very high.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 13% for FY27
items.quote: we have given a guidance of 13%. We still remain firm with that guidance.

items.statement: Volume growth guidance revised to 7-8% for FY27 from earlier 7-9% range
items.quote: I would say we will be having a healthy run for market growth. I still believe we can deliver 7%-8% volume growth but not 9%.

items.statement: Annual capex guidance maintained at INR 80-100 crores for FY27
items.quote: Actually, the long term of whatever we said, INR80 crores to INR100 crores capex every year, we are maintaining still the same statement.

items.statement: MINPRO JV initial investment of INR 35 crores over next 2 years, targeting 8-10% EBITDA margin and <3 year payback
items.quote: It is roughly INR35 crores initial investment in next 2 years' time. And we believe EBITDA should be around 8% to 10% and payback period should be less than 3 years or so after production.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin improved to 14.5% vs 10.8% in Q1 FY26, driven by steel execution, price realization, operating leverage and productivity
items.quote: EBITDA margin improved significantly to 14.5% compared to 10.8% in Q1 FY26. This improvement in profitability was driven by strong execution across our steelmaking portfolio, favourable price realization, operating leverage and ongoing productivity initiatives.

items.statement: Magnesite prices increased 6-8% in last 2 months; company working on absorption and pass-through to customers
items.quote: magnesite price has already gone up by 6% to 8% from, last 2 months or so. We are trying to see how we can absorb this and how we can pass on to our end user.

items.statement: Steel sector capex of INR 50,000-60,000 crores expected in FY27, supporting refractory demand growth for 5-8 years
items.quote: steel sector itself would be seeing a capex of not less than INR50,000 crores to INR60,000 crores coming up this financial year. So that also gives us a lot of headroom. Going forward, the growth rate of steel sector is going to be great, at least for the next 5 to 8 years that we look at.

items.statement: Flow control products driving margin growth; market share doubled in one major group in last 6 months; 35% of revenue from core flow control business
items.quote: In RHI Magnesita India, most of the products are flow control products, be it the Bhiwadi plant or Jamshedpur plant, and that was our focus area where we could manage to get price increases.

items.statement: Quartzite mines (Chiraipani and Bhikampali) expected to open by end of Q2 FY27, providing structural cost benefits from Q3 FY27
items.quote: We are very close to opening up this mine and now our take is, towards the end of this quarter we should be able to open these mines. So this would definitely give us a solid structural benefit in terms of cost structure. The benefits we expect should start coming up from next quarter.

items.statement: 4PRO solutions model expanding with 5-year robotic contracts including refractory supply and maintenance (e.g., JSW)
items.quote: it is a 5-year contract. It includes everything: supply of refractory, maintaining of robotic part. The maintenance, everything is taken care of when we offer this.

items.statement: Technology transfer from parent: 4-5 new products to be produced in India within 1 year
items.quote: We are working on that. And in maybe 1 year's time, we will have 4 or 5 more products being produced in India.

items.statement: North American export orders with combined annual value ~US$10.7M and lifetime value ~US$58.5M; SOPs expected Q3 FY27 and Q4 FY27
items.quote: Our previously announced 3 orders from a North American engine and genset manufacturer with a combined annual value of approximately US$10.7 million and a lifetime value of approximately US$58.5 million remain aligned to revised customer schedules.

items.statement: Uttarakhand facility investment ~INR 20 crores progressing per customer plan; Chakan 3 lightweighting facility commenced SOP with modular capacity
items.quote: Our new Uttarakhand facility is progressing in line with the customer implementation plan. The project involves an investment of approximately INR 20 crores and has been planned closer to customers' manufacturing location to improve logistics, responsiveness and JIT alignment.

items.statement: Steel and aluminium on pass-through basis with no lag; substrate prices customer-directed with no lag; one-time premium freight/RM procurement due to geopolitical situation absorbed in Q1, expected to normalize
items.quote: Most of the direct materials are on pass-through basis. And there was small impact of premium RM procurement, which is built into the gross profit growth of 8% because of the geopolitical situation.

items.statement: Industry production grew 22% YoY to 93.6 lakh units in Q1 FY27; PV up 16.8% (UVs +21.2%), LCV +20.8%; demand healthy across PV, CV, 3W segments relevant to Sharda
items.quote: Overall, industry performance during the quarter reflected broad-based momentum with domestic automobile production increasing over 22% year-on-year to 93.6 lakh units, underscoring strong OEM activity and healthy demand visible across automobile value chain.

items.statement: Donghee TLA generating RFQs across multiple platforms; internal assessment sees lightweighting addressable market at INR 8,000-9,000 crores in 5 years targeting mid-to-high teen share; Purem JV program started Q4 FY26 ramping in FY27; integ
items.quote: Our internal assessment on this portfolio is around 5 years from now, it can be between INR8,000 crores to INR 9,000 crores. And we firmly believe that we can actually build a mid-teen to high-teen percentage share in that portfolio.

items.statement: Expecting to reach INR100 crore quarterly revenue by Q4 FY27, implying INR400 crore annualized top line
items.quote: We can see it from Q4.

items.statement: As of call date, 700+ tenancies from Vodafone Idea in execution pipeline plus 150 already converted in Q1
items.quote: My ET keeps increasing every day because they keep loading me sites day on day out. So as of date, when I am sitting here, it's 700 plus other than 150, which I have done earlier.

items.statement: Launching zinc battery (INR33,000 per 100H) to replace lithium (INR48,000 per 100H), reducing CapEx and operational costs; first batch for 10-15 sites by mid-September
items.quote: Zinc battery is ready. It's under production right now and we should get first batch for around 10, 15 sites in by mid of September. And pricing of zinc battery is similar to old pricing of lithium battery.

items.statement: EBITDA margin with electricity reimbursement to be maintained at ~59% for coming quarters; PAT margin expected at ~20%
items.quote: We will have the same EBITDA margin with EV, which I have shown right now which is around 59%. We will maintain the same EBITDA margin for coming quarters also.

items.statement: Vodafone Idea plans 45,000 site rollout over 18-24 months (3,000-3,500 sites/month); BSNL plans 2 lakh sites over 5 years but rollout delayed by Tejas equipment issues
items.quote: Vodafone has already declared close to 45,000 site rollout plan in next 18-24 months. They are targeting to do 3,000, 3,500 site every month which they have already started.

items.statement: Revenue per tower stable at INR31,000-31,500/month excluding electricity; electricity reimbursement adds ~INR20,000-25,000/site/month to top line
items.quote: revenue per tower has been constant at INR31,000, INR31,500 for us from last four quarters

items.statement: No immediate fundraising planned; internal accruals sufficient for 3,000 tenancy target; will evaluate if larger orders materialize from VI or BSNL
items.quote: As of now, we have enough funds from internal accruals. We are not seeing any major fundraising right now. But depends if I get more orders than expected, then we may decide on fundraising.

items.statement: Order book at INR990 crore end of Q1 FY27, up from INR880 crore previous quarter after INR157 crore execution and INR143 crore fresh orders
items.quote: Our order book stood at INR990 crores at the end of quarter, providing a healthy base for the revenue visibility going forward.

items.statement: Fresh order inflows of INR143 crore secured in Q1 FY27 across geospatial, mobility, water and smart city segments
items.quote: the quarter saw continued momentum in our order inflows, with the company securing fresh contracts worth INR143 crores during the period

items.statement: EBITDA margin expanded 505 bps YoY to 24.4% in Q1 FY27 driven by project delivery efficiency gains, eighth consecutive quarter of sequential EBITDA increase
items.quote: EBITDA increased substantially by 27% on a year-on-year basis to INR39 crores, with EBITDA margins improving to 24.4%, representing an expansion of 505 basis points over the corresponding period last year.

items.statement: Board approved up to INR25 crore investment in 50:50 JV with AI Fabric USA for sovereign AI cloud targeting defense, cybersecurity; first INR5 crore for incorporation, INR20 crore post due diligence in 3-4 months
items.quote: We have approved an investment up to INR25 crores in joint venture with AI Fabric USA to be incorporated to create a sovereign AI new cloud in India for Indian government, citizens and companies focused on cybersecurity, services and defense

items.statement: Strong order funnel with L1 positions on multiple large tenders; one INR67 crore order converted, two more expected in Q2 FY27, plus new tenders published
items.quote: one of the order may come this quarter will come this quarter. There is a huge process going to board and then giving the final order. So there are a few more tenders just we got those.

items.statement: Working capital cycle at 164 days; expect meaningful improvement over next 2-3 quarters as Maharashtra government released GR for Jal Jeevan Mission IoT dues (~INR100 crore) to be collected by Q3 FY27
items.quote: we expect that in next 2 to 3 quarters and obviously, before 31st March, all the overdues of IoT projects and other projects which are under the Jal Jeevan Mission will be cleared

items.statement: Geospatial Engineering Services revenue grew 30% YoY to INR94 crore; Technology Solutions declined 25% YoY to INR63 crore; aim to grow Technology Solutions beyond 51% of segment revenue
items.quote: our Geospatial Engineering Services revenue for the quarter increased by 30% year-on-year to INR94 crores, while Technology Solutions side, revenue declined by around 25% year-on-year to INR63 crores

items.statement: No forward guidance given per policy; execution timeline weighted average 12-18 months for order book; expect growth trend of last 2.5 years to continue
items.quote: we don't give forward-looking statements, and therefore, we will be restricting ourselves to mention about the numbers, but we are sure to have -- continue the trend of the growth

items.statement: International geospatial mobility business showing meaningful improvement with new business development and contract awards gaining momentum
items.quote: Our international geospatial mobility business showed a meaningful improvement during the quarter with new business development opportunities and contract awards gaining momentum.

items.statement: Received LOI for INR67 crore PMAY contract over 3 years from Madhya Pradesh Urban Administration; INR17 crore AMR water meter order from Bhandara Municipal Council for 12 months
items.quote: We have received a Letter of Intent from the Director of Urban Administration and Development, Madhya Pradesh for the selection and appointment of a manpower agency for beneficiary led constant vertical under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana with a total contract value of approximately INR67 crores

items.statement: Unbilled revenue of ~INR320 crore (majorly JJM) expected to be billed and collected in next 2 quarters following government fund release clarity
items.quote: this unbilled revenue, major portion is of JJM things and which we have clarified in our, just a few, in one of the calls that we have got the clarity from the department and this amount will be billed in this next 2 quarters

items.statement: INR238 crore raised (INR100 crore Sep'24, INR130 crore Mar'26) for expansion, acquisitions, new opportunities; evaluating targets for vertical integration and margin expansion
items.quote: When we talk about the raising of INR238 crores for, it was not just acquisition, it was expansion, new opportunities, acquisition and all.

items.statement: Run-rate businesses (Mobility, Product Solutions) ~20-25% of revenue not in order book; FY26 run-rate revenue was INR130 crore
items.quote: FY26, we had business, as I mentioned, are the 2 segments, which are without order book was INR130 crores, which includes Mobility and the Product Solutions business.

items.statement: AI cloud JV revenue expected from FY28 onwards after due diligence and business model finalization in 3-4 months
items.quote: You understood right.

items.statement: FY27 revenue target raised to Rs 1,350-1,400 crore from earlier Rs 1,250 crore, with PAT margin around 8.5-9%
items.quote: I wouldn't be surprised if that figure moves toward Rs. 1,350 crores or Rs. 1,400 crores.

items.statement: FY28 revenue potential of Rs 1,700-1,750 crore with full year of Unit 6 operation
items.quote: So with a full 12 months, I see the possibility of crossing 1,700 to 1,750.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 capex of Rs 20 crore; cumulative Rs 209 crore spent of Rs 512 crore planned; Rs 9.3 crore for land at Lote Parshuram
items.quote: we incurred approximately Rs. 20 crores during Q1 FY27 across ongoing expansion initiatives. With this, cumulative capex incurred stands at Rs. 209 crores as of June 30, 2026, against the total planned capex of Rs. 512 crores.

items.statement: Unit 5 and Unit 6 at Ratnagiri complete; Unit 6 trials expected by end-August or September; Unit 5 dyes plant and 10 MW solar also complete
items.quote: Unit 5 dyes plant and the 10 -megawatt solar project capitalization will be announced very soon. Both plants are complete. Unit 6 is also complete. I expect that in the next month or month and a half, we should go on trials.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 11.4%, PAT margin 8.2%; targeting return to 8.5-9% PAT margin for FY27
items.quote: I said that we will come to the level of 8.5%-9%. I hope so.

items.statement: Sulphur prices reset from USD 250-300 to USD 1,100; acid plants run on low load due to working capital stress and negative margins
items.quote: Specifically, if I talk about sulphur, sulphur, which used to be in the range of USD250-USD300, in today's date, only sulphur is in the range of USD1,100.

items.statement: Holding inventory in anticipation of higher prices; strategy to continue; volumes expected in Q2
items.quote: Obviously. Why would we sell? You can see the inventory levels.

items.statement: K-acid price rose from Rs 550 to Rs 700+; largest K-acid manufacturer in India; strong inquiries for K-acid, H-acid, Vinyl Sulphone from China
items.quote: Today, we are the largest manufacturer of K -acid in India. No one else is in K -acid. The price of the product has moved from Rs. 550 to Rs. 700-plus.

items.statement: Acquired 30,000 sq m land at Lote Parshuram for Rs 9.33 crore for future expansion headroom
items.quote: During the quarter, the company acquired approximately 30,000 square meters of additional land at Lote Parshuram for Rs. 9.33 crores, located near the existing Unit 1.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 revenue expected 110% better than Q2 FY26 (which was ~Rs 250-255 crore)
items.quote: 110% much better than last year Q2.

items.statement: Management expects double-digit revenue growth for FY27, supported by INR 10 crore sales reversal recovery in Q2
items.quote: As of now, we feel yes. Even this quarter, we lost around INR 10 crores because of the sales reversal, which will come in the next quarter. As of now, we think we should be able to grow in double digits.

items.statement: Fermentation utilization at 70-75%; capacity expansion capex decision expected next quarter
items.quote: We are close to 70-75%, and we will take the call in the next quarter, and we may start some of the CapEx expenditure for increasing our capacity.

items.statement: EBITDA margin target of 30-32% for FY27; Q1 was 27% due to lower realization, higher energy costs, mix shift
items.quote: Yes. We expect that it shall come back to the normal level of about 30% of EBITDA.

items.statement: Serratiopeptidase pricing improved in Q1 vs Q4 and Q1 FY26; FDC ban impact minimal (~1%)
items.quote: Pricing is better in this particular quarter because we have increased some prices. It's better in that sense. Realization is better than Q4 and Q1 of last year.

items.statement: US business steady; management expects 8-10% steady-state growth amid geopolitical/logistics challenges and branding transition
items.quote: We don't expect at least at this juncture beyond 8-10% of growth.

items.statement: Bioprocessing grew 30% YoY driven by Food; Specialized Manufacturing up 41% YoY; Human Healthcare down 7% YoY on Pharma API weakness
items.quote: The strong YoY performance was driven by healthy growth in Food business, and the segment contributed 16% to our total revenues.

items.statement: Geopolitical tensions, supply chain disruptions, energy cost volatility, and US tariff/war risks cited as key headwinds
items.quote: The global economy has been experiencing significant disturbance for quite some time, primarily driven by geographical tensions, trade and uncertainties, and continued disruption across global supply chain.

items.statement: Board approved buyback of INR 697 million at INR 500/share via open market; JC Biotech 4.28% stake acquired for INR 79.79 million
items.quote: We are pleased to announce that the Board has approved a buyback of INR 697 million at a ceiling price of INR 500 per share via open market route.

items.statement: R&D spend at 4.75% of revenue (INR 90 million) in Q1; 15-20 molecules in pipeline; novel food (EFSA) approval pending 3-6 months
items.quote: R&D expenditure, we have spent about INR 90 million in the Q1 of FY27 as compared to INR 86 million in Q1 of FY26. This is about 4.75% during this quarter.

items.statement: Working capital cycle 125-138 days; inventory INR 190 cr, receivables INR 131 cr, payables INR 41 cr as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: Inventory, 30th June 2026, was about INR 190 crores. We had a receivable of about INR 131 crores. Payables were about INR 41 crores. INR 280 crores was roughly invested in the working capital.

items.statement: evoxx subsidiary revenue INR 74 million, EBITDA -INR 13 million; SciTech revenue INR 201 million, EBITDA INR 31 million
items.quote: The sales from evoxx stood at INR 74 million, and EBITDA is negative INR 13 million with negative PAT of about INR 18 million in Q1 FY27.

items.statement: JC Biotech now 100% owned after acquiring 4.28% stake; Algae DHA project paused, may revisit after new R&D facility
items.quote: We are not going forward with the DHA as of now, which was JC Biotech's molecule. As of now, we are not really working on that at current level.

items.statement: Patents granted: Alternansucrase (sugar management) and protein hydrolysis; third biocatalysis patent in process
items.quote: We got one patent on Alternansucrase on the sugar management. We already granted U.S. patent. On the protein as well, I guess, I need to check, but I guess we got that one, too.

items.statement: Revenue growth guidance of 30%-40% for FY27 maintained
items.quote: Our guidance on our revenue of 30%-40% also remains on track. So, none of our guidance that we had in the last quarter has changed and we are very positive around that.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance of 10%-12% for FY27 maintained
items.quote: We have given the guidance of around 10% to 12% so that guidance is still the same.

items.statement: Standalone net debt reduction guidance of Rs. 600-800 crores for FY27 maintained
items.quote: I reiterate that our debt reduction guidance of Rs. 600 to 800 crores that we mentioned at the start of the year is on track and we will achieve that.

items.statement: Standalone CAPEX guidance of less than Rs. 100 crores for FY27 maintained
items.quote: Yes, that will remain the same. There is no big CAPEX envisaged in Quarter 1. So, we can consider Rs. 100 crores and some replacement CAPEX we can do against some important equipments.

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin at 10.32% in Q1 FY27, up from 10.11% in Q1 FY26
items.quote: The EBITDA margin was 10.32%, marginally expanded from 10.11% in Quarter 1 FY26, reflecting steady cost management even in a quarter of moderate execution.

items.statement: Working capital days expected to reduce to 120 days by FY27 end and ~90 days next year
items.quote: So, working capital, basically, like Rohan said, by this year-end, we may reach to 120 days. And next year, probably around 90 days of total.

items.statement: Finance cost guidance of Rs. 350 crores for full year FY27
items.quote: So, the finance cost for full year would be total Rs. 350 crores because we are basically expecting some lesser utilization of working capital during Q3 and Q4. So, our targeted cost is around Rs. 350 crores.

items.statement: Management targets 15-20% organic revenue growth annually for the next 5 years.
items.quote: our target is to grow 15% to 20% for the next 5 years. And if you see the first quarter numbers, we have surpassed that. We've grown 25% on revenue and around 24% on EBITDA.

items.statement: Visa & Consular EBITDA margin target is to maintain ~40%; Digital Services margin improved to 8.2% with expectation of continued improvement as business scales.
items.quote: In the Visa business, we have achieved around 40% EBITDA margin. And our Digital Service business, the EBITDA margin has grown up to 8.0% now, which was 7.3% before. Our target is to maintain those margins.

items.statement: Digital Services revenue grew 32% to INR 330 crores (37% of consolidated revenue), led by BC business (GTV INR 29,500 crores) and loan distribution; EBITDA grew 46% to INR 27 crores with margin expansion to 8.2%.
items.quote: Digital Service segment revenue was INR 330 crores, up 32% from INR 250 crores, our fastest-growing business this quarter. The growth was led by healthy traction in our business correspondent and loan distribution businesses.

items.statement: Net cash position of INR 1,617 crores as of June 30, 2026; asset-light model converts profit to cash well providing financial flexibility for investments.
items.quote: As on 30 June 2026, we held a net cash of INR 1,617 crores. It is an asset-light business model that converts profit into cash well, and that is what gives us the flexibility that we have today.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 Matchmaking billing and revenue expected to grow double-digit YoY; PAT expected triple-digit YoY, similar or slightly better than Q1 level
items.quote: Matchmaking billing and revenue will have a double-digit growth, year-on-year basis in Quarter 2. Profit will also be triple digit in Quarter 2 as well.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 consolidated PAT expected triple-digit YoY growth; profit may be similar to Q1 or slightly better
items.quote: On the outlook for Q2 margins, we expect to achieve a triple digit year-on-year growth in PAT. Profit may be similar level of Q1 or slightly better than current quarter.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin 20.1% in Q1 FY27 vs 12.4% in Q4 FY26 and 11% YoY
items.quote: On a consolidated basis, EBITDA margin in Q1 is at 20.1% compared to 12.4% in Q4 and 11% a year ago.

items.statement: ATV for Matchmaking dropped 6.7% QoQ but grew 4.2% YoY; management says ATV fluctuates due to package mix and pricing strategies, not a steady-state metric
items.quote: ATV for the Matchmaking business dropped at 6.7% on a quarter-on-quarter and grew by 4.2% year-on-year.

items.statement: Launched love.com and regional variant malayalilove.com; expanding regional strategy on love.com; Jodi low-cost product also in portfolio
items.quote: We launched a new offering. We launched love.com. We also went regional on love.com. We launched malayalilove.com because Malayalam is one market, where normally the uptake is good. So, we are also going regional on love.com.

items.statement: Wedding services business model shifted from subscription to commission-led; expects growth momentum in coming quarters; targets Rs. 100 crore run rate before profit contribution; clarity expected in ~1 year
items.quote: We moved from the subscription business model to a commission-led model. We believe that's the way forward on the wedding services. We see some traction. We are working on things. So, we are quite optimistic about the growth opportunity in the wedding services space and also other initiatives. So, we see that happening

items.statement: ManyJobs platform has 1.5 million job seekers; focused on Tamil Nadu; national rollout decision maybe next year
items.quote: We have more than 1.5 million job seekers. So, it may take some time till you achieve a certain run rate or close to a break even. You may not expand other markets. So, we wanted to stay focused only in Tamil Nadu. So, at this point of time, maybe next year or maybe coming next year or so, we may focus only in Tamil Na

items.statement: Revenue recognition gap between billing and revenue expected to remain Rs. 3-5 crores per quarter; revenue typically 97-99% of billing depending on quarter
items.quote: There will be some difference of Rs. 3 to 5 Crores. So, it depends on the quarters. Suppose the billing growth, sometimes the catch-up may happen also. There is a billing growth Q2 and Q3. There will be some bit of slight slowdown can happen in terms of compared to the previous quarter. But revenue can be better also.

items.statement: Full-year FY27 fractionation capacity utilization guided at 80-85% on expanded ~52,000 MTPA capacity (including 4,500 MTPA debottlenecking in Q3 FY27)
items.quote: So we expect our to be around 80%, 85% for full year for this year.

items.statement: Contracts are 9-12 months, renewed on rolling basis; no specific renewal concentration in any quarter
items.quote: So see, basically, our contracts are 9 to 12 months, which is not specific to a certain quarter or a certain month. So it is an ongoing process.

items.statement: EBITDA margin 26.3% in Q1 FY27 (+49 bps YoY); management says underlying margin range expected to hold broadly stable, with modest quarter-to-quarter movements
items.quote: See, margins can see modest quarter-to-quarter movement depending on mix and one-off items. But the underlying lens range is expected to hold broadly stable.

items.statement: Capex spend Q1 FY27: ~INR 20 cr; cumulative spend to date: ~INR 70 cr of INR 460 cr plan; intend to spend ~INR 220 cr more in FY27
items.quote: So if we talk about just for this quarter, we have spent around INR 20-odd crores through Manorama and our subsidiaries. Until today, we have spent around INR 70 crores out of our total proposed capex plan, and we intend to spend approximately around INR 220 odd crores more in this financial year for our capex.

items.statement: IPP segment EBITDA margin 85-90%; consolidated EBITDA margin improved to 37% in Q1 FY27 from 35% YoY
items.quote: Our EBITDA margin has improved to 37% from 35%, reflecting the operating strength of our portfolio.

items.statement: Management targets IPP at ~20% of total revenue mix; currently 17-18% from IPP
items.quote: As we have earlier in our con-calls also said that we will try to maintain IPP at a level of 20-odd percent of the total revenue mix.

items.statement: INR670 crore green bond listed (5-year, 8.50% coupon, quarterly amortization, 65% GuarantCo guarantee, AA+ rated)
items.quote: We continue to build on the successful listing of India's first externally credit enhanced green bond of INR670 crore, a 5-year instrument carrying 8.50 coupon with quarterly amortization backed by 65% partial guarantee from GuarantCo.

items.statement: Botswana 500 MW IPP project: 500 hectares land acquired, PPA signing advanced, no revenue in FY27
items.quote: 500 hectares of land has already been acquired. So we are at a very advanced stage of signing the PPAs also. So shortly, I think we'll see. But by execution point of view, I think this year, we will not see any revenue.

items.statement: Target Rs 2,000 sales per sq ft in festive quarter for Spencer's
items.quote: I would set the target as reaching to Rs. 2,000 SPSF in the festive quarter, and that is the internal target.

items.statement: Aspire to reach 7.5-8% store EBITDA for Spencer's
items.quote: We are making good progress towards what we have publicly stated our short-term aspiration of reaching to about 7.5% to 8% store EBITDA.

items.statement: Online business full-year growth to steady around 25%
items.quote: I think we'll see growth rates -- full year cumulative growth rates on that business, which will steady at around 25% as far as the online business is concerned.

items.statement: Spencer's offline growth expected at mid to high single digits
items.quote: I think on the offline business, it will probably be mid to high single digits on the Spencer's offline business.

items.statement: Nature's Basket early double-digit growth expected from Q3/Q4 after reset
items.quote: I would say from quarter 3, quarter 4, we will start seeing early double-digit growth as far as Natures Basket is concerned once we finish the whole reset and the optimization.

items.statement: Sustain consolidated sales growth momentum through FY27 with steady margins and controlled opex
items.quote: I think we will be able to sustain this through the year. And with steady margins, controlled operating expenses, we will see the full flow-through of it as far as the EBITDA is concerned.

items.statement: Nature's Basket capex focused on store refurbishments, not new stores
items.quote: We will spend our limited capex on renovating stores, driving a higher level of throughput. We will not see too many additional stores.

items.statement: Spencer's like-for-like gross margins steady at 19%
items.quote: If I look for like-for-like, margins are steady at 19%.

items.statement: Nature's Basket gross margins flat; focus on absolute rupee gross margin growth not percentage
items.quote: Our gross margins are -- stand at the same level. And really there, it's not about improving percentage margins, but it's really about increasing your throughput and looking at driving a much higher level of gross margins at an absolute level, not at a percentage level.

items.statement: Spencer's growth driven 70% by higher number of bills (NOBs) and 30% by higher average bill value
items.quote: So it is a combination of 2, but largely driven by higher number of NOBs, number of bills, which to me is -- if you were to look at it in FMCG part, it's underlying volume growth as opposed to pricing growth.

items.statement: Order book stands at INR 93,492 crore as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: As on June 30, 2026, the company's total order book is stood at an impressive INR 93,492 crore.

items.statement: Targets INR 20,000-25,000 crore new order inflow for FY27, INR 5,500 crore already received
items.quote: Our target for business development or increasing the order book is almost INR 20,000-25,000 crore for this year, out of which already INR 5,500 crore of works have been entrusted to us.

items.statement: Expects consolidated EBITDA margin of 5-7% over next three years
items.quote: We are expecting an EBITDA of 5-7%.

items.statement: Focus sectors for new orders: ports, hydro, highways, green energy
items.quote: Right now, we are focusing heavily on port sector, hydro, and highway. So, these are the three sectors, and plus green energy also.

items.statement: Revenue mix Q1 FY27: 63% management fee (nomination), 37% bidding/PMC; targets 50-50 in 2-3 years
items.quote: If you see our Q1 results, almost 60% of the revenue /top line is from the management work, which is almost 63% is from management, and remaining is from the bidding or PMC.

items.statement: INR 40,000 crore of order book currently under active execution
items.quote: Our total order book, which is remaining, is INR 93,000, and works which are in progress is about almost INR 40,000 crore.

items.statement: Contracts generally covered by price variation clauses; inflation impact minimal
items.quote: Vishal, generally, all the contracts are covered by price variation, which generally covers the price inflation. So, I think it does not have a very big impact.

items.statement: Dividend policy follows DIPAM guidelines: 30% of PAT or 4% of net worth, whichever higher
items.quote: We generally follow DIPAM guidelines, which is 30% of the PAT or 4% of the net worth, whichever is higher. So, we'll give that dividend.

items.statement: No further provisioning for onerous contracts expected; all major losses already provisioned
items.quote: So, we have already provisioned for the onerous project, and we are not anticipating any further provision of the losses.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth expected at lower single-digit, with Q3 and Q4 better than H1
items.quote: We are expecting that Q3 and Q4 will be better , so it will be lower single-digit kind of growth this year.

items.statement: Annual capex of INR 100 crores across Sandila and Hamirpur facilities
items.quote: Every year we are doing a capex of about INR 100 crores at Sandila and Hamirpur together.

items.statement: Hamirpur facility capex of INR 70-100 crores per year for 2 blocks annually over 3-4 years
items.quote: Our further block will be almost around INR 80 crores to INR 100 crores per year we would be doing the capex at our Hamirpur facility.

items.statement: Sustainable EBITDA margin target of 18%, currently at 15.5% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: We feel that we should be able to get around 18%. 18% if things go alright otherwise at least 15%, 16% we should be able to continue on a sustainable basis.

items.statement: Adding 3 new products in FY27 including fungicide at Sandila and multipurpose herbicide plant at Hamirpur
items.quote: Yes, 3. Including what we already produced, 3 products.

items.statement: EU Technical Equivalence approval for fungicide to add INR 30-40 crores revenue from November
items.quote: At least we feel that we should be able to get another INR 30 crores, INR 40 crores of revenue from this molecule in European Union in addition to what we are already doing.

items.statement: Hamirpur facility to reach INR 1,000 crores revenue potential in 3-4 years with 8-10 blocks
items.quote: Overall potential, sir, when we put up roughly 8 to 10 blocks, we comfortably should get almost INR 1,000 crores from our Hamirpur facility. It will take three to four years from now.

items.statement: Chinese imports at lower prices creating competitive pressure; countering via operational efficiency and R&D process optimization
items.quote: Chinese products are coming at relatively much lower prices. So we are trying to improve our operational efficiency and trying to compete with Chinese imports and that is where our R&D team is working regularly to optimize further the process conditions.

items.statement: Hamirpur facility expected to contribute INR 50-60 crores revenue in FY27 from 2 operational blocks
items.quote: Maybe it's not INR 70 crores to INR 80 crores, but it will be somewhere around INR 50 crores to INR 60 crores. It will be there, no doubt about it.

items.statement: New fungicide product (imported from China) priced at INR 500-600/kg; targeting 2,000 tons capacity from 4,000-5,000 tons import market
items.quote: Price is about INR 500 to INR 600 per kg.

items.statement: New fungicide production at Sandila requires only INR 2-3 crores balancing equipment in existing plant
items.quote: We are trying to adjust it in the existing with some balancing equipment. We will not put a whole new plant for this. In the existing plant, we will have to put a little balancing of INR 2 crores, INR 3 crores.

items.statement: No term loans planned; capex funded entirely through internal accruals and healthy cash balance of INR 59 crores
items.quote: Our object has been not to take any term loan in India Pesticide for its expansion and we have already a very healthy cash balance. So we will be funding our capex through internal accruals only.

items.statement: Expect to submit SFB operational readiness to RBI by end of Q4 FY27 within 18-month timeline from Dec 2025
items.quote: We continue to expect that all required milestones will be completed within the prescribed 18-month timeline, and we remain on course to submit our readiness to the Reserve Bank of India by end of Quarter 4 FY27.

items.statement: B2B UPI P2M segment relaunch tentatively in Q4 FY27 depending on ecosystem developments
items.quote: We are preparing to relaunch our high-growth B2B UPI P2M segment. However, this would depend on the ecosystem and other developments, which could result in the relaunch tentatively in Quarter 4 FY27.

items.statement: SFB-related opex burn estimated at INR 10 crores for FY27 including hiring and technology
items.quote: So, in terms of the burden on opex this year, we are anticipating anything around INR10 crores on this year's P&L in terms of the SFB opex which includes hiring, which includes all the other related opex for the bank.

items.statement: Net revenue margin expanded to 42.8% in Q1 FY27, up 275 bps sequentially and 925 bps YoY
items.quote: One of the key highlights for the quarter was a continued improvement in our net revenue margin. Despite lower revenues, our net revenue margin expanded to its highest quarterly value of 42.8%, improving 275 basis points sequentially and 925 basis points year-on-year.

items.statement: Target NIMs of 8-9% for SFB on day one, driven by 1.4% cost of funds and 14% blended portfolio yield
items.quote: So from an SFB perspective, with the kind of asset products which we are looking at, we expect our NIMs, and that may not answer your ROE question fully, but at least NIMs, which is highest in the industry, which we are looking at anywhere in the range of 8% to 9%.

items.statement: Referral loan disbursements surged 214% YoY to INR 628 crores in Q1 FY27, nearly 50% of FY26 total
items.quote: Referral loan disbursals surged 214% on year-on-year to INR 628 crores, nearly 50% of the total disbursals in FY26, indicating growing demand for credit in our banking ecosystem and our target customer segment.

items.statement: CASA contribution to revenue increased from 45% in Q4 FY26 to 54% in Q1 FY27
items.quote: CASA increased its contribution to the revenue from 45% in Q4 FY26 to 54% in the current quarter, reflecting the growing strength of our liability franchise.

items.statement: No non-compete clause with NBFC partners for referral lending; customers belong to bank enabling seamless transition to own balance sheet
items.quote: The answer to that is no because currently, the referral lending is to our own customers. So these customers belong to the bank and not to the NBFCs whose loan referring we are doing. So there is no noncompete clause or any implications for that matter.

items.statement: Liability book stability confirmed: 90%+ core deposits behavioral, grew 9% in March 2026 despite stress event
items.quote: In the month of March, we reached one of our highest possible liability book balance. And thereafter, on an average basis, our liability in the month of March perhaps increased by around 9%.

items.statement: Confident of recovering Q1 lost sales of Rs. 25-30 crores in coming quarters to achieve FY27 revenue and margin guidance
items.quote: Now as regards the guidance, we are still confident that we will be able to make up for this lost Rs. 25 crores - Rs. 30 crores of sales in the coming few quarters. And we are still confident we will be able to achieve our guidance of closer to Rs. 1,000 crores while maintaining the EBITDA margin levels between 32% to

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin at 25% due to temporary water shortage and solar policy change impacts; expected to normalize to guided 33-35% range
items.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at Rs. 47 crores as against Rs. 52 crores in Q1 FY '26, a degrowth of 8.1% year-on-year and EBITDA margin stood at 25% for Q1 FY '27.

items.statement: Solar policy change increased power costs by Rs. 8 crores at EBITDA level; retrospective Rs. 4.5-5 crores one-time; ongoing increases to be passed to customers
items.quote: Second, Maharashtra government changed the solar power policy, which led to increased fuel and power costs during the quarter. This alone had an impact of Rs. 8 crores at EBITDA levels.

items.statement: Strong demand continued in Q1 but water shortage deferred Rs. 35 crores sales; exports 81% of revenue with Asia 39%, Europe 35%, LATAM 20%
items.quote: Revenue for the quarter stood at Rs. 190 crores, reflecting a 31% year-on-year growth. Demand remained strong during the quarter, but water shortages led to a deferment of sales of around Rs. 35 crores.

items.statement: EU audit for Ambernath facility scheduled for second half of November 2026
items.quote: So, we have already received the dates for audit from EU at Ambernath facility. The audit is scheduled for the second half of November.

items.statement: Block F at Lote not yet started; will begin in next couple of quarters
items.quote: We haven't started it yet. We will be starting it in next couple of quarters.

items.statement: Water shortage risk being mitigated through recycling for utilities; consultants engaged for long-term solution
items.quote: We are working with a lot of consultants on how we can further take up recycling of water. Because we are into API manufacturing, we can't use recycled water in our end product, but at least for the utility part of it, the cooling towers and all, how we are able to do that, that effort is ongoing.

items.statement: Customs matter sub judice; new export authorization received from Central Bureau of Narcotics; no provision made as consignment value minimal
items.quote: So, currently, the matter is still sub judice. However, one thing I would like to inform everyone is that we have already received the new export authorization from Central Bureau of Narcotics for the same consignment which in our opinion should regularize this particular export.

items.statement: Inventory at Rs. 230-240 crores (high due to planned maintenance); will liquidate over next 3-4 quarters as maintenance deferred
items.quote: Somewhere around Rs. 230 crores to Rs. 240 crores. It is on the higher side. Since the last quarter, we had planned for taking the maintenance, so we had started building up the inventory.

items.statement: SAP implementation underway; expected go-live in 4-5 months to strengthen systems for CDMO growth
items.quote: As we speak, we are actually under SAP implementation, so we will be live in another four to five months, we should be live with our SAP, which will further strengthen our internal system.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 141.8 cr, up 85% YoY and 25% QoQ; EBITDA Rs 41.6 cr at 29.4% margin; PAT Rs 25.2 cr at 17.8% margin
items.quote: In Q1 FY '27, we delivered our highest-ever quarterly revenue of Rs. 141.8 crores, registering a strong 85% year-on-year growth from Rs. 76.8 crores in Q1 FY '26 and a 25% sequential growth from Rs. 113.8 crores in Q4 FY '26.

items.statement: Confident of sustaining growth momentum in coming quarters based on visibility across existing programs and upcoming platforms
items.quote: With the visibility we currently have across existing programs and upcoming platforms, we remain confident in sustaining this growth momentum in the coming quarters.

items.statement: India capacity expansion: new automated transfer case line at Shirwal with 400 units/day (~120k/year); land available at Sirsi (25 acres) and Shirwal (10 acres)
items.quote: I believe we will have capacity on that line of 400 a day, about 120,000 a year on that new line, which will go into our Shirwal facility.

items.statement: Indonesia program: 70,000 transfer cases over 10-12 months; ~30% dispatched in Q1; balance over remaining months, may spill 1-2 months into next year
items.quote: The Indonesia order through our OEM customers in India is a kind of export order because 70,000 of our transfer cases are going to land up in Indonesia in the next 10 to 12 months.

items.statement: South Africa export shipments expected to start April 2028 - March 2029; same global pickup truck program as Indonesia
items.quote: Directionally, I can tell you, sometime next year, which means from April 28 to March of 29, we are expecting shipments to start to South Africa.

items.statement: EBITDA margin 29.4% in Q1 FY27 (up from 24.5% Q4 FY26); sustainable target 20-22%+; ROIC without cash ~32%
items.quote: EBITDA margin improved to 29.4% compared to 24.9% in Q1 of FY '26 and 24.5% in Q4 of FY '26, supported by a favourable product mix, higher contributions from exports, and better margins from the 4x4 products.

items.statement: Internal margin target: sustain 20-22%+ EBITDA vs industry average 14-17%; ROIC benchmark 18% per Mahindra leadership
items.quote: My proposition to you is if I can sustain 20% to 22% and above, I think that is a very fair offering we are giving you. And this is the mission that we are on.

items.statement: EV transmission schedules rising: quarterly run-rate moving from ~7-8 cr to 10-12 cr for next three quarters; PPAP approval received from Tata
items.quote: We were averaging 6.5, let's say, 7 to 8 crores a quarter on the EV products. Our forecasts now are in the region of 10 to 12.

items.statement: New growth pillars: LCV manual transmission beachhead contract starting FY29 (INR 100-150 cr potential); automatic transmission targeting H2 CY28 commercialization (INR 300-400 cr potential); front-wheel-drive AWD application (>Rs 30k/vehic
items.quote: And this is highly, this particular contract is a little modest, but it is the beachhead to go after business opportunities in India, which we believe will be anywhere from INR 100 crores to INR 150 crores and above.

items.statement: Automatic transmission programs expected to deliver INR 300-400 cr; seen as key to reach INR 1,000 cr revenue milestone
items.quote: We think that automatic transmission programs at a minimum will deliver INR 300 crores to INR 400 crores. So, at the end of the day, if you have to hit that holy grail of that benchmark of INR 1,000 crores, it is the automatic transmission, which will give us the afterburner thrust.

items.statement: Execution bandwidth challenged by simultaneous scaling of transfer cases, EV, components, exports, and new transmission programs; prioritizing and sequencing work
