items.statement: Shipway expected to grow 20%+ YoY from Q4 FY27 onwards
items.quote: With the investments that we are making, we are anticipating that this growth will improve to 20% plus from quarter 4 FY '27.

items.statement: Shipway targeted to reach adjusted EBITDA breakeven by Q3 FY27
items.quote: We are targeting to make Shipway breakeven in quarter 3 itself.

items.statement: Consolidated profitability improvement expected in H2 FY27 as front-loaded investments materialize
items.quote: Most of these investments will be front-loaded in H1 FY '27 with benefits expected to build through growth and operating leverage, leading to an improving profitability trajectory in H2 FY '27 and beyond.

items.statement: Investments of a few crores annually in AI product development, talent, and go-to-market expansion
items.quote: The investment in terms of absolute is in the range of a few crores and will continue for the current quarter, post which we anticipate some of these investments to start demonstrating results.

items.statement: Uniware standalone adjusted EBITDA margin improved from 32% to 35% run rate despite investments
items.quote: Uniware, even with investments, it has grown from 32% to 35% from an adjusted EBITDA run rate perspective.

items.statement: Uniware adjusted EBITDA margin expected to stay in 35-40% ballpark in H2 FY27
items.quote: Last year, it had gone to the 40% adjusted EBITDA margin levels as well. So it should stay in similar ballpark as we continue to see improvement in profitability in the second half of the year.

items.statement: Shipway to operate at breakeven level for next couple of years, reinvesting any profits
items.quote: We want to continue growing the business for the next couple of years, at least we want to operate it at a breakeven level.

items.statement: Added 115 enterprise customers in Q1 FY27, up 30.7% YoY
items.quote: During the quarter, we added 115 enterprise customers, up 30.7% compared to 88 in the same quarter last year.

items.statement: 40-45% of Uniware enterprise customers using quick commerce and B2B modules; UniReco at 6-7% attach rate; UniCapture at 3-4% attach rate
items.quote: 40% to 45% of our Uniware enterprise customers are now using quick commerce and B2B modules. 6% to 7% have adopted UniReco within a year of launch and 3% to 4% have taken up UniCapture within 2 quarters of its launch.

items.statement: Shipway operates in INR 4,000+ crore courier aggregation market with single-digit market share
items.quote: Shipway operates in courier aggregation, which is a large market opportunity. As per our estimates, it's INR4,000 crores plus market, where we are a relatively early-stage player, single-digit market share today.

items.statement: ESOP expense of INR 2.5-4 crores per quarter expected to continue for next year
items.quote: Over the period of next year, the spend would be trending in the similar range of INR2.5 crores to INR4 crores per quarter.

items.statement: Management guides for mid-teens revenue growth with stable EBITDA margins for the full year
items.quote: What we are guiding for is the business as a whole, which is for Belrise as a whole, which is mid-teens revenue growth with stable EBITDA margins.

items.statement: EBITDA margins expected to remain broadly stable at FY26 levels despite Q1 cost pressures
items.quote: We expect EBITDA margins to remain broadly stable as compared to FY26 levels.

items.statement: INR17,000 million QIP proceeds to be deployed primarily towards inorganic opportunities and select organic growth in FY27
items.quote: We intend to deploy a significant majority of these net proceeds within this fiscal year, primarily towards high-quality inorganic opportunities and also towards select organic growth initiatives.

items.statement: Renewable energy order for sheet metal assemblies supporting 2.5 GW annual supply, production starting Q4 FY27, peak revenue >INR1,500 million
items.quote: At peak volumes, the facility is expected to generate annual revenue in excess of INR1,500 million.

items.statement: Chassis system order for fast-growing 2W/3W OEM worth >INR650 million annual revenue, production starting Q4 FY27 at Bangalore brownfield
items.quote: The program is expected to generate annual revenue in excess of INR650 million and will be added to our existing brownfield facility in Bangalore, with start of production expected in Q4 of this fiscal year.

items.statement: 59 unique assemblies localization order for leading Indian 4W EV OEM, plus tooling/fixtures/automation design order
items.quote: We have been selected to manufacture 59 unique assemblies as part of their localization program for one of their highest-selling EV models.

items.statement: Aerospace & defense target: 10% of manufacturing revenue in short-to-medium term via acquisitions in Europe, North America, India
items.quote: Sumedh, already mentioned in the last earnings call that we want aerospace and defense to get to 10% of our manufacturing revenue in a short to medium term.

items.statement: Hyva India tipper business acquisition expected to close Q3 FY27; adds 3 manufacturing facilities (Pune, Jamshedpur, Bangalore)
items.quote: The transaction is currently progressing through the closing process and we expect to complete it during Q3 of this financial year.

items.statement: Input cost pressures (steel, polymer) peaked in Q1 FY27; back-to-back pricing model passes fluctuations to customers with slight lag
items.quote: I can say with a great amount of confidence that the worst is behind us in terms of cost pressures.

items.statement: Trading business declined 19% YoY due to Middle East crisis impacting logistics and demand; expected to normalize
items.quote: Due to the ongoing crisis in the Middle East, there was a lot of pressure in terms of business scenario in the Middle East over this quarter.

items.statement: H-One Japan technology collaboration concluded, enabling high tensile steel applications up to 1470 MPa (~3x India standard)
items.quote: We have also now successfully concluded our technology collaboration with H-One Japan during this quarter, thus strengthening our capabilities for high tensile steel applications up to 1470 megapascal, which is approximately 3x the industry standard today in India.

items.statement: Plasan Sasa partnership for armored vehicle assembly in India; Hyva heavy fabrication capabilities seen as synergistic
items.quote: We believe the heavy fabrication know-how, manufacturing processes, and capabilities that come with the Hyva business will be highly synergistic with this initiative and further strengthen our ability to address this massive opportunity.

items.statement: Industry price increases unsustainable due to weak demand and elevated Chinese supply; packaging costs 40% higher YoY
items.quote: Prices of several molecules remained under pressure as global supply remained elevated, particularly with continued availability of intermediates and technical products from China.

items.statement: Delayed monsoon caused delayed sowing, resowing, and cautious dealer stocking; Q1 demand shifted to subsequent quarters
items.quote: The delayed rainfall resulted in delayed sowing across several important agriculture markets. In certain regions, farmers had to reassess their crop plans or undertake resowing.

items.statement: 189 global registrations (120+ valid, 10+ under renewal); new registrations in Taiwan, Vietnam, Sri Lanka, Saudi Arabia; expanding in Africa, LatAm
items.quote: Overall, we have 189 registrations globally, of which more than 120 are valid and more than 10 are under renewal.

items.statement: El Nino declared; weak monsoon outlook for remainder of FY27; channel inventories low; raw material costs remain incrementally higher than last year
items.quote: We are not expecting very promising monsoons even in the coming days because this El Nino has already been declared.

items.statement: Two of three planned specialty products launched; new fungicide on track for Q2 launch subject to patent expiry; ICAR-IARI collaboration for heat/drought resistant products
items.quote: Two of the three speciality products planned for FY27 are already in the market, while our new fungicide remains on track for launch this quarter, subject to the relevant patent expiry.

items.statement: Expects LFL growth of 5-7% above passenger traffic in normalized years; targets LFL of 14-15% when passenger traffic grows 8-9%
items.quote: We've traditionally been where, we're used to passenger traffic somewhere around 8% to 9% in normal years, and drive maybe 5% to 7% more of LFL growth over that to kind of reach an LFL percentage maybe around 14% -15%.

items.statement: Expects strong H2 FY27 passenger traffic bounce-back as airlines restore long-haul international routes from September-October
items.quote: The expectation is H2 of this year should be a good bounce back on passenger traffic. And I think that's also been a call-out by many independent research, what they expect passenger traffic this year in India to be, a strong H2.

items.statement: Adjusted gross margin ~81% (within guided range); EBITDA margin 35.8% moderated due to pre-operating costs for new outlets at Noida, Cochin, Delhi
items.quote: Adjusting for this reclassification of INR223 million of lounge aggregation cost from other expenses to cost of sales, the adjusted gross profit stands at INR3.65 billion, translating into an adjusted gross profit margin of around 81%, which remains well within our guided range.

items.statement: Net contract gains of 15.9% system-wide YoY; historically in 15-16% ballpark but lumpy year-to-year
items.quote: We sustained strong momentum in new outlet openings, backed by recent contract wins and a robust pipeline, which translated into net contract gains of 15.9% year-on-year at the system-wide level.

items.statement: Launched passenger services (meet-and-greet, porter) at Noida under Elite Assist brand; integrating into EATS tech platform for cross-selling
items.quote: Another important milestone during the quarter was the successful launch of our passenger services at Noida International Airport under our Elite Assist brand, including meet-and-greet and porter services.

items.statement: Debt-free balance sheet with INR9.7B cash as of June 30; provides headroom for airport expansions, lounges, highways, passenger services
items.quote: As of June 30th, we maintain a debt-free balance sheet and a consolidated cash balance of approximately INR9.7 billion.

items.statement: International expansion focus shifting to Asia (Indonesia entity set up) while Middle East normalizes; Dubai entity established for Middle East opportunities
items.quote: We have set up an entity in Dubai to focus at the region. We set up another entity recently in Indonesia to look at opportunities there because you need those local entities to be able to bid for opportunities in the markets.

items.statement: Targeted turnover for FY27 is INR 850 crore and for FY28 is INR 1,200 crore
items.quote: Sir, targeted turnover for the FY26-27 is almost INR 850 crores and for FY27-28 is INR 1,200 crores.

items.statement: Total work order including recent toll wins is INR 900 crore (EPC ~INR 500 crore, toll ~INR 400 crore)
items.quote: Recently we secured INR 120 crores new toll projects in Tamil Nadu. And so, adding this, we have INR 900 crores of work order, out of which EPC is almost INR 500 crores and the rest for toll segment.

items.statement: Traffic trends improving and near normal levels after geopolitical disruptions impacted Moti Naroli toll plaza in Q1
items.quote: And you can also see it on the IHMCL website. So, naturally, we are almost near normal to what the earlier traffic was.

items.statement: EBITDA margin drop in Q1 due to geopolitical factors; recovery expected if no new developments
items.quote: Yes, I think so. And even so, I think there was a drop in our EBITDA margin recently because of this geopolitical situation recently. And so, going forward, I think, and if there are no new developments on that front, we should be good.

items.statement: Voluntary surrender of a toll project with unfavorable economics due to geopolitical disruptions
items.quote: A temporary bidding restriction from NHAI and the voluntary surrender of a toll project where economics had been unfavorable due to the same reason.

items.statement: Current weakness from geopolitical factors will not significantly impact full-year results; recovery in H2 as per seasonal trend
items.quote: Actually, this won't have a significant impact on the full-year results because, based on past trends, we tend to hover around the break-even point during the first and second quarters, while seeing a rapid recovery in the third and fourth quarters.

items.statement: FY27 maize crushing target above 400,000 tons vs 265,000 tons in FY26
items.quote: This year, we are expecting that the crushing will go up above 4,00,000 tons in the entire year.

items.statement: Value-added products expected to reach 20-22% of turnover in FY27 from 3% in FY26
items.quote: This year, we are expecting it to go up to 20 %-22% of our entire turnover as value -added products.

items.statement: Major capex cycle substantially complete; Rs 552 crore spent of Rs 664 crore total outlay by June 2026
items.quote: Of the total project outlay of approximately Rs. 664 crores, around Rs. 552 crores had been incurred as of 30 June 2026, with the major phase of CAPEX cycle now substantially behind us.

items.statement: Value-added margin expanded to 39.8% in Q1 FY27 from 25.1% in Q1 FY26 driven by shift to manufacturing-led revenue
items.quote: Value-added grew 30.3% year -on-year to Rs. 80.53 crores, with value -added margin expanded to 39.8% from 25.1% in Q1 FY26 , driven by a decisive shift towards higher margin, manufacturing led revenue.

items.statement: Export contribution doubled to 10.4% in Q1 FY27 from 4.9% in Q1 FY26; targeting further geographic diversification
items.quote: Contribution from exports more than doubled to 10.4% in quarter 1 '27 from 4.9% in quarter 1 '26, reflecting growing acceptance of our products across international markets.

items.statement: New value-added products include Liquid Glucose (180 TPD), Maltodextrin (50 TPD); Modified starches and Dextrose variants planned for FY27

items.statement: Net debt Rs 735.32 crore; peak debt in H1 FY27, expected to decline in H2 as working capital normalizes
items.quote: Our working capital requirement is highest in the H1. So, that's why the debt is peaking. And definitely, it is going to come down when the H2 comes.

items.statement: Long-term value-added capacity mix designed at 50:50 starch:value-added; FY28 turnover mix guided at 30-35% value-added
items.quote: Capacity, so automatically 35% will happen. Turnover automatically 30%-35%. Total turnover.

items.statement: Target to cross INR500 crores consolidated revenue in FY27 with 12-15% growth
items.quote: We continue to work towards our stated objective of crossing INR500 crores in consolidated revenue during the FY 27, while maintaining appropriate discipline on margins and working capital.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded 121 bps to 7.99%; management expects 1-2% EBITDA margin improvement over next 2 years from technology mix shift
items.quote: I would expect at least an increase of about 1% to 2% in the EBITDA area over the next 2 years or so.

items.statement: Wage hikes passed to clients with 3-month DSO lag; temporary working capital impact

items.statement: INR1 crore investment for HDFC command center setup; skill development centers require capex for labs and training infrastructure
items.quote: The investment, currently the investment that we are looking at is around a INR1 crores to set up the entire control room, wooden wall panels, et cetera.

items.quote: Yes so currently as on June 2026 IPO funds which are available is around INR36.85 crores.

items.statement: GeM bidding at 3.85% margin compresses government manpower contracts; CCTV segment loss in Q1 due to project execution timing
items.quote: Government contracts, you are aware in terms of the GeM bidding, nowadays they have brought down the percentage to 3.85%. So at L1 everybody is bidding at 3.85%.

items.statement: Net debt: standalone INR69 crores, consolidated INR82 crores; cash INR60 crores (standalone June); working capital ~90 days; client retention 96-97%
items.quote: At a standalone basis, it is around INR69 crores and on a consolidated basis it is around INR82 crores.

items.statement: Long-term revenue target of INR600-700 crores in 2-3 years with healthier profitability
items.quote: I believe that INR600 crores to INR700 crores figure long-term revenue targets are still in place.

items.statement: Expect meaningful improvement in returns from strategic investments in 3-6 quarters
items.quote: So, the answer would be in 3 quarters to 6 quarters I think we can start seeing results of these strategic investments.

items.statement: Consolidated PAT declined to INR2.2 crores from INR6.51 crores YoY due to higher freight and employee costs
items.quote: On a consolidated basis, PBT stood at INR3.04 crores compared with INR7.26 crores, and PAT stood at INR2.2 crores compared with INR6.51 crores.

items.statement: Shipping costs increased significantly; company absorbing partial hit while passing some to purchase and sales prices
items.quote: We are taking the hit, but we are still able to grow on revenue. We are taking partial hit and we are taking -- where we are partially trying to supply, like, pass it on to the suppliers also, like, at the time of purchase, and partially trying to pass it at the time of sales.

items.statement: No fixed capex; investments in inventory, manpower, and marketing are transient and growing quarter-on-quarter
items.quote: All the investments made are transient in nature. None of them are fixed investments or any plant machinery capex purchases, etcetera, which has a certain timeline of 3-year break even or whatever.

items.statement: Inventory conversion cycle runs over 2 quarters; INR96.8 crores consolidated inventory as of June 30, 2026
items.quote: As of June 30, 2026, our consolidated inventory stood at about INR96.8 crores, with around INR84.4 crores positioned at our overseas subsidiaries.

items.statement: Target equal revenue mix across new customized equipment, used/refurbished equipment, and HexL in 2-3 years
items.quote: I think if all the three verticals are equal in our revenue mix, I think we would be happy enough.

items.statement: Geopolitical developments increasing freight/logistics costs and elongating shipping times and working capital cycles
items.quote: The ongoing geopolitical developments across various regions have continued to create operational and logistical challenges, particularly for the businesses with significant international exposure, such as ours.

items.statement: Employee benefit expenses rose to INR3.83 crores from INR2.21 crores YoY to build international sales and operations team
items.quote: Consolidated employee benefit expenses increased to approximately INR3.83 crores from INR2.21 crores in the corresponding period last year.

items.statement: Full-year revenue growth guidance revised up from 50% to 70% YoY for FY27, with potential to trail higher in coming quarters
items.quote: So, we would like to revise our guidance for the full year to 70% considering the robust demand which is there and the capacities that we are ready with in Ratlam. And we would like to also highlight one thing that we can trail this guidance in the coming quarters as the year progress.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance maintained at sustainable to improve from current 18.9% level for FY27
items.quote: So, I'd like to reiterate that point only. So, we will continue our margin guidance from sustainable to improve for the year. So, we have reported a 18.9% margin, so we continue that guidance.

items.statement: Cumulative gross block including CWIP expected to reach Rs 1,300 crore by end of FY27 from Rs 800 crore at start of year
items.quote: On the capex front, ma'am. When we start this year, we were close to 800 including CWIP and we are by the end of this year, it will be close to 1.300.

items.statement: Channel partner network expanded to 10,100+ (80+ distributors, 1,000+ dealers, 30+ exclusive Shoppes added in Q1); target 15,000+ by end of FY28
items.quote: At the end of 28, we believe more than 15,000 Network partaers including Shoppe? Including Shoppe, dealer and distributor, 15,000.

items.statement: FY27 revenue guidance and PAT margin of 5-6% reaffirmed
items.quote: We remain aligned with the FY27 revenue guidance and PAT margin in the range of 5% to 6%.

items.statement: Order book visibility at INR3,400 crore across confirmed POs, signed MSAs, and advanced discussions
items.quote: On order book visibility, currently stands at approximately INR3,400 crore.

items.statement: Executable order pipeline of INR845.84 crore targeted for execution by December 31, 2026
items.quote: Together, these orders represent an executable order pipeline of INR845.84 crore targeted for the execution by the December 31st, 2026.

items.statement: Cell line capex revised to INR1,050 crore (INR700 crore debt, INR350 crore equity) for 2.2 GW first phase
items.quote: At present, INR1,050 crore, out of which INR700 crore from the principal lenders and INR350 crore will be our margin.

items.statement: 2.2 GW N-type TOPCon+ cell line on track for commissioning by end of calendar year 2027
items.quote: The 2.2 GW N-type TOPCon+ cell line, which is the first phase of our planned 5 GW cell capacity, is on track for commissioning by end of calendar year 2027.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin 12.7% vs 16.4% YoY; PAT margin 3.1% due to seasonally softer volumes and full quarter depreciation/interest impact
items.quote: EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR33.8 crore as against the INR42.7 crore in Q1 FY26, translating into an EBITDA margin of 12.7% for the quarter as compared to 16.4% in Q1 FY26.

items.statement: H2-weighted execution expected; order conversions accelerating post-monsoon with ALMM clarity
items.quote: The situation will be improved once the monsoon gets over and then there will be a lot of pressure in execution of projects and delivery of modules for both the segments.

items.statement: FY27 module utilization assumption 55% (down from ~70% in FY26) due to industry disruption and cell supply constraints
items.quote: For FY27, we are working with an average utilization assumption of around 55% across the year.

items.statement: ALMM-2 caused temporary delivery rescheduling but no order cancellations; domestic cell supply arrangements in place for DCR orders
items.quote: These are the timing shifts and not cancellations. We do not currently see any orders at risk and whether ALMM is extended at any stage or not, there is no impact on our order book.

items.statement: Cell line funding: INR700 crore debt at advanced stage, INR350 crore equity (NCDs/CCDs) in due diligence
items.quote: On funding, the debt component of approximately INR700 crore is at an advanced stage of discussion with our lender, and the equity component of INR350 crore structured as a combination of NCDs and CCDs is progressing through the due diligence stage.

items.statement: BSE listing completed (existing shares, no fresh capital); shareholder base 11,000+
items.quote: Solex Energy is now listed on both the NSE and the BSE. Kindly note, this was a listing of existing shares on the BSE main board. No fresh capital was raised.

items.statement: Indian TOPCon cell cost higher than imported Chinese cells; DCR tenders priced accordingly
items.quote: Those tenders which are already bidded with the domestic cells are bidded with the higher price considering the high cost of cell. The Indian cell cost will be higher compared to the imported right now.

items.statement: Vision 2030: 10 GW module, 10 GW cell, 10 GW BESS, 2 GW wafer/ingot; INR4,000 crore Gujarat MoU signed
items.quote: The INR4,000 crore MoU we have signed with the Government of Gujarat is the first concrete step in that direction.

items.statement: Management expects sustainable good earnings for next 6 to 8 quarters on favorable BOPET supply-demand.
items.quote: So , all this give us confidence that we should have sustainable good earnings going forward, not only for the next 3 quarters, but I would go on to say, for next 6 to 8 quarters.

items.statement: Company expects to reach INR2,000-2,200 crore revenue in next 2-3 years.
items.quote: Yes. I think we are steadily marching towards that, and we should definitely be hitting there in next 2 years to 3 years.

items.statement: Targeting VAS products at 50-60% of film volumes over next 2-3 years.
items.quote: Encouraged by the recent performance and positive outcomes of our strategic focus, we are targeting proportion of VAS products at about 50% to 60% over the next 2 to 3 years.

items.statement: VAS contribution expected up to 35% of portfolio by exit quarter this fiscal.
items.quote: See, we are seeing up to 35% contribution of VAS product out of our own -- up to the overall portfolio by the quarter end, I mean, in the exit quarter.

items.statement: Specialty Polymers targeting 20% CAGR over next 3-5 years; FY27 flat to single-digit growth.
items.quote: We are targeting growth at a CAGR of 20% over the next 3 to 5 years in the Specialty Polymer segment.

items.statement: Specialty Polymers revenue growth expected to recover by end of this financial year.
items.quote: However, given the strength of our business development pipeline, we expect to recover the revenue growth in this business by the end of this financial year.

items.statement: Specialty Polymers EBIT margin may moderate in percentage terms but absolute EBITDA/EBIT to grow.
items.quote: But you are right. As we go forward, we are g oing to see some moderation of the percentage margins, right? Because the mid-margin is going to pull down the high specialty margins a little bit in percentage terms.

items.statement: 12-micron commodity film spreads were INR28-30 last quarter and are holding resilient.
items.quote: So, spreads last quarter were in the range of INR28 to INR30. When I say spread, I mean VA, value-add over raw material for 12-micron film.

items.statement: BOPET supply-demand balance expected to hold for next 6-8 quarters, keeping margins steady.
items.quote: See, like I told you that we are very positive that for next 6 quarters to 8 quarters, the global and domestic supply-demand balance is going to hold. And I think that is going to give us some respite and is going to keep the margin steady.

items.statement: Only 2-3 new BOPET lines expected in next 1.5-2 years; demand growth outpacing capacity.
items.quote: We are expecting another 2 to 3 lines coming up in the next 1.5 to 2 years.

items.statement: No major capex planned apart from sustenance and maintenance capex.
items.quote: No. So, apart from our sustenance and maintenance capex, we are not planning any major capex.

items.statement: Debt repayment target of INR100 crores this year; gross debt to fall to INR620 crores.
items.quote: So, this year, the debt repayment target is around INR100 crores.

items.statement: ELITe JV to raise additional debt in JV company, not on Ester balance sheet; not consolidated.
items.quote: So, there is going to be additional debt, which will be raised in the JV company, not in Ester balance sheet.

items.statement: ELITe facility targeted operational in CY2028; land acquisition to conclude in 2 months.
items.quote: The facility is targeted to become operational in CY 2028 and will use Loop's proprietary depolymerization technology to convert 100% textile waste streams into virgin -quality monomers, which will then be polymerized into virgin-quality polyester resin.

items.statement: Expects FMCG revenue to cross INR12,500 crores in FY27, up from INR11,000+ crores in FY26
items.quote: Last year our total sales from overall FMCG including the HPC was INR11,000 crores plus, and this year my estimation is that we should certainly cross increase it by 10% plus and we should be somewhere closer to INR12,500 crores in our revenues.

items.statement: TSP EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 16-18% for the year
items.quote: We are quite confident that we will continue the guidance that we have always given that our margins will be 16% to 18% on the TSP. I think we will be able to maintain that.

items.statement: Edible oil EBITDA margin construct guided between 3-5% volume growth, aiming for consistent 5%+ margins
items.quote: How do we increase our margin construct typically what we say between 2% and 4% towards consistently 5-plus percent will be a big driver of growth.

items.statement: Staples volume grew 5% with 12% pricing inflation in Q1 FY27; rural demand caution flagged for current quarter
items.quote: The volumes have grown by 5% and the pricing inflation that came in was almost about 12%.

items.statement: E-commerce and quick commerce revenue contribution at 15% currently, targeting 20% within 18 months
items.quote: Currently, if I were to put those numbers together, we right now do close to about 15% between modern trade and e-commerce, quick commerce. We want to take that number up to 20%.

items.statement: Oil palm cultivated area 1,15,861 hectares as of June 2026, 37% in prime yielding phase (7-25 years)
items.quote: As of 30th June '26, the cultivated area stood at 1,15,861 hectares with nearly 37% of the area in the prime yielding phase of 7 to 25 years, against total allocated area of 6.63 lakh hectares.

items.statement: Calibrated price increases in edible oils; targeted discounts and smaller pack sizes in FMCG to remain competitive
items.quote: We took calibrated price increases in the edible oil segment while using targeted discounts in our FMCG portfolio to remain competitive. We also introduced smaller pack sizes to address changing consumer needs and market requirements.

items.statement: HPC acquisition (INR1,100 crores slump sale) generated INR600 crores EBITDA last year; already repaid acquisition cost
items.quote: It was generating a margin of INR600 crores, and we have paid INR1,100 crores which is less than 18, 19 months of profitability and which has already in last 18 months it has already repaid that much and built up assets substantially.

items.statement: Revenue guidance of Rs 300 crore for FY27 reaffirmed; Q1 FY27 revenue at Rs 60.95 crore, balance order book of Rs 150 crore to be executed this year plus pipeline orders by March
items.quote: Sir we have done already 60 in Q1. And the balance about 150 crores, the order book that also needs to be finished in this financial year. And definitely there are some orders in pipeline which also we would need to do it by March. So 300 we are in line Sir.

items.statement: Fabrication capacity being expanded from ~6,000 tons to 18,000 tons/year (1,500 tons/month) at Tedesra Unit for power sector and fabricated bogies
items.quote: Sir, we would be in a position to do about 1500 tons a month about what the plan is that capacity is 1500 tons a month that is about 18,000 tons. So that is but at the moment what we are doing is about without this capacity expansion we are doing about 6000, from 6000 we want to grade it at least 6000 or 7000, 8000 ton

items.statement: PAT margin target maintained at 15-20% for EPC projects; overall PAT margins expected to improve via niche complex products despite railway/power fabrication at similar margins
items.quote: Anything because of its because of the kind of things that are associated with the EPC project. That is again that I am making the box smaller. If anything less than 15 to 20%, we are not interested. So that is why my box is very small.

items.statement: Strong demand across steel, power, railways, defence, oil & gas, shipbuilding; multiple sectors opening simultaneously with broader opportunity landscape than ever before
items.quote: Across thermal and power, railways, defence, oil and gas, shipbuilding, multiple opportunities have opened for the company at the same time. These opportunities are clearly visible to us.

items.statement: Strategic shift to faster-moving products (railway bogies 30-45 day cycle, power fabrication via RXIL/Invoice Mart at 30-35 days) to reduce operating cycle from ~120 days to 60-70 days by FY28
items.quote: By FY28, we expect an operating cycle with the much more controlled and disciplined working capital structure, with a targeting days of 60 to 70 days.

items.statement: Defence revenue share targeted at 5-10% in FY27 and 10-15% in FY28 (including shipbuilding); collaborating with ordnance factories (e.g., Gun Carriage Factory Jabalpur) for hardware/components using flexible machining
items.quote: It will be 5 to 10% because I would add the shipbuilding to the same. So it will be 10 to 15% and it will continue to be 10 to 15% in the next financial year also.

items.statement: Management declined to provide FY27 revenue growth guidance, stating it would not be prudent to give a number at this time.
items.quote: I don't think it will be prudent to give you any number at this time.

items.statement: Russia licensing arrangement for Exblifep has estimated 10-year value of approximately USD178 million.
items.quote: In Russia, the estimated 10-year value of our licensing arrangement is approximately USD178 million.

items.statement: 7-ACA pricing stable at weighted average ~USD60 for last 10-12 years; limited room for drastic price reduction by Chinese suppliers.
items.quote: The pricing in 7-ACA has been stable over the last 10 to 12 years. The weighted average is about USD60. So, we believe that there is not much room to reduce prices drastically.

items.statement: Regulated market demand typically stronger in H2 (winter season); Q1 FY27 described as mediocre for regulated products.
items.quote: last year trend, we have seen that the second half is generally having more demand from the regulated. It's probably the winter season there.

items.statement: 7-ACA project ramp-up uncertain; guided 12 months to full utilization but may take longer per Aurobindo experience.
items.quote: We've guiding 12 months, but you know -- and I have said that again earlier that Aurobindo looking at other experience, it might be longer.

items.statement: Cefixime margins under maximum stress in rest-of-world markets due to pricing pressure.
items.quote: Cefixime as a product is under maximum stress with respect to margins.

items.statement: 7-ACA commercial batch target March 2027; ramp-up to 80-100% utilization by end of first year; long-term split 80% captive, 20% third-party sales.
items.quote: Our ramp-up plan is to go to about 80% to 100% by the end of the first year. Initially, it would be slow and then increasing progressively. With respect to utilization, our long-term guidance on this is 80% in-house use and 20% selling to third party.

items.statement: Cefiderocol facility commissioning target December 2026; validation and initial batches Jan-Mar 2027; commercial launch subject to DCGI approval.
items.quote: We target commissioning by December of '26, followed by validation and initial batches during January to March '27 period. Commercial launch will be subject to the approval process from DCGI.

items.statement: Exblifep Europe volumes grew 300% in Q3 FY26, 170% in Q4 FY26, and 50% in Q1 FY27 quarter-over-quarter.
items.quote: In Europe, the business is growing at a steady manner whilst volumes grew by approximately 300% in Q3 of '26, 170% in Q4 of '26, and about 50% in Q1 of '27.

items.statement: NP-NC segment revenue ~INR21 crores in Q1 FY27; working on new molecules and backward integration.
items.quote: So, this quarter sales was INR21 crores, and we are working on a couple of molecules. We are also planning to scale up and backward integrate in these molecules also.

items.statement: Full-year volume target of 10-12 million tons may see 10% variance, implying 9-11 million tons.
items.quote: As mentioned, we have given a target of 10 to 12 and we expect maybe there may be a 10% variance into this target. So we can consider like a 9 to 11 kind of a range.

items.statement: Confident of achieving or exceeding 15 million tons bauxite volume guidance by FY28.
items.quote: We remain confident in our ability to achieve or even cross our guidance of 15 million tons by financial year ’28.

items.statement: Expects around USD1 billion (~INR10,000 crores) bauxite sales at 15 million tons baseline.
items.quote: So even picking that as a baseline kind of number for the next financial year, we can think that around you know, almost about billion dollars of sales we are expecting from bauxite as per the company's plan.

items.statement: EBITDA per ton expected to stay around USD5.5-6 in next one to two quarters.
items.quote: So around USD6 or USD5.5 to USD6 would be a reasonable, expectation.

items.statement: Medium-to-long term EBITDA per ton expected to return closer to earlier ~USD10 levels.
items.quote: So at least we should able to achieve over a medium to longer term closer to the EBITDAs we were achieving earlier which was near USD10.

items.statement: EBITDA to improve significantly possibly in next calendar year as freight normalizes and quota system kicks in.
items.quote: So, we expect EBITDA to improve significantly from now, maybe in the sort of next calendar year, at least this is our expectation.

items.statement: Planning capex of close to INR200 crores across India business verticals.
items.quote: As stated previously, we are also planning a capex close to INR200 crores across various projects and business verticals.

items.statement: Boffa port capacity enhanced to 8 million tons; GSM new jetty to be operational by Q4 FY27 raising capacity to 10 MT.
items.quote: At GSM, the second port, the new jetty is currently under construction and expected to be operational by Q4 of this financial year, increasing capacity from 6 million tons to 10 million tons per annum.

items.statement: Combined port capacity to reach approximately 23 million tons supporting medium-term volume growth.
items.quote: With these developments, our combined port capacity will reach to approximately 23 million tons, providing us with the infrastructure to support the maximized volume growth and sales over the medium terms.

items.statement: Bauxite washing plant of 20,000 tons per day set up; expansion would take about one year if decided.
items.quote: I think the fundamental purpose of bauxite washing plant might be EBITDA neutral but it definitely helps us to increase our total volume and throughput which we can do from a particular location because it makes the more low grade resources into high grade and exportable resources.

items.statement: Guinea bauxite export quota system expected before end of this year, seen as positive for prices.
items.quote: We believe this could be introduced in the near terms and certainly before end of this year.

items.statement: Realizations to remain close to similar levels until quota system provides directional tailwind.
items.quote: I think that the realizations may remain close to similar levels for time being until we have -- I think any kind of directional tailwind would probably come in from the quota system.

items.statement: Four new Chinese refineries expected to add 20-30 million tons bauxite demand over current volumes.
items.quote: Several new refineries are coming on stream, including the four new refineries in China which are expected to create additional bauxite demand of around 20 million tons to 30 million tons over the above current volumes.

items.statement: Freight rates highly volatile; expects volatility to continue across 2027, pressuring margins.
items.quote: The freight rates remains highly volatile. Given the current geopolitical environments, we expect this volatility to continue across 2027.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 expected to produce around 500 wagons versus 300-odd wagons in Q1.
items.quote: We hope to do around 500 wagons in the quarter as compared to 300 and odd wagons in the first quarter.

items.statement: Wagon manufacturing to grow about 45-50%, other businesses 8-10%.
items.quote: whereas the wagon manufacturing would show a growth of approximately more than 45% to 50%.

items.statement: Targets 15-17% EBITDA margin for freight wagon business over medium term.
items.quote: We are targeting an EBITDA margin of 15% to 17% for the freight wagon business over the medium term, with increasing utilization of the existing platform being an important driver towards achieving this objective.

items.statement: Targets 13-15% EBITDA margin for rolling stock interior and allied business segment.
items.quote: We are targeting an EBITDA margin of 13% to 15% for the rolling stock interior and allied business segment supported by passenger coach modernization, new train additions, and expansion to ORVIN, which is the artificial leather business brand, applications and further backward integrations to improve our profitability.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin expected at 15% to 17%.
items.quote: The EBITDA margin has already been also indicated and mentioned. We expect about 15% to 17%.

items.statement: Consolidated order book as of August 11, 2026: INR1,692 crores, with wagons INR1,526 crores.
items.quote: As of August 11, 2026, our consolidated order book stood at approximately INR 1,692 crores, comprising INR1,526 crores of wagon at OFPL and INR 166 crores in the coach interior at Oriental Rail Infrastructure.

items.statement: OFPL order book of INR1,526 crores equals approximately 3,800 wagons.
items.quote: The number of wagons is approximately 3800 wagons.

items.statement: Plans to execute OFPL orders at 200 wagons per month from Q3 FY27.
items.quote: We project to execute at the rate of 200 wagons per month from quarter three of the present financial year.

items.statement: Capacity expansion from 2,400 to 3,600 wagons to cost roughly INR60-70 crores.
items.quote: The capex requirement for wagon expansion from 2,400 wagons to 3,600 wagons would be roughly about INR60 crores to INR70 crores.

items.statement: Plans to expand wagon capacity to 4,800 wagons over 12-18 months from FY28, phased via 3,600.
items.quote: In the long run, over a period of say 12 months to 18 months to 4,800 wagons.

items.statement: Revenue mix: wagons ~75%, seat and berths 16%, rexine upholstery ~5%, other 4%.
items.quote: Looking at the consolidated revenue mix, wagons accounted for approximately 75% of revenue, followed by seat and berths at 16%, rexine upholstery at approximately 5% and other products at 4%.

items.statement: Smart wagon JV with HUM targets INR750 crores annual revenue from 30,000 units at INR2.5-3 lakh each.
items.quote: So we are targeting a revenue of about INR750 crores from this business segment per year.

items.statement: AAR certification being pursued to align with global rail quality standards and support international expansion.
items.quote: We are also applying for AAR certification which is intent to align our manufacturing capacity with global rail quality standards and support our expansion into international markets, which will be a big revenue booster.

items.statement: Expects standalone full-year EBITDA margin of 17%-18% after factoring in price increases.
items.quote: So, with the factoring in, price increases coming in, we are expecting the full year to end at 17%-18% EBITDA margin for the standalone business.

items.statement: Expects FY28 top-line growth in mid-teens and consolidated EBITDA margins of 19%-20%.
items.quote: So, the top-line growth should be in mid -teens, 12%-13% growth, and we are hoping to reach at a consolidated level EBITDA margins of about 19%-20%.

items.statement: Expects current year revenue growth to cross double digits, including the IDBI Bank mandate.
items.quote: No. Including this IDBI Bank, we will have double -digit growth is what our expectation is for the current year.

items.statement: Sought significant price revision from all customers, expecting it to materialize in the current quarter.
items.quote: The company has sought significant price revision with all its customers and expects the same to materialize in the current quarter.

items.statement: Price revision negotiations with banks expected to complete in Q2, effective July or September-October.
items.quote: In Q2, we expect to complete the negotiation.

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin fell to 13.5% from 15.9% on higher manpower and gunmen costs.
items.quote: Our standalone EBITDA margins for the quarter Q1 FY27 dropped to 13.5% from 15.9% in the same quarter last year.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved marginally to 11.01% from 10.7% on narrowing Acemoney losses.
items.quote: The consolidated EBITDA margin for the quarter improved marginally to 11.01% from 10.7% in the previous quarter due to narrowing down losses in Radiant Acemoney.

items.statement: Direct clients rose to 18.4% of revenues from 14.3% a year earlier; future growth to come from direct clients.
items.quote: Direct clients accounted for 18.4% of our revenues for this quarter, up from 14.3% in the same period last year.

items.statement: Acemoney expects to break even in September and be EBITDA positive for the full quarter in Q3.
items.quote: And we expect it to narrow down further and break-even in the month of September and for the full quarter will be in Q3.

items.statement: Targets deploying over 50,000 Soundboxes in the current financial year, with 60%-70% already in order book.
items.quote: Radiant Acemoney currently provides Soundbox both on outright and rental models and has a target to deploy over 50,000 Soundboxes in the current financial year.

items.statement: Acemoney has over 20,000 BCs, cumulatively deployed over 58,000 Soundboxes, and facilitated Rs. 170 crores transaction volume in Q1.
items.quote: Currently, we have a network of over 20,000 BCs, cumulatively deployed over 58,000 Soundboxes so far, and facilitated a transaction volume of Rs. 170 crores in Q1 FY27.

items.statement: Radiant Valuable Logistics reported Rs. 22.1 million revenue, up 24% sequentially, targeting positive EBITDA this year.
items.quote: Radiant Valuable Logistics reported revenues of Rs. 22.1 million, reporting sequential growth of 24% in Q 1FY27 over Q4FY26, and is well on its way to achieve positive EBITDA in the current financial year.

items.statement: Manpower costs rising 8%-9% annually due to minimum wage hikes and licensed gunmen shortage in southern states.
items.quote: But own employee costs, because of inflationary nature, has increased at about 8 %- 9% every year, whereas our revenue growth has not been.

items.statement: Payment aggregator licence application to be resubmitted by end-August or early September; expects licence by early 2027.
items.quote: We will be resubmitting the application maybe by the end of this month or in the first week of September. Once that is submitted, we expect the application, we expect to get the application in hand by early next year, by January or February 27.

items.statement: FY27 launch pipeline of INR1,600 crores with quarterly phasing: Q2 INR240 crores, Q3 INR800-880 crores, Q4 INR480 crores
items.quote: So, the launch pipeline in total for this financial year is about INR1,600 crores. The launch pipeline, if I give you a synopsis, we are planning to roughly launch about INR240 crores in quarter two, almost about INR800 crores to INR880 crores in quarter three and about INR480 crores in quarter four.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10-15% YoY
items.quote: So close to 10%- 15% growth we will achieve as compared to the last financial year.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance range of 35-37% for next 2 years
items.quote: It will be in the range of 35% to 37%.

items.statement: FY27 presales guidance of INR700 crores for residential plus commercial portfolio
items.quote: Overall, we're going to be targeting a presales of about INR700 crores, both put together. But internal thing will be higher. But right now, we'll be guiding for INR700 crores.

items.statement: Target to sell minimum 1 lakh sq ft additional in One Business Bay during FY27
items.quote: But we are seeing good traction, and our target is to at least minimum sell a further 1 lakh square feet in One Business Bay. That's our minimum target.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin at 37.5%
items.quote: EBITDA increased to INR55 crores from INR50 crores, representing a 9% year-on-year growth in the EBITDA, while EBITDA margin stood at close to 37.5%.

items.statement: One Business Bay commercial project achieving avg INR50,000/sq ft with scope for price appreciation as construction progresses
items.quote: So see, right now, I mean, we've achieved roughly about an average of INR50,000 per square foot. So I think there will be appreciation as a project goes along, right?

items.statement: Strong sales traction in Suraj One Business Bay with 33% inventory sold post launch; healthy absorption across residential and commercial
items.quote: Suraj One Business Bay, our marquee commercial development in Mahim has witnessed strong sales traction since its launch with approximately 33% of inventory sold post launch, demonstrating healthy demand and strong absorption for our commercial offering.

items.statement: Current inventory mainly in commercial and Value Luxury segments; Luxury segment launches planned post society tie-ups
items.quote: So actually, in the Luxury segment, as we speak, we do not have a lot of inventory in the ongoing projects. It is majorly the commercial project and the Value Luxury, which we have inventory.

items.statement: Net debt INR614 crores as of June 2026 (gross debt INR646.94 crores, cash INR33.03 crores); debt expected to rise temporarily with new launches then decline
items.quote: As of June 2026, the company's net debt stood at INR614 crores, primarily reflecting capital deployment towards business development activities, strategic acquisitions and investments in ongoing and upcoming projects.

items.statement: Expects better ADR and stronger revenue from October to March; H2 better than H1.
items.quote: Therefore, we expect to achieve better ADR and stronger revenue from October to March, while April to June is comparatively slower.

items.statement: Hopeful of around 5% YoY ADR growth for the year.
items.quote: We are expecting, we are quite hopeful.

items.statement: Top line and bottom line will improve this year with Devprayag and Bandhavgarh additions.
items.quote: So, these three products are such that this year, our top line and bottom line will improve both the numbers.

items.statement: Expects H2 FY27 EBITDA margins better than same period last year.
items.quote: We expect our margins in the second half to be better compared with the same period last year.

items.statement: Aims to maintain 30% EBITDA margin; new properties initially lower it.
items.quote: we try our best to maintain 30% but when new properties come in, they lower the numbers but when it becomes stable.

items.statement: Mathura project total cost ₹49 crore; ₹32 crore HDFC loan at 8.14%.
items.quote: The Mathura project has a total project cost of ₹49 crore. Out of this, around ₹17 crore will be funded internally, of which ₹11.5 crore is the IPO component, and the balance will be managed through other sources. We have financed ₹ 32 crore through HDFC Bank.

items.statement: Sheopur Fort total budget ₹25 crore; ₹17.5 crore HDFC loan; 35-40 rooms this year.
items.quote: Our objective is to complete the entire project within the overall ₹25 crore budget. Around ₹10.5 crore will be funded through internal accruals, while we are taking a loan of approximately ₹17.5 crore from HDFC Bank.

items.statement: Kukru Jungle Camp 15-20 tents, investment ₹7-7.5 crore, operational by end FY28.
items.quote: Our plan is to set up good 15-20 tents. So, we will invest around 7-7.5 crores in this project.

items.statement: Devprayag 22 rooms, max expenditure within ₹1 crore to operationalize.
items.quote: Overall, we expect the maximum expenditure to be within ₹1 crore to make the property operational.

items.statement: Mathura and Sheopur to open in FY28; Kukru by end FY28.
items.quote: So, Mathura and Sheopur will come in FY28.

items.statement: Mathura annual revenue estimate ₹18-20 crore; downside comfortable at ₹12 crore.
items.quote: For Mathura, our broad revenue estimate is around ₹18–20 crore annually.

items.statement: Sheopur first-year revenue at least ₹12 crore with 35 rooms.
items.quote: For Sheopur, in the first year, assuming we operate around 35 rooms, our estimate is that revenue should be at least ₹12 crore.

items.statement: Total debt to reach around ₹50 crore by end FY28; two-year moratorium, seven-year repayment.
items.quote: Both loans have a two-year moratorium, followed by a seven-year repayment period.

items.statement: Strengthened due diligence for land deals after two incidents; ₹50 lakh written off.
items.quote: Going forward, we have strengthened our due -diligence process, particularly for land transactions.

items.statement: Top line expected to exceed INR 2000 crores over next 2-3 years.
items.quote: INR2000 crores plus will be the company's top line. And accordingly, bottom line EBITDA will also improve.

items.statement: Sales growth expected at 10-15% with PAT improving slightly more.
items.quote: Sales growth is on average around 10% to 15%. Accordingly, EBITDA and PAT will improve, with PAT improving slightly more. Both quantities and value will see an improvement of 10% to 15%.

items.statement: Solar power to add INR 10-12 crores to bottom line annually.
items.quote: So, with this also the bottom line profit of the year will increase by INR10 crores to INR12 crores and EBITDA will also increase.

items.statement: Margins to improve in Q3/Q4 FY27 due to better conditions.
items.quote: It should improve in Quarter 3 or Quarter 4. Quarter 2 is a rainy season, so there isn't significant improvement as construction remains somewhat affected. It will improve in Quarter 3 and Quarter 4.

items.statement: 15 MW solar plant: 12 MW operational, remaining in 1.5 months; expansion next year.
items.quote: Currently, the company is installing 15 MW, of which 12 MW has already been operationalized since August 7th, and the remaining will be operationalized within one and a half months. The further installation is being planned by the company for next year, where we will expand it further.

items.statement: Added higher-margin products like 550D, increasing inventory.
items.quote: Additionally, we have added products like 550D and other higher-value products, which has also contributed to the higher inventory.

items.statement: Able to charge INR 1500 premium over local competitors due to service and network.
items.quote: That is why we are able to charge INR1500 more premium as compared to the local ones.

items.statement: Raw material price surge due to Iran conflict compressed margins.
items.quote: Due to the recent Iran conflict, raw material prices -- scrap is our raw material which around 50%, 60% we are importing. So that's why the scrap prices has gone up. In compared to that TMT has not gone up so much. So that is the compressed the profit.

items.statement: Demand environment supportive from infrastructure, construction, real estate.
items.quote: We believe the demand environment remains supportive, particularly with continued activity in infrastructure, construction, and real estate.

items.statement: Dealer network grows 10-15% annually.
items.quote: On an annual basis, the dealer network grows by 10% to 15%.

items.statement: Inventory to normalize below INR 200 crores after Diwali.
items.quote: This will normalize after Diwali. After Diwali, it will come below INR200 crores.

items.statement: Expects FY27 revenue to be 15-20% higher than FY26, driven by new acid chloride products and portfolio diversification.
items.quote: So, this year we are expecting to be at least, almost 15% to 20% higher than what we were in the last year in terms of our revenue.

items.statement: Aspires to double revenue in the next 5-6 years through current product growth and new product commercialization.
items.quote: we are looking to double our size and business in next 5 years.

items.statement: Planning new manufacturing site in Odisha; land interest approved by government, feasibility report under preparation.
items.quote: The company has recently expressed interest in acquisition of land in Odisha in a notified zone which has been approved by the Odisha government.

items.statement: Building multi-purpose pilot plant with 4 streams; expected completion in 6-7 months to accelerate product scale-up.
items.quote: we are also setting up a multi-purpose pilot plant, the design of which is already done, and now we will start building that plant. It will take another 6 months to 7 months for that plant to be ready.

items.statement: Doubling R&D team and infrastructure this financial year to speed up product development.
items.quote: in this financial year, we are going to double our Research and Development team. As well as our infrastructure in Research and Development.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin at 15.6%, down from prior year due to pricing pressure and raw material pass-through.
items.quote: EBITDA margin for the quarter stood at 15.6%.

items.statement: DuPont/Arclin contract is formula-driven pass-through; revenue fluctuates with raw material prices.
items.quote: DuPont contract is a pass-through contract in terms of raw material and other cost so there can be ups and downs where raw material prices go up then our revenue, or rather our price, will also go up.

items.statement: Current quarter running at 100% permission utilization across all 4 sites (own + 3 job work).
items.quote: This quarter as we speak, we are looking at almost full capacity utilization, full permission utilization, 100% at all rather 3 job work and Transpek sites, all 4 sites.

items.statement: Arclin contract non-renewal would be significant blow to volume and margins; mitigation via portfolio diversification underway.
items.quote: assuming that the contract is not renewed, so that is why we are working on diversifying our portfolio of products. Next year when the renewal comes, and if it doesn't get renewed, so naturally that would be a significant blow in terms of volume and in terms of margins.

items.statement: Two new products near commercialization: one expected Q4 FY27 (~INR50 Cr annual), another FY28 (~INR50 Cr annual); pipeline products target INR50-100 Cr each.
items.quote: one is very close to commercialization. So that would have probably last quarter of this financial year as revenue, but on an annual basis that can be at least about INR50 crores worth of business for that particular product. Second product that we are looking at commercializing, probably it will, the commercialization

items.statement: No tariff advantage vs China/Japan in US; standard 18% tariff applies; customers benefit from duty drawback.
items.quote: Actually, there is no special tariff on Transpek products. What is the normal tariff I think it is 18%, if I remember correctly. That is the tariff that, Transpek products also have. So there is no specific advantage in terms of that.

items.statement: Targets revenue doubling over next 5-6 years through current and new products
items.quote: we are looking at doubling our revenue in the next 5 to 6 years as a combination of current products wherever we have potential for growth and new products

items.statement: Expects INR 50 crore annual revenue from first new product commercializing end of current FY
items.quote: Annual revenue there is expected to be about another INR50 crores

items.statement: Targets 15-20% EBITDA margin range going forward
items.quote: Moving forward, we are expecting same level, anywhere between 15% to 20%

items.statement: Plans INR 250 crore capex over 5-6 years for Odisha greenfield project in multiple phases
items.quote: We are looking at almost INR 250 Crores over 5-6 years

items.statement: Multi-purpose pilot plant at Ekalbara to be ready by February for scale-up trials
items.quote: Yes, around, maybe February

items.statement: Arclin increasing order quantities this quarter as they optimize production facility utilization
items.quote: this very quarter, we are seeing, some higher, quantities that they want, us to supply

items.statement: Expects per-kg margin pressure from Arclin but overall margin maintained via volume increase
items.quote: per kilo margin, we believe that there will be some impact. But overall margin will be, the, the loss that will be there will be more than, offset by the increase in volume

items.statement: Developing 3 polymers and additives with mix of complex high-purity and large-volume products targeting entry barriers
items.quote: We want to strategically, we want to be in those products where entry barrier can be created to some extent

items.statement: First non-acid chloride product (5MT pilot lot) nearing commercialization by end of calendar year after 3-4 month customer trial
items.quote: by end of this calendar year, we should see commercialization of that product

items.statement: Building AI models to accelerate product development from 3-4 years to 12-18 months
items.quote: we are building some AI models which will improve our ability to develop product in terms of the speed and in terms of the overall results

items.statement: Targeting 20% EBITDA margin over coming quarters, up from current 16.2%
items.quote: We are targeting internally 20% as an EBITDA margin over the coming quarters, and this is in line with our industry benchmarks.

items.statement: Aiming for at least 20% revenue CAGR over next five years based on growth strategy
items.quote: In terms of sales CAGR over the next five years, again, we don't give revenue guidance, but I would say at least 20% CAGR is something we aim at.

items.statement: FY27 capex plan of ₹30 crore, 60% allocated to driveline and axle growth areas
items.quote: Apart from that, overall, our capex plan for FY27 is ₹30 crore, and that's what we are progressing on.

items.statement: Machining capacity expansion from 1.8 lakh to 3 lakh pieces per month by end of FY27
items.quote: We are planning to expand our machining capacity from 1.8 lakh pieces per month to 3 lakh pieces per month by the end of the financial year.

items.statement: New wheel hub line expected online by end of Q2 FY27 using existing CNC machines
items.quote: We are expecting by the end of Q2 we should have it up and running, since it involves shifting our existing machinery from other businesses to this line and retooling the line.

items.statement: EBITDA margin reached all-time high of 16.2% in Q1 FY27, up 640 bps YoY
items.quote: EBITDA margin is 16.2%. This is another result that we are particularly happy about, as EBITDA margin is one of our main KPIs for our transformation journey. It is up 640 basis points year-on-year from 9.3% last year.

items.statement: Vriddhi Council realised ₹19.1 crore annualised savings to date against ₹50 crore annual target
items.quote: Vriddhi Council cost savings of ₹19.1 crore realised to date against a ₹50 crore annual target.

items.statement: Wheel hub samples in validation phase with ₹20 crore annual revenue potential
items.quote: Wheel hub samples are in progress, which constitute approximately ₹20 crore of annual revenue.

items.statement: New business revenue at all-time high of 22% of total revenue (~₹13 crore in Q1)
items.quote: At 22%, we are at an all-time high in the last five quarters or possibly even more, and at an absolute level it's around ₹13 crore of the quarter's revenue.

items.statement: Strong growth across segments: passenger cars 35% YoY, trucks 48% YoY, industrial 67% YoY
items.quote: Passenger cars: 35% year-on-year growth, with strong OEM growth and new business ramp-up. Trucks: 48% year-on-year growth, the fastest-growing segment. Industrial segment: 67% year-on-year growth, with a smaller base but the strongest percentage growth.

items.statement: Raw material cost pass-through mechanism in place with all customers; received pricing increases for recent raw material hikes
items.quote: We are fairly well insulated from raw material price changes, because we have a pass-through mechanism with all our customers. We have received pricing increases from our customers for whatever recent raw material rate increased there were.

items.statement: Business portfolio well hedged for EV transition; engine business focused on HCV/industrial, driveline and axle are fuel-agnostic
items.quote: Based on our market research, our primary feedback from customers and the general market, what we observe is that EVs can grow, but mainly in the two-wheeler and three-wheeler and then in the passenger vehicle market. There is not too much feasibility for EVs in the truck segment.

items.statement: Plans to raise equity in future with promoter participation to repay debt; evaluating multiple options
items.quote: We do have plans to raise equity in the future. There are multiple options that we are evaluating, and the promoters themselves would be putting in equity along with other participants.

items.statement: FY27 capex funded 75% by debt and 25% by internal accruals
items.quote: Yes, the capex is going to be funded by a combination of debt and internal accruals. So we're looking at 75% funding from debt and 25% from internal accruals. That's our policy.

items.statement: FY2026-27 revenue guidance of approximately ₹500 crore confirmed
items.quote: Based on the response provided in the chat, ₹500 crore appears to be a reasonable revenue guidance, considering the growth in CHUK and PM4 coming into operation.

items.statement: FY2026-27 EBITDA margin target of 18-19%
items.quote: We expect the gross-margin contribution to improve through a better variable-cost structure. Since fixed costs are not expected to increase proportionately, the higher contribution should support an improvement in margins.

items.statement: Project Jagriti total cost ₹753 crore, adding 30,000+ tonnes annual capacity
items.quote: The current total project cost is approximately ₹753 crore, and the project will add slightly more than 30,000 tonnes of annual capacity.

items.statement: PM4 commissioning targeted end of October, paper reeling in November
items.quote: We are confident of starting the machine by the end of October and reeling out paper in November.

items.statement: Delivery container facility investment less than ₹2 crore
items.quote: The initial facility is expected to require an investment of less than ₹2 crore.

items.statement: FlexC base paper pilot trials in Europe September, soft launch October, commercial production post PM4 start-up in November
items.quote: Pilot trials are being conducted in Europe on a machine selected after evaluating several facilities globally. The pilot machine closely replicates PM4, which was custom-designed to produce a differentiated product.

items.statement: Food Services B2B revenue grew 46% YoY to ₹16.5 crore, B2C grew ~3x YoY, now on 12 retail platforms
items.quote: B2B revenue grew by 46%, from ₹11.4 crore to ₹16.5 crore, and was the primary growth driver. On the B2C side, our presence has increased from three to 12 retail platforms.

items.statement: Delivery containers priced 40-50% above plastic, customers willing to absorb premium due to food quality benefits
items.quote: The product is currently priced approximately 40% –50% above comparable plastic containers, but it offers advantages in packing, unpacking and food quality, as indicated by chefs involved in our customer trials.

items.statement: FlexC base target cost ₹24/sqm vs petroleum substrates ₹16-18/sqm, aiming to reduce to ₹18/sqm
items.quote: In the targeted applications, petroleum-based substrates generally cost approximately ₹16 –₹18 per square metre, whereas our current target is approximately ₹24 per square metre.

items.statement: Neo Asset Management debt at ~17% vs previous 11%, refinancing targeted in 16-18 months
items.quote: The borrowing cost increased from approximately 11% to approximately 17%. The arrangement is intended to remain in place for approximately 18–20 months, during which the Company expects to commission and stabilise the project.

items.statement: Middle East situation affecting exports, export share ~27% of Q1 revenue
items.quote: Our principal challenges are the start-up of PM4, which is expected around the end of October or in November; market acceptance of products manufactured on PM4; the continuing Middle East situation, which is affecting exports; and the high financing cost associated with Project Jagriti.

items.statement: Outsourced Food Services capacity to grow from 300 to 800-900 tonnes/month over coming quarters
items.quote: We intend to increase outsourced capacity from approximately 300 tonnes per month currently to approximately 800–900 tonnes per month over the coming quarters.

items.statement: PM4 utilisation ramp: 40-50% initial months, 60-70% next year, 80-90% by 2028
items.quote: For the new plant, our financial projections assume utilisation of approximately 40% –50% during the initial months, 60% –70% in the following year, and stabilisation at approximately 80%–90% by 2028.

items.statement: Targeting INR 1,000 crores annual revenue by FY28
items.quote: The company continues to work towards its long-term objective of achieving INR 1,000 crores in annual revenue by FY28.

items.statement: Rationalizing low-margin SKUs; closing profit-draining products
items.quote: We are going away with many of the products which are not good profit margin or drainer, profit drainer. So definitely, we are closing that product.

items.statement: No import dependence for raw materials; fully local sourcing mitigates geopolitical risk
items.quote: We have stopped buying imports since many years. And as like locally material available in India, and hence, we are buying from local only.

items.statement: Q1 FY27 order inflow of INR90-100 crore vs full-year FY26 inflow of INR90-100 crore; additional INR60-65 crore secured in Q2 so far
items.quote: And again, in Q2, which is in running condition, we have got additional INR60 crores, INR65 crores of the orders in our kitty. So what I can say specific answer to your query, roughly 15% to 20% of the order book gets converted into the revenue.

items.statement: Management declines to give numeric FY27 revenue guidance citing SEBI LODR restrictions; notes Q1-Q2 typically 30-40% of annual revenue with Q3-Q4 stronger
items.quote: So it's difficult for me to give any numbers as the SEBI LODR doesn't allow us to do that. But definitely -- then Q1 and Q2, Q3, Q4 over the past years or so also, if you see, have been much better.

items.statement: Ticket size of new orders rising from INR5-10 crore to INR20-40 crore range; NHAI technical rating of 9/100 consultants provides competitive advantage for larger assignments
items.quote: Previous financial years, yes. So already, you can see the results, the projects which already LOA has been received are INR19 crores, INR30 crores, INR40 crores, those kind of assignments. Minimum, I think, would be INR8 crores. So we are moving towards that bigger ticket size assignments now.

items.statement: Three additional Wayside Amenities projects near Nanded, Latur, Solapur; LOAs expected September 2026, revenue start 7-8 months post possession
items.quote: Existing project we concluded. Now we are in for another 3 projects. One is near Nanded City, is near Latur city and one is near Solapur city, all 3 are big cities. So the letter of acceptance are expected anywhere in month of September.

items.statement: International order book target 10-15%; empaneled in Mozambique, preferred bidder in Ghana, bidding in Saudi Arabia; Exim Bank empanelment enables lenders' engineering & DPR work for Indian contractors abroad
items.quote: We are hopeful of getting 10% to 15% of our order book from the international market.

items.statement: Receivables cycle 60-90 days (up to 120 days in Northeast); no major mobilization or approval delays expected in next 9 months; prior estimate correction of INR30-35 crore (<5% of order book) now complete
items.quote: Our total order book is INR600 crores and the correction happened is about INR30 crores, INR35 crores, which is completed now, and it is less than 5%. So now we don't expect any big challenge or any threat or any surprise for current year.

items.statement: FY27 EBITDA margin target of ~18% excluding West Asia conflict impact
items.quote: For FY27, yes, it remains -- that remains about 18% EBITDA margins.

items.statement: Steady-state EBITDA margin target of 18-20% overall business excluding West Asia conflict
items.quote: we are good to maintain about 18% to 20% EBITDA margins on the overall business.

items.statement: West Asia conflict impact ~INR10 crores in Q1 FY27, partially offset by price increases
items.quote: The overall net impact of the conflict on Q1 FY27 was approximately INR10 crores, which was partially offset through price increases implemented across multiple categories.

items.statement: Solar Phase 3 savings ~INR27-28 crores at EBITDA level in FY27
items.quote: FY27, the overall savings from the solar with the Phase 3 implementations that we have done so far, that will be about INR27 crores, INR28 crores at EBITDA level.

items.statement: Hydra plant 2 double-wall lines commissioned 30 June 2026, third line expected Q2 FY27
items.quote: The commercial production from 2 double-wall lines commenced on 30th June 2026, and the production from third double-wall line is expected to commence during Q2 FY27.

items.statement: Chinese dumping in borosilicate glassware persists despite rupee depreciation and higher freight
items.quote: And despite depreciation of the rupee as well as the shipping freight rates going up, I would say, in the market, we are not seeing much of a difference as far as the Chinese dumping is concerned.

items.statement: Solar now meets ~61% of overall energy requirement after 20MW BESS plant commissioning
items.quote: As a result, solar power now meets about 61% of our overall energy requirement.

items.statement: ROCE target 20-24% medium term as capacity utilization improves and capex bears fruit
items.quote: I think we should definitely look at basically 20% to 24% ROCE margins on the business.

items.statement: Targeting FY27 revenue of Rs 500+ crore, implying 35-40% YoY growth over FY26's Rs 365 crore
items.quote: we are targeting 500 plus crores for FY27. Approximately 35 to 40% of the growth.

items.statement: Order book stands at Rs 373 crore as of June 30, 2026, with 55% executable in FY27
items.quote: As of June 30, 2026, XtraNet had a strong order book of approximately INR 373 crores across 55 projects. Importantly, approximately 55% of this order book is expected to be executable during FY27

items.statement: Q1 FY27 EBITDA margin expanded 855 bps YoY to 20.59%; PAT margin improved 444 bps to 11.88%
items.quote: operational EBITDA increased by 89% Y-o-Y to approximately INR 10 crores, with EBITDA expanding by 855 basis points to 20.59%. Profit after tax stood at approximately INR 6 crores, representing a 77% Y-o-Y increase, while PAT margin improved by 444 basis points to 11.88%.

items.statement: Services revenue share rose to 65-68% in Q1 FY27 from 46% in Q1 FY26; target is 60%+ services mix for FY27
items.quote: Services accounted for approximately 65 to 68% of Q1 FY27 revenue, compared with around 46 Q1 FY26. This shift towards a higher service-led revenue makes it strategically important for us

items.statement: Targeting 35-40% CAGR over next 3 years; data center to remain 50-55% of revenue, enterprise apps 20-25%, proprietary platforms + digital services 30%+
items.quote: Overall goal is basically we want to grow around 35% to 40% CAGR in the next three years' time. And on my four verticals, the biggest vertical will always be my data center, which will be around 50-55 odd percent. Enterprise applications will be around 20-25 odd percent. And my biggest share in the service margin, whic

items.statement: Data center segment targeting 35-40% YoY revenue growth; active pipeline of Rs 600+ crore in data center & IT operations
items.quote: We are looking forward to 35% to 40% of the annual growth in this segment from our business perspective. So, every year, we have an objective to take it to the next level and 35% to 40% is the objective to increase the revenue base from this segment.

items.statement: Hardware costs up 3-4x over past year; company mitigated via pre-built inventory for existing projects; new bids factor in price escalation clauses
items.quote: The cost of hardware has moved almost 3x-4x size basically. That was the strategic call of the company which was very different from the many other players as well that we had kept some good inventory with us for my past projects wherein there is no price escalation with government.

items.statement: XtraTrust data center capacity being enhanced to handle more subscribers; targeting completion in next quarter
items.quote: We are enhancing the capacity and capability of our data center, and we are targeting XtraTrust in the next one quarter of time.

items.statement: Active bid pipeline of Rs 1,200 crore; 40-45% at advanced stage; expect to convert ~30% to orders in next quarter
items.quote: Approximately 40% to 45% out of this is at an advanced stage. And hopefully, in next one quarter, we will be able to close to 30% of this order book.

items.statement: Product prices locked at bid stage via firm OEM rate confirmations; no pass-through on existing orders; new bids include annual price escalation clauses linked to USD variation
items.quote: Generally, as I have already informed you the life cycle, from the bidding to order conversion, it is approximately 60 to 90 days. And we already have a firm rate confirmation from the respective manufacturer. We take it in writing for a particular project, and the price is locked for the project.

items.statement: Internal IRR hurdle of 17-18% for CAPEX+annuity projects; working capital cycle: government 120-150 days, O&M services 45-60 days
items.quote: Even in that case also we maintain a benchmark of at least 17% to 18% as an IRR then only we enter into the project basically.

items.statement: Tax rate expected at ~25% for next two years
items.quote: It will be close to 25 odd percent. That tax rate will be considered for the next two years, ma'am.

items.statement: Fresh orders of Rs 60 crore secured in Q1 FY27; order book composition: 55% non-government, 45% government; 45% direct, 55% indirect
items.quote: We continue to see healthy momentum in order inflows during the quarter, securing fresh orders worth approximately Rs. 60 crores. This took our order book to around INR 373 crores as of June 30, 2026.

items.statement: Aims for double-digit growth for the full year, with H2 expected to be much better than H1.
items.quote: Our goal is to have a double -digit growth. This is what we are aiming for.

items.statement: New shed at Shirwal adds approximately 20% capacity to the energy plant.
items.quote: This will approximately add to capacity of 20% in this plant.

items.statement: Nuclear order on hand stands at INR 1,235 crores, including GHAVP, Kaiga, and Kudankulam safety package.
